es.e: They want to decrease their reliance on oil.
es.c: 他们想减少对石油的依赖。

d: n 执行；成绩；演出 when someone performs a play or a piece of music

es.c: 男性感染花粉热多于女性。

es.c: 轰炸

es.c: 空袭警报

es.c: 僵尸们在网格的每一行向你的房子蹒跚而行，如果他们越过了你的防线，那么，你知道的。

es.c: 头发上系着丝带的小姑娘们

es.c: 一捆用淡蓝色丝带扎好的信

es.c: 剪彩后，新车站正式开始运营。

es.c: 两种情形下，这些见解并非来自于天文学，而是来自大气干扰—— 而且，那并不令人感到如此的吃惊。

d: n 切片，部分；段，节 a part of something that is different from or affected differently from the whole in some way

d: n 文章，小品文，随笔 a short piece of writing giving someone’s ideas about politics, society etc

es.c: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

es.c: 该课程的教学大纲主要包括了非裔美国男女作家的小说。

d: adj 能偿还的 having enough money to pay your debts；n 溶剂，偿付能力 a chemical that is used to  dissolve  another substance

es.c: 他们将不得不证明公司现在是具备偿债能力的。

d: n 通信；符合 the process of sending and receiving letters

es.e: The magazine is unable to enter into any correspondence on medical matters.
es.c: 本杂志无法答复有关医学方面的来信。

es.e: All correspondence between us must cease.
es.c: 我们之间的所有通信必须停止。

d: adj (疾病)流行性的，传染的
v 使分裂，瓦解

es.e: Traffic was disrupted by a hoax bomb.
es.c: 有人虚报有炸弹，造成了交通混乱。

d: v 使羞辱，使丢脸 to make someone feel ashamed or stupid, especially when other people are present

es.e: Her boss humiliated her in front of all her colleagues.
es.c: 她的老板在所有同事面前羞辱了她。

d: n 媒介；中庸间，适中 a way of communicating information and news to people, such as newspapers, television etc；adj 中等的，中庸 of middle size, level, or amount

es.e: Advertising is a powerful medium.
es.c: 广告是具有强大影响力的传播媒介。

d: n 涟漪，波纹 a small low wave on the surface of a liquid；vt&vi (使)起层层细浪 to move in small waves, or to make something move in this way

es.e: ripples on the surface of the pond
es.c: 池面上的涟漪

es.e: She dived into the pool, making scarcely a ripple.
es.c: 她跳入池中，几乎没有泛起水波。

d: n 诅咒，祸因，骂人话 a swear word or words that you say because you are very angry；v 咒骂，被所苦 to swear

es.e: He muttered a curse under his breath.
es.c: 他低声骂了一句。

d: n 冒犯或引起反感的行动；流言，诽谤 Scandal is talk about the shocking and immoral aspects of someone's behaviour or something that has happened

es.e: He loved gossip and scandal.
es.c: 他喜欢闲话和流言蜚语。

d: n 劝告；评议；忠告；律师 a type of lawyer who represents you in court

es.e: He had always been able to count on her wise counsel.
es.c: 他总是能够指望她明智的忠告。

d: v&n 摇晃；蹒跚 to walk or move unsteadily, almost falling over

es.e: He managed to stagger home.
es.c: 他好不容易才蹒跚着走回家。

es.e: She staggered back a step.
es.c: 她踉跄着后退了一步。

es.e: The old man staggered drunkenly to his feet.
es.c: 老汉醉醺醺地踉跄着站了起来。

d: n 荚；装一剂药的小囊；密封舱 a plastic container shaped like a very small tube with medicine inside that you swallow whole

es.e: a space capsule orbiting the Earth
es.c: 沿地球轨道飞行的太空舱

d: adj 紧急的，必要的，强制的，祈使语气 extremely important and needing to be done or dealt with immediately

es.e: It is imperative that politicians should be good communicators.
es.c: 政治家应该是很好的沟通者，这很重要。

d: n 食谱，烹饪法 a set of instructions for cooking a particular type of food

es.e: a recipe book
es.c: 一本烹饪书

d: v 漂流，流浪 to move slowly on water or in the air；n 漂流，漂流物，趋势 a slow change or development from one situation, opinion etc to another

es.e: Smoke drifted up from the jungle ahead of us.
es.c: 我们前方的丛林里有烟升起。

d: v&n 嗡嗡叫，嘈杂声 to make a low continuous sound

es.e: Machines hummed on the factory floor.
es.c: 机器在车间里嗡嗡作响。

d: adj 一般的，普通的 relating to a whole group of things rather than to one thing

es.e: Parmesan is a generic term used to describe a family of hard Italian cheeses.
es.c: 巴尔马干酪是一个用来描述一类坚硬的意大利奶酪的通用名称。

d: n 公民投票、复决权 when people vote in order to make a decision about a particular subject, rather than voting for a person

es.e: The city council agreed to hold a referendum on the issue in November.
es.c: 市政会同意在11月就此问题进行全民投票。

d: n 流体 a liquid；adj 流动的，不固定的 a situation that is fluid is likely to change

es.e: He is not allowed solid food yet, only fluids.
es.c: 他还不能吃固体食物，只能进流食。

es.e: a powerful cleaning fluid
es.c: 一种强力清洁液

d: adj 真实的，可靠的 a painting, document, book etc that is authentic has been proved to be by a particular person

es.e: an authentic work by Picasso
es.c: 毕加索的真迹

d: n 沼泽地，使淹没 land that is always very wet or covered with a layer of water

es.e: I spent one whole night by a swamp behind the road listening to frogs.
es.c: 我整个晚上都在这条路后面的一个沼泽地旁听蛙鸣。

d: n&v 耸肩 to raise and then lower your shoulders in order to show that you do not know something or do not care about something

es.e: I just shrugged my shoulders and ignored him.
es.c: 我只是耸耸肩，没有理睬他。

es.e: Melanie shrugged and walked away.
es.c: 梅拉妮耸耸肩走开了。

d: n 奔流，兴奋，激动 a sudden feeling of anger, embarrassment etc；adj 齐平的；富有的 if two surfaces are flush, they are at exactly the same level, so that the place where they meet is flat

es.e: She felt a sudden flush of anger.
es.c: 她突然感到一阵愤怒。

d: v 遣返；返回 to send someone back to their own country

es.e: After the war, prisoners were repatriated.
es.c: 战后，战俘被遣返。

d: n 降落伞 a piece of equipment fastened to the back of people who jump out of planes, which makes them fall slowly and safely to the ground

es.e: a parachute jump
es.c: 跳伞

d: n&vt 水坝，筑坝，抑制，阻拦 a special wall built across a river or stream to stop the water from flowing, especially in order to make a lake or produce electricity

es.e: Once she allowed her anger to show, it could not be dammed up again.
es.c: 她一旦发起脾气来就不可收拾。

d: n 管理员，监护人 a person who is responsible for a particular place and whose job is to make sure its rules are obeyed
n 追赶；追求；从事，消遣 when someone tries to get, achieve, or find something in a determined way

es.e: The quarterback sprinted toward the end zone with Jansen in hot pursuit (= following closely behind ) .
es.c: 那名四分卫快速冲向底线区，詹森穷追不舍。

d: v 抓；接球；逮住；赶(车) to see someone doing something that they did not want you to know they were doing

es.e: He was caught red-handed (= as he was doing something wrong ) taking money from the cash register.
es.c: 他从现金出纳机偷钱时被当场抓住。

d: n 小块土地；阴谋，情节 the events that form the main story of a book, film, or play；v 绘制，标绘 to draw marks or a line to represent facts, numbers etc

es.e: The plot was a little confusing.
es.c: 情节有些费解。

es.e: We discover that Jack isn’t as innocent as he seems, as the plot unfolds (= gradually becomes clearer ) .
es.c: 随着情节的展开，我们发现杰克并不像表面上看起来那么清白。

d: n&v&a 相反(的)；颠倒(的) if a vehicle or its driver reverses, they go backwards

es.e: I owe you nothing. If anything, the reverse is true (= you owe me ) .
es.c: 我不欠你什么。 如果说欠的话，是你欠我才对。

d: n 纯净；纯洁 the quality or state of being pure

es.e: the purity of tap water
es.c: 自来水的纯净度

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["spiritual purity"]}
es.c: 心灵的纯洁

d: n 统计，统计数字；统计学 quantitative data on any subject, esp data comparing the distribution of some quantity for different subclasses of the population

es.e: statistics for earnings by different age groups

d: adj 可防守的，守得住的；可保持的，可维持的

es.e: an idea which is no longer tenable
es.c: 不再成立的观点

d: adj 可触知的；明确的；确实的 clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen or noticed

es.e: The scheme must have tangible benefits for the unemployed.
es.c: 这个计划一定要对失业者有实实在在的好处。

d: v 解散；解雇；不考虑；消除 to remove someone from their job

es.e: The government has dismissed criticisms that the country’s health policy is a mess.
es.c: 有人认为国家医疗政策一塌糊涂，政府对这种批评持否认态度。

d: v 开发票 to send someone an invoice；n 发票，装货清单 a list of goods that have been supplied or work that has been done, showing how much you owe for them

es.e: The agency invoices the client who then pays the full amount to the agency.
es.c: 那个代销处给客户开具发票，然后客户向代销处支付全部的款项。

d: n 营养，营养学 the process of giving or getting the right type of food for good health and growth

es.e: Nutrition and exercise are essential to fitness and health.
es.c: 营养和运动是保持健康所必不可少的。

es.e: a nutrition expert
es.c: 营养专家

d: adj 憔悴的，瘦弱的；荒凉的 very thin and pale, especially because of illness or continued worry

es.e: the old man’s gaunt face
es.c: 老人那瘦削的脸庞

d: n 被告 the person in a court of law who has been  accused  of doing something illegal；adj 处于被告地位的

es.e: We find the defendant not guilty.
es.c: 我们裁定被告无罪。

d: v (物价)涨落，起落，波动 if a price or amount fluctuates, it keeps changing and becoming higher and lower

es.e: Insect populations fluctuate wildly from year to year.
es.c: 昆虫的数量每年变化很大。

d: v 提高(强度、力量、数量等)，增加(进) to improve something

es.e: Good lighting will enhance any room.
es.c: 良好的照明能给房间增色不少。

es.e: The publicity has enhanced his reputation.
es.c: 这次宣传提高了他的声誉。

d: adj 可怕的，非常的

es.e: That’s a terrific idea!
es.c: 这个主意真棒！

d: vt&n 展览，陈列 an arrangement of things for people to look at or buy

es.e: a dazzling display (= very good display ) of flowers
es.c: 令人目眩神迷的花卉展

es.e: The window display caught her eye.
es.c: 橱窗陈列吸引了她的目光。

d: n 交响乐曲 a long piece of music usually in four parts, written for an  orchestra

es.e: Bruckner’s Fifth Symphony
es.c: 布鲁克纳的《第五交响曲》

d: n&a 滋补品，补药；强身的，健体的 a drink that you have as a medicine to give you more energy or strength when you feel tired

es.e: A lot of people need a tonic at the end of the winter.
es.c: 很多人冬末需要进补。

d: n 生理组织；薄纸；棉纸；织物；一套 light thin paper used for wrapping, packing etc

es.e: a box of tissues
es.c: 一盒面巾纸

d: n 教学，学费 teaching, especially in small groups

es.e: I had to have extra tuition in maths.
es.c: 我不得不上数学补习课。

d: n 学术性刊物，期刊；日记 a serious magazine produced for professional people or those with a particular interest

es.e: the British Medical Journal
es.c: 《英国医学杂志》

d: n 果核，果仁，核心 the part of a nut or seed inside the shell, or the part inside the stone of some fruits

es.e: The kernel of that message was that peace must not be a source of advantage or disadvantage for anyone.
es.c: 那一信息的核心是和平绝不应该成为对任何人有利或不利的根源。

d: n 大拇指 the part of your hand that is shaped like a thick short finger and helps you to hold things

es.e: a baby sucking its thumb
es.c: 吮着大拇指的婴儿

es.e: She held the coin carefully between finger and thumb.
es.c: 她小心翼翼地把那枚硬币捏在食指和拇指之间。

d: n 说明书，简介 a small book that advertises a school, college, new business etc

es.e: ...a prospectus for a new issue of stock.
es.c: …新发行股票的招股说明书。

d: v 诊断(疾病) to find out what illness someone has, or what the cause of a fault is, after doing tests, examinations etc

es.e: How did they diagnose you?
es.c: 他们怎么给你的诊断的？

es.e: What tools do you need to help you diagnose the problem, and where do you get them?
es.c: 您需要什么工具来帮助您诊断问题，可以从哪里获得这些工具？

es.e: Evidently this springs from some defect in their nature, but it is one not altogether easy either to diagnose of to cure.
es.c: 这种情形显然源于他们本性上的某种缺陷，但是这种缺陷既不容易诊断也不容易治疗。

d: a&ad&n 额外的/地，非常，另外；额外的人 Extras are additional amounts of money that are added to the price that you have to pay for something

es.e: There are no hidden extras.
es.c: 没有任何隐蔽的额外费用。

d: "vi 缩小, 减小" to gradually become less and less or smaller and smaller

es.e: The elephant population is dwindling.
es.c: 大象的数量在减少。

es.e: His money had dwindled away.
es.c: 他的钱在逐渐变少。

d: n 补钉；眼罩；斑点；小块土地 a small area of something that is different from the area around it；v 补缀 to repair a hole in something by putting a piece of something else over it

es.e: Look out for icy patches on the road.
es.c: 小心路上结冰的地方。

es.e: a cat with a white patch on its chest
es.c: 胸部有一块白斑的猫

es.e: He combs his hair over his bald patch .
es.c: 他把头发梳过来盖住秃掉的地方。

d: n 草图，素描; a simple, quickly made drawing that does not show much detail；n 短剧；简述 a short humorous scene on a television programme, in a theatre etc, that is part of a larger show；v 草拟

es.e: So if we just sketch that.
es.c: 那么如果我们把那画个草图。

es.e: He squiggled a sketch on the ground.
es.c: 他在地上胡乱地画了个草图。

d: adj 难看的，简陋的；吝啬的，自私的 not wanting to spend money, or not wanting to use much of something；n 中间 a method of doing something which is between two very different methods, and better than either of them …

es.e: He’s too mean to buy a present for his wife.
es.c: 他很吝啬，给他妻子买件礼物都不肯。

d: n 痕迹；足迹；微量 a small sign that shows that someone or something was present or existed；v 描绘，勾出轮廓 to copy a drawing, map etc by putting a piece of transparent paper over it and then drawing the lines you can see through the

es.e: There was no trace of anyone having entered the room since then.
es.c: 没有任何迹象表明在那以后有人进过这房间。

es.e: Petra’s lost all trace of her German accent.
es.c: 彼得拉已完全没有德国口音。

es.e: Officers were unable to find any trace of drugs.
es.c: 警察未能找到毒品的蛛丝马迹。

d: n 防卫 防护 防御物 辩护 被告律师 something that you say or do in order to support someone or something that is being criticized

es.e: The land was flat, giving no scope for defence.
es.c: 土地非常平坦，无法做防卫之用。

d: n 驱逐; 开除 the act of forcing someone to leave a place

es.e: The headmaster threatened the boys with expulsion.
es.c: 校长警告这几名男生说要开除他们。

d: adj 潜在的; likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future；adj 可能的 likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future；n 潜能；潜力 the possibility that something will develop in

es.e: The company has identified 60 potential customers.
es.c: 该公司已确定了60位潜在的客户。

d: n 护照，保障，手段 a small official document that you get from your government, that proves who you are, and which you need in order to leave your country and enter other countries

es.e: I have an Irish passport.
es.c: 我持爱尔兰护照。

es.e: They need to check that your passport is in order.
es.c: 他们要检查一下你的护照是否有效。

d: n 工艺；手工业；船；技巧；诡计 a job or activity in which you make things with your hands, and that you usually need skill to do

es.e: traditional rural crafts
es.c: 传统的乡村手工艺

es.e: arts and crafts
es.c: 手工艺

d: n&vi 微光，闪光，短暂而微弱的闪现 to shine softly

es.e: His teeth gleamed under his moustache.
es.c: 他的八字须下面，牙齿晶莹发亮。

d: v&n 泛滥，溢出 if a river, lake, or container overflows, it is so full that the liquid or material inside flows over its edges

es.e: The drains flooded and water overflowed down the main street.
es.c: 下水道被淹，水溢到了大街上。

es.e: The river had overflowed its banks.
es.c: 河水漫堤了。

d: adj 庄严的，严肃的，隆重的 very serious and not happy, for example because something bad has happened or because you are at an important occasion

es.e: a solemn expression
es.c: 严肃的表情

es.e: Their faces suddenly grew solemn.
es.c: 他们的脸突然变得严肃起来。

es.e: a solemn procession of mourners
es.c: 庄重的送葬队伍

d: n 植被 plants in general

es.e: Lefkas has an abundance of lush green vegetation.
es.c: 莱夫卡斯有葱郁茂盛的植被。

d: adj 易弯的，柔韧的；易受影响的 able to bend without breaking or cracking

es.e: a shoe made of soft pliable leather
es.c: 柔韧的皮革做成的鞋子

d: n 理解；忧虑 anxiety about the future, especially about dealing with something unpleasant or difficult

es.e: a feeling of apprehension
es.c: 担忧的心情

es.e: I woke before the alarm, filled with apprehension.
es.c: 我忧心忡忡，闹钟没响就醒了。

d: v 胡言乱语；热衷谈论 to talk in an angry, uncontrolled, or crazy way；n 热情赞扬 enthusiastic or extravagant praise

es.e: He was still ranting and raving the next morning.
es.c: 第二天上午他仍在大叫大嚷。

d: adj 运动的，移动的 relating to movement；n 火车头 a railway engine

es.e: an increase in locomotive power
es.c: 运动力的增加

d: n [法]企业家, 演出承包人 " someone who starts a new business or arranges business deals in order to make money, often in a way that involves financial risks
adj 有疑问的；怀疑的 not sure that something is true or right

es.e: ‘Everything’s going to be all right, you’ll see.’ Jenny looked doubtful .
es.c: “一切都会顺顺当当的，你等着看好了。” 珍妮看起来不大相信的样子。

d: adj 疾病的，病态的 with a strong and unhealthy interest in unpleasant subjects, especially death

es.e: The trip was made all the worse by Frankie’s morbid fear of flying.
es.c: 弗朗基对坐飞机有种病态的恐惧，使得旅途变得更加糟糕。

es.e: His head was full of morbid thoughts.
es.c: 他的脑袋里全是不健康的思想。

d: adj 猛烈的，凶暴的；由暴力引起的；强烈的 involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc

es.e: the increase in violent crime
es.c: 暴力犯罪的增多

es.e: violent clashes between the police and demonstrators
es.c: 警方与示威者之间发生的暴力冲突

es.e: 31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
es.c: 今天一天有31人在暴力事件中受伤。

d: v 举例说明，作为的例证 to give an example of something

es.e: Problems are exemplified in the report.
es.c: 问题都在报告中作了举例说明。

d: v 停止 to stop doing something or stop happening

es.e: The things people will do for charity never cease to amaze me (= I am always surprised by them ) .
es.c: 人们的慈善义举总是让我感到惊讶。

es.e: The rain ceased and the sky cleared.
es.c: 雨过天晴。

d: v 旋转，轮流 to turn with a circular movement around a central point, or to make something do this

es.e: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
es.c: 地球每24小时绕地轴自转一周。

es.e: Rotate the pan halfway through the baking time.
es.c: 烘烤到一半时把盘子转一下。

d: n 解决困难，解答问题；溶解；溶液 a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation

es.e: The best solution would be for them to separate.
es.c: 最好的解决方法是他们分开。

d: v 认出，认为与一致 to recognize and correctly name someone or something

es.e: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
es.c: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

es.e: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
es.c: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

d: adj 最高的；首要的 more important than anything else

es.e: During a war the interests of the state are paramount, and those of the individual come last.
es.c: 战争时期国家利益是首要的，个人利益置于最后。

es.e: Women’s role as mothers is of paramount importance to society.
es.c: 女性作为母亲的角色对社会至关重要。

d: v 联合；连结 if you combine two or more different things, or if they combine, they begin to exist or work together；n 集团，联合企业 a group of people, businesses etc who work together

es.e: Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
es.c: 节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。

es.e: Ruth hesitated, uncertain of how to combine honesty and diplomacy in her answer.
es.c: 露丝犹豫了，她不知道怎样回答才能既诚实又婉转。

d: n 雪崩；大量涌来 a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls down the side of a mountain

es.e: Two skiers were killed in the avalanche.
es.c: 两名滑雪者在雪崩中丧生。

d: n 仪器；设备 the set of tools and machines that you use for a particular scientific, medical, or technical purpose

es.c: 这份报告的优点就是它对所要求的变动进行了实事求是的评估。

es.e: The great merit of the project is its flexibility and low cost.
es.c: 该项目最大的优点是它的灵活性和低成本。

es.e: Each of these approaches to teaching has its merits .
es.c: 这些教学方法每一种都有其优点。

d: n (湍，激，洪)流 a large amount of water moving very quickly and strongly in a particular direction

es.e: After five days of heavy rain the Telle river was a raging torrent (= a very violent torrent ) .
es.c: 下了五天的大雨之后，泰勒河急流汹涌。

d: v 阿谀，使高兴；(肖像)等胜过(真人真物)

es.e: That dress really flatters your figure.
es.c: 那件连衣裙很显你的身材。

d: n 临时解雇，停工 When there are layoffs in a company, people become unemployed because there is no more work for them in the company

es.e: It will close more than 200 stores nationwide resulting in the layoffs of an estimated 2,000 employees.
es.c: 在全国范围内将关闭二百多家商店，造成约两千人失业。

d: v 估的价，定的值 to judge how good, useful, or successful something is

es.e: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
es.c: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

es.e: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
es.c: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

es.e: It can be difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments.
es.c: 要对各种治疗方法的效果作出评估会很难。

d: n&vt 出口；发泄 to do something violent or harmful to express feelings of anger, hatred etc

es.e: Children give vent to their anger in various ways.
es.c: 儿童用各种方法发泄怒气。

es.e: He knew that if he gave full vent to his feelings, it would upset Joanna.
es.c: 他知道，要是他把自己的情绪全部发泄出来，就会把乔安娜惹火的。

d: adj 紧密的，紧凑的 packed or put together firmly and closely

es.e: The bushes grew in a compact mass.
es.c: 灌木长成茂密的一片。

d: n 生产能力；生产率 the rate at which goods are produced, and the amount produced, especially in relation to the work, time, and money needed to produce them

es.e: high productivity levels in manufacturing
es.c: 制造业中的高生产率

es.e: It cost the country $4 million in lost productivity .
es.c: 它对该国造成了400万美元的生产力损失。

d: adj 绝对的，无条件的 not limited by or depending on any conditions

es.e: the unconditional release of all political prisoners
es.c: 所有政治犯的无条件释放

es.e: unconditional surrender
es.c: 无条件投降

d: v 埋伏，潜伏 to wait somewhere quietly and secretly, usually because you are going to do something wrong

es.e: a dark formless danger, lurking in the shadows
es.c: 一种潜藏在阴影里的无形危险

d: n 压力；重压 continuous feelings of worry about your work or personal life, that prevent you from relaxing；v 着重，强调重点，重视 to emphasize a statement, fact, or idea

es.e: Your headaches are due to stress.
es.c: 你的头痛是压力造成的。

es.e: Janet’s been under a lot of stress since her mother’s illness.
es.c: 珍妮特自从母亲生病以来承受了很大的压力。

es.e: all the stresses of public life
es.c: 公众生活的所有压力

d: n 乐趣；滋味，风味; 兴趣

es.e: The danger of being caught added a certain zest to the affair.
es.c: 被捉奸的危险为这件风流韵事增添了一些刺激性。

d: n 竞争者，对手 a person, group, or organization that you compete with in sport, business, a fight etc

es.e: This gives the company a competitive advantage over its rivals.
es.c: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

es.e: He finished 39 seconds ahead of his main rival .
es.c: 他比主要对手早39秒到达终点。

es.e: She was 2 minutes faster than her nearest rival .
es.c: 她比紧随其后的对手快两分钟。

d: n 香味，香气 a pleasant smell

es.e: ...a shrubby plant with a strong characteristic fragrance.
es.c: …一种有独特浓郁香味的灌木。

d: v 遵守，照做 to do what you have to do or are asked to do

es.e: The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
es.c: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

d: adj 可信赖的，可靠的 able to be trusted and depended on

es.e: He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.
es.c: 他是个可信赖的、头脑冷静的领导。

d: n&v 染料，着色剂，污点，沾污处 to accidentally make a mark on something, especially one that cannot be removed, or to be marked in this way

es.e: Be careful you don’t stain the carpet.
es.c: 当心别把地毯弄脏了。

es.e: This tablecloth stains very easily.
es.c: 这块桌布很容易脏。

es.e: Her fingers were stained yellow from years of smoking.
es.c: 她的手指因长年吸烟被熏黄了。

d: adj 明显的；获得专利的 protected by a patent；n 专利 a special document that gives you the right to make or sell a new  invention  or product that no one else is allowed to copy；v 取得专利 to obtain a special document giving you the rig

es.e: a patent lock
es.c: 专利锁

d: n 烦忧，困扰 when someone behaves in an unpleasant or threatening way towards you

es.e: African-Americans have been complaining about police harassment for years.
es.c: 美国黑人多年来一直抱怨受到警察的骚扰。

d: n 矮子，矮小的动植物 an imaginary creature that looks like a small man；v 使矮小 to be so big that other things are made to seem very small

es.e: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
es.c: 《白雪公主和七个小矮人》

d: n 估价，评价；鉴定 a statement or opinion judging the worth, value, or condition of something

es.e: What is needed in such cases is a calm appraisal of the situation.
es.c: 在此类情况下需要的是对形势的冷静估计。

d: adj 极小心的；勤恳的 very careful and thorough

es.e: The work had been done with painstaking attention to detail.
es.c: 这项工作被一丝不苟地完成了。

es.e: Chris described in painstaking detail what had happened.
es.c: 克里斯非常详细地描述了所发生的事情。

d: adj 脆弱的；脆弱的 someone who is frail is weak and thin because they are old or ill

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["frail elderly people"]}
es.c: 年老体衰者

es.e: her frail health
es.c: 她虚弱的身体

d: n 能力，胜任，权限 the ability to do something well

es.e: Typing is considered by most employers to be a basic competence.
es.c: 大多数雇主认为打字是一项基本技能。

d: n 通风；讨论 an occasion when an opinion, idea etc is discussed

es.e: give them an airing.
es.c: 把室内盆栽植物搬出去透透气。

d: v 否认, 否定，拒绝一项要求" to say that something is not true, or that you do not believe something

es.e: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
es.c: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

d: n 居住；住处；住宅 a house, especially a large or official one

es.e: the ambassador’s official residence
es.c: 大使官邸

d: v 完成，达到 to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard

es.e: Frances achieved very good exam results.
es.c: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

es.e: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
es.c: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

es.e: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
es.c: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

d: n 智力，才智 the ability to understand things and to think intelligently

es.e: Do the emotions develop in parallel with the intellect?
es.c: 情感与智力同步发展吗？

d: adj 普通的，平凡的

es.e: Car thefts are commonplace in this part of town.
es.c: 镇上的这个地段盗车案屡见不鲜。

d: v&n 瞌睡 to be in a light sleep or to feel as though you are almost asleep

es.e: I was drowsing in front of the television when you called.
es.c: 我正坐在电视机前打瞌睡，恰好你打电话来。

d: adj 水产的；(运行)水上的 living or growing in water

es.e: an aquatic plant
es.c: 水生植物

d: n&v 振奋，高兴，欢呼 a shout of happiness, praise, approval, or encouragement

es.e: A great cheer went up from the crowd.
es.c: 人群中爆发出巨大的欢呼声。

es.e: So let’s give a cheer to the kids who passed their exams.
es.c: 那么我们为通过考试的孩子们欢呼吧。

es.e: The final whistle was greeted with triumphant cheers from players and spectators.
es.c: 终场的哨声迎来了运动员和观众胜利的欢呼。

d: n 赈济款、物；慈善团体；博爱 an organization that gives money, goods, or help to people who are poor, sick etc

es.e: Several charities sent aid to the flood victims.
es.c: 有几家慈善机构已向洪灾灾民送去了救援物资。

d: v&n 把（…）锁住；被锁住

es.e: The wheels suddenly locked.
es.c: 轮子突然卡住不动了。

d: adj 遗腹的；父亡后出生的；死后的；身后的 happening, printed etc after someone’s death

es.e: a posthumous collection of his articles
es.c: 他身后出版的文集

d: n 小孔，刺孔 a small hole made accidentally in a tyre

es.e: She was cycling home when she had a puncture .
es.c: 她骑车回家途中轮胎被扎破了。

d: adj 国外来的(姑娘)帮助料理家务换取住宿的
adj 社团的；法人的；共同的 shared by or involving all the members of a group

es.e: corporate responsibility
es.c: 共同的责任

d: v 宣告，声明 to say publicly or officially that something important is true or exists

es.e: The President proclaimed the republic’s independence.
es.c: 总统宣布共和国独立。

d: n 名声，名誉 the state of being known about by a lot of people because of your achievements

es.e: He claims he is not really interested in fame.
es.c: 他称自己对出名真的没有兴趣。

d: n 小事，无价值的东西；少量的钱 something unimportant or not valuable

es.e: There’s no point in arguing over trifles.
es.c: 为琐事争吵毫无意义。

d: v 遍及，弥漫 if a feeling, idea, or smell pervades a place, it is present in every part of it

es.e: A spirit of hopelessness pervaded the country.
es.c: 一种无望的情绪笼罩着该国。

d: n 伤疤，伤痕，(喻)内心创伤 a permanent mark that is left on your skin after you have had a cut or wound

es.e: He had a long, curved scar on his right cheek.
es.c: 他的右脸上有一道弯弯的长疤。

es.e: a deep cut that could leave a permanent scar
es.c: 可能会留下永久性疤痕的一道很深的伤口

d: adj 无畏的，大胆的 a feeling or thought that is unconscious is one that you have without realizing it

es.e: She was found alive but unconscious.
es.c: 她被找到时还活着，但已不省人事。

d: v 调查，调查研究 to try to find out the truth about something such as a crime, accident, or scientific problem

es.e: The state police are investigating the incident.
es.c: 州警察正调查此事。

es.e: The study investigates the impact of violent TV programming on children.
es.c: 该研究调查暴力电视节目对儿童的影响。

es.e: I heard a noise and went downstairs to investigate.
es.c: 我听见响声，就下楼去看个究竟。

d: n (沙漠中的)绿洲 a place with water and trees in a desert

es.e: The immaculately tended gardens are an oasis in the midst of Cairo's urban sprawl.
es.c: 那些打理得非常整洁的花园是杂乱扩张的开罗市区中的一片绿洲。

d: adj 坚硬的；困难的；难忍的；严厉的；结实的 firm, stiff, and difficult to press down, break, or cut

es.e: a hard wooden chair
es.c: 一把硬木椅

es.e: the hardest substance known to man
es.c: 已知的最硬物质

es.e: After months without rain, the ground was too hard to plough.
es.c: 数月无雨，土地坚硬难犁。

d: adj 正(传)统的 orthodox ideas, methods, or behaviour are accepted by most people to be correct and right

es.e: orthodox medical treatments
es.c: 传统疗法

es.e: He challenged the orthodox views on education.
es.c: 他对传统的教育观念提出了质疑。

d: n (从火灾及其他灾难中)抢救财物救助 when you save things from a situation in which other things have already been damaged, destroyed, or lost

es.e: a massive salvage operation
es.c: 大规模的抢救行动

d: n 混乱，混同 when you do not understand what is happening or what something means because it is not clear

es.e: To avoid confusion, the teams wore different colours.
es.c: 为了避免混淆，各队穿着不同颜色的服装。

d: adj 异常的，优越的 unusually good

es.e: an exceptional student
es.c: 出类拔萃的学生

es.e: exceptional bravery
es.c: 非凡的勇气

d: n 干旱 a long period of dry weather when there is not enough water for plants and animals to live

es.e: ...a country where drought and famines have killed up to two million people during the last eighteen years.
es.c: …过去18年来干旱和饥荒致死达两百万人的一个国家。

d: adj 无效的，无意义的 an agreement, contract etc that is null and void has no legal force

es.e: The contract was declared null and void.
es.c: 该合同被宣布无效。

d: v (去)取，拿来；(货物)售的(价钱) If you fetch something or someone, you go and get them from the place where they are

es.e: Sylvia fetched a towel from the bathroom.
es.c: 西尔维娅从浴室拿来一条毛巾。

es.e: Fetch me a glass of water.
es.c: 给我拿杯水来。

d: v 上挽具；治理；利用 to control and use the natural force or power of something；n 挽具，降落伞背带 a set of leather bands used to control a horse or to attach it to a vehicle it is pulling

es.e: We can harness the power of the wind to generate electricity.
es.c: 我们可以利用风力发电。

d: adj 琐碎的，不重要的；平常的，平凡的

es.e: a trivial sum
es.c: 一笔极小的金额

d: v&n 减轻，放松，小心移置；舒适 feeling relaxed, especially in a situation in which people might feel a little nervous

es.e: They won with ease.
es.c: 他们轻松获胜。

d: v 供应，用家具装备房子 to put furniture and other things into a house or room

es.e: Having bought the house, they couldn’t afford to furnish it.
es.c: 买下房子后，他们没有钱买家具了。

d: n 随身用品；贴身用品 You can refer to a large number of objects that someone has with them or that are connected with a particular activity as paraphernalia

es.e: ...a large courtyard full of builders' paraphernalia.
es.c: …一个充满建筑装备的大院子

d: n 广度，长度，程度
adj 起作用的，有助于，乐器的 instrumental music is for instruments, not for voices

es.e: He was instrumental in developing links with European organizations.
es.c: 他在建立与欧洲各组织之间的联系中起了重要作用。

d: adj 要价过高的，过分的 an exorbitant price, amount of money etc is much higher than it should be

es.e: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.
es.c: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。

d: adj 易燃的，可燃的 able to burn easily；n 易燃物，可燃物

es.e: The ability of coal to release a combustible gas has long been known.
es.c: 煤能够释放易燃气体这一点早已为人所知。

d: n 住址；致词 the details of the place where someone lives or works, which you use to send them letters etc；v 向致词；在信封上写姓名 if you address an envelope, package etc, you write on it the name and address of the person you are send

es.e: What’s your new address?
es.c: 你的新地址是什么？

es.e: I can give you the address of a good attorney.
es.c: 我可以给你一个好律师的地址。

d: n 旧货，假货；v 把(当废物)丢弃 to get rid of something because it is old or useless

es.e: Consumers will not have to junk their old cassettes to use the new format.
es.c: 消费者们将不必为了使用新制式而丢掉他们的老盒式磁带。

d: n 名誉，名声 the opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past

es.e: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
es.c: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

d: v 阻塞，堵塞；妨碍 to block a road, passage etc

es.e: A small aircraft was obstructing the runway.
es.c: 一架小型飞机堵住了跑道。

es.e: The column obstructed our view of the stage.
es.c: 柱子挡着，我们看不见舞台。

d: n 围栏；附件 something that is put inside an envelope with a letter

es.e: the enclosure of arable land for pasture
es.c: 将耕地圈起来用作牧场

d: n 电信，电信学 the telegraphic or telephonic communication of audio, video, or digital information over a distance by means of radio waves, optical signals, etc, or along a transmission line

es.e: If large media and telecommunication companies decide to close their offerings to the web, I am convinced the web will route around it.
es.c: 如果大型媒体和电信公司决定停止向万维网提供内容，我很确信万维网会绕过这一点。

d: n 保管人，监护人；公共建筑看守 someone who is responsible for looking after something important or valuable

es.e: a custodian at the stadium
es.c: 体育场看门人

d: v 深思，仔细思考 to think seriously and deeply about something

es.e: On the day her son began school, she meditated on the uncertainties of his future.
es.c: 在她儿子入学那天，她深思了有关他未来的种种不确定因素。

d: v (以誓言或契约等)束缚某人；施惠

es.e: It’s always a good idea to oblige important clients.
es.c: 能满足重要客户的请求总是好的。

d: prep [略作v或vs](诉讼或比赛中)对 used to show that two people or teams are competing against each other in a game or court case

es.e: the New York Knicks versus the LA Lakers
es.c: 纽约尼克斯队对洛杉矶湖人队

es.e: the Supreme Court decision in Roe vs. Wade
es.c: 最高法院关于罗诉韦德案的判决

d: n 胆怯

es.e: They mocked at my timidity.
es.c: 他们耻笑我胆小。

es.e: In this, the politicians display not only their own timidity but also the mood of many voters.
es.c: 在这个问题上，政要们不仅展现他们的胆小，还有许多民众的不满情绪。

es.e: Anyone who does otherwise, either out of timidity or because of bad advice, is always obliged to keep his knife in his hand.
es.c: 任何不这样做的人，或出于胆怯，或由于接受了拙劣的建议，总是被迫一直把屠刀提在手中。

d: adj (液体)易挥发的；(人)反复无常的 a volatile liquid or substance changes easily into a gas

es.e: an increasingly volatile political situation
es.c: 日益动荡的政治局势

d: adj 义愤的，愤慨的 angry and surprised because you feel insulted or unfairly treated

es.e: an indignant reply
es.c: 愤慨的回复

d: n&v 海豹；封蜡，封印；印记 a large sea animal that eats fish and lives around coasts

es.e: The window was sealed shut.
es.c: 这扇窗户被封了起来。

d: adj 主权的；最高的 having the highest power in a country

es.e: Lithuania and Armenia signed a treaty in Vilnius recognizing each other as independent sovereign states.
es.c: 立陶宛和亚美尼亚在维尔纽斯签订了一份互相承认各自为独立主权国家的协定。

d: adj 漂亮的，逗人喜爱的 very pretty or attractive

es.e: a cute little puppy
es.c: 一只逗人爱的小狗

es.e: The baby’s so cute.
es.c: 这婴儿真可爱。

es.e: That’s a really cute outfit.
es.c: 那套衣服真漂亮。

d: n 航行；驾驶 the science or job of planning which way you need to go when you are travelling from one place to another

es.e: compasses and other instruments of navigation
es.c: 罗盘及其他导航仪器

d: n&vt (使)震惊 if something that happens is a shock, you did not expect it, and it makes you feel very surprised, and usually upset

es.c: 她又是震惊，又是羞辱，身体直发抖。

es.c: 我的工资直接存入我的银行账户。

es.c: 我在巴克莱银行开了一个账户。

es.e: My husband and I have a joint account (=  one that is shared between two people  ) .
es.c: 我和丈夫有个联名账户。

d: n (自来水、煤气等)总管道，干线 a large pipe or wire carrying the public supply of water, electricity, or gas

es.c: 报告中说约克郡的很多自来水总管道需要更换。

es.c: 破裂的煤气总管道

d: n 全部剧目，全部节目 all the plays, pieces of music etc that a performer or group knows and can perform

es.e: the behavioural repertoire of infants
es.c: 婴幼儿的行为能力

d: adj 空的，空虚的

es.e: Her eyes were void of all expression.
es.c: 她的眼神一片茫然。

d: prep 关于 a word used especially in letters or speeches to introduce the subject you are writing or talking about

es.c: 关于你最近的咨询，我随信附上一本我们最新的手册。

d: n 合同，契约 an official agreement between two or more people, stating what each will do；v 缔结；负债；感染；使皱缩 to get an illness

es.c: 员工拒绝调动岗位是违反合约的。

es.c: 巴尼特急需钱来解决他的经济问题。

es.c: 品行端正的男子

es.c: 休认为自己品行非常端正，因为她既不喝酒也不抽烟。

d: adj 难以置信的，惊人的 too strange to be believed, or very difficult to believe

es.c: 他跌下去竟然能够生还，真不可思议。

es.c: 自从遇见萨莉后，汤姆的变化之大简直令人难以置信。

es.c: 没人发现这些错误，真让我无法相信。

d: v 赔偿，补偿 to replace or balance the effect of something bad

es.c: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

d: adj 歇斯底里的, 狂热的 unable to control your behaviour or emotions because you are very upset, afraid, excited etc

es.e: Janet became hysterical and began screaming.
es.c: 珍妮特歇斯底里起来，开始尖叫。

es.e: Everyone in the studio burst into hysterical laughter .
es.c: 演播室里的每个人都爆发出一阵狂笑。

d: vt&n 紧抱，拥抱 to put your arms around someone and hold them tightly to show love or friendship

es.c: 我们站在那里哭着互相拥抱。

es.e: She went to her daughter and hugged her tightly .
es.c: 她走到女儿身边，紧紧地拥抱她。

d: v 居住于 if animals or people inhabit an area or place, they live there

es.e: The woods are inhabited by many wild animals.
es.c: 很多野生动物栖居在这片森林里。

es.e: inhabited islands
es.c: 有人居住的岛屿

d: n 镊子 a small tool that has two narrow pieces of metal joined at one end, used to pull or move very small objects

es.c: 她正拿着一把小镊子在拔眉毛。

d: v 监督，监管 to be in charge of a group of workers and check that a piece of work is done satisfactorily

es.e: A team leader was appointed to oversee the project.
es.c: 任命了一位组长来监管该工程。

d: adj 侧面的；旁边的 relating to the sides of something, or movement to the side

es.e: The wall is weak and requires lateral support.
es.c: 墙体不坚固，需要从侧面加以支撑。

d: n 卷轴; 纸卷 a long piece of paper that can be rolled up, and is used as an official document

es.e: Ancient scrolls were found in caves by the Dead Sea.
es.c: 在死海边的洞穴里发现了古代的卷轴。

d: n 开始，开端 at or from the beginning of an event or process

es.e: It was clear from the outset that there were going to be problems.
es.c: 从一开始就很清楚会有问题出现的。

es.e: It’s better to get something in writing right at the outset.
es.c: 最好一开始就有个书面的东西。

d: n (公共场所存衣帽的)小橱柜 A locker is a small metal or wooden cabinet with a lock, where you can put your personal possessions, for example in a school, place of work, or sports club

es.e: a meat locker
es.c: 肉类冷藏间

d: adj 帝国的，皇帝的 relating to an empire or to the person who rules it

es.e: Britain’s imperial expansion in the 19th century
es.c: 19世纪英帝国的扩张

d: n 保养费，维修费 the process of keeping something in good condition

es.e: Poorer people find it hard to pay for their pet’s upkeep.
es.c: 经济不宽裕的人难以负担养宠物的开销。

d: adj 自愿的，志愿的；有意的 done willingly and without being forced

es.e: Workers are being encouraged to take voluntary redundancy.
es.c: 工人被鼓励主动离职。

d: adj 无情的，不仁慈的，残酷的 strict, cruel, or determined, without ever stopping

es.c: 她要成功的坚定决心

es.c: 无情迫害持不同政见者的政权

d: vi&n 滑动，滑翔 to move smoothly and quietly, as if without effort

es.c: 侍者们托着一盘盘的意大利面食在拥挤的餐桌间自如穿行。

d: adj 壮丽的，辉煌的 beautiful and impressive

es.c: 所有的房间都能看到漂亮的景致。

es.e: a splendid cathedral
es.c: 宏伟的大教堂

d: n 怪诞的思想、行动或事件；畸形的 someone who is considered to be very strange because of the way they look, behave, or think

es.c: 我戴这副眼镜看上去像个怪人。

d: adj 精力充沛的；动力的 full of energy and new ideas, and determined to succeed；n (pl)力学，动力学 something that causes action or change

es.c: 精力充沛且雄心勃勃的人

d: adj 主要的，基本的 very important or basic；n 深红色；基数 a  cardinal number

es.c: 双手洁净是准备食物时的一项最基本要求。

es.e: an issue of cardinal importance
es.c: 至关重要的问题

d: n 鞋带；花边 a fine cloth made with patterns of many very small holes

es.c: 饰有蕾丝花边的手绢

es.e: lace curtains
es.c: 网眼窗帘

es.c: 她的尸体被发现丢在离她家不到一英里的一座废弃的仓库里。

d: adj 能活的，能生存的 able to continue to live or to develop into a living thing

es.c: 可存活的种子

d: v 后退；向后倾斜

es.c: 她有预言的天赋。

es.c: 那次晋升确实增强了她的自信心。

d: adj 肌肉的；肌肉发达的 having large strong muscles

es.c: 她动作敏捷，身体强壮，身材苗条，肌肉结实。

es.c: 他很强壮。

d: a&n 外部的；外来的，外表 the outside of something, especially a building

es.c: 穹顶表面铺了瓦片。

d: v 提供住宿；使适应 to provide someone with a place to stay, live, or work

es.e: The island was used to accommodate child refugees.
es.c: 该岛用于收容儿童难民。

d: v 违犯，侵犯 to disobey or do something against an official agreement, law, principle etc

es.c: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

es.c: 侵犯人权的政权

d: adj 妒忌的；妒羡的 feeling unhappy because someone has something that you wish you had

es.c: 他们决定向该报提起法律诉讼。

es.e: The posts have to be set in concrete.
es.c: 这些柱子必须固定在混凝土中。

es.c: 全国各地日益动荡不安。

es.e: We need to apply for planning permission to build a garage.
es.c: 我们建车库需要申请规划许可。

d: n 大灾难，浩劫 a situation in which there is a lot of damage or a lack of order, especially so that it is difficult for something to continue in the normal way

es.c: 会危害该国经济的政策

es.e: Rain has continued to play havoc with sporting events.
es.c: 下雨一直影响着体育比赛的进行。

d: n 招贴画，广告；广告画 a large printed notice, picture, or photograph, used to advertise something or as a decoration

es.e: A team of volunteers were putting up posters .
es.c: 一队志愿者正在张贴海报。

es.e: a poster campaign for the election
es.c: 选举的海报宣传

es.c: 桨叶和她包的带子紧紧缠在了一起。

es.c: 厌食症患者会在暴饮暴食之后服用泻药或者把吃下去的东西呕吐出来。

es.e: Dozens of companies, including Hewlett-Packard, are sponsoring the event.
es.c: 包括惠普在内的许多公司都在赞助这项赛事。

d: n 标题；题目；称号；法律权利，所有权 the name given to a particular book, painting, play etc

es.c: 《耐心与萨拉》于1969年以《我们的地方》为书名首次出版。

d: n 汽锅，汽船，轮船 a  steamship

es.c: 研究者们对这个提议报以轻蔑的态度。

es.c: 政治上的保守

es.c: …一部百老汇歌舞剧的试演。

d: n 草地 a field with wild grass and flowers

es.c: 那片草地已用犁翻过。

es.e: There are many lambs capering in the meadow.
es.c: 很多小羊在草地上蹦蹦跳跳。

d: v 纵容，娇惯 to look after someone very kindly, for example by giving them the things that they want and making them feel warm and comfortable

es.c: 她出身于一个富裕家庭，从小娇生惯养。

d: n 备忘录；便函 a  memo

es.c: …一份来自国防部的有关其角色的备忘录。

d: adj 不愿意的，勉强的 slow and unwilling

es.c: 她勉强笑了笑。

d: adj 褴褛的，外形参差不齐的 wearing clothes that are old and torn

es.c: 一群群破衣烂衫的孩子在岩石间玩耍。

d: n (动物)触角 one of the long thin parts of a sea creature such as an  octopus  which it uses for holding things

es.c: 言论自由正被政府控制的新触角逐渐侵蚀。

d: adj 领土的，领地的 related to land that is owned or controlled by a particular country

es.c: 领土争端

es.e: territorial claims

d: n 集邮册；相片册 a book that you put photographs, stamps etc in

es.c: 相册

es.c: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

es.c: 恢复中东和平的倡议

es.c: 他蹑手蹑脚地回楼上，尽量避开那些嘎吱作响的梯级。

es.e: I’m going to show you how to make a box for your tools.
es.c: 我来教你怎么做一个箱子存放工具。

es.c: 你很容易就会喜欢上工作中接触到的孩子。

d: n 星系；一群人 one of the large groups of stars that make up the universe

es.c: 天文学家们发现了一个遥远的星系。

es.c: 那位医生过去曾碰到过好几个类似病例。

es.c: 安德鲁没有用多长时间就整理好了手提箱。

d: n 分隔栏；售货摊；前排座位 a table or a small shop with an open front, especially outdoors, where goods are sold

es.c: 市场摊位

es.c: 10名员工被分派做这项任务。

es.c: 这条新法规将削弱警方的权力。

es.c: “但我该怎么办呢？”伯纳德哭喊道。

d: adv 借以，从而

es.e: However, doing so would dramatically expand the message payload of the service, thereby possibly impacting its performance profile.
es.c: 然而，这样做会显著扩展该服务的消息有效负载，从而可能影响其性能状况。

es.c: 我认为这本书非常一般。

es.e: a mediocre student
es.c: 能力一般的学生

d: n 深谷，山谷 an area of lower land between two lines of hills or mountains, usually with a river flowing through it

es.c: 圣费尔南多山谷

d: n 容忍；宽恕 willingness to allow people to do, say, or believe what they want without criticizing or punishing them

es.c: …他对各种人性的宽容和理解。

d: adj 有名望的，声誉鹊起的 known and admired by a lot of people, especially for a special skill, achievement, or quality

es.c: 这个地区以其罗马式教堂闻名。

d: n 阴谋，同谋 a secret plan made by two or more people to do something that is harmful or illegal

es.c: 围绕戴安娜王妃之死有许多阴谋论。

d: n 礼仪，礼节；外交礼节 a system of rules about the correct way to behave on an official occasion

es.e: a breach of diplomatic protocol
es.c: 违反外交礼节

d: n&vi 野餐 if you have a picnic, you take food and eat it outdoors, especially in the country

es.c: 我们决定在湖边野餐。

es.e: a picnic table
es.c: 野餐桌

es.e: There is free parking for visitors, as well as a restaurant and picnic area (= a special area with tables where people can have a picnic ) .
es.c: 除了餐厅和野餐区，我们还为游客提供免费停车位。

d: v 眩目，耀眼 if a very bright light dazzles you, it stops you from seeing properly for a short time

es.e: a deer dazzled by the headlights
es.c: 被车头灯光照得目眩的鹿

d: n 营养不良 when someone becomes ill or weak because they have not eaten enough good food

es.c: 营养不良的难民

d: n 困境; 苦境 a very bad situation that someone is in

es.c: 该国的经济困境

es.c: …一种品牌的清洁剂。

d: v 占用；吸引 if something engrosses you, it interests you so much that you do not notice anything else

es.c: 景色非常美丽，一时间把我们都完全吸引住了。

es.c: 乐谱

es.c: 我希望他不要再问令人难堪的问题。

es.c: 她不知道是该跟他握手还是亲他的脸颊，一时很尴尬。

d: v 保护；保存 to save something or someone from being harmed or destroyed

es.e: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
es.c: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

es.c: 一人说，目前正在进行的部分金融服务管理局调查有望在未来六个月完成。

es.c: 孩子们知道，如果调皮捣蛋的话就会挨藤条。
