es.e: He stopped, shifting his cane to his left hand.
es.c: 他停下来，把手杖移到左手。

d: n 税制，税项 the system of charging taxes

es.e: the government’s economic and taxation policy
es.c: 政府的经济和税收政策

d: vt&n 拖；拉 to pull a vehicle or ship along behind another vehicle, using a rope or chain

es.e: The ship had to be towed into the harbor.
es.c: 那艘轮船不得不被拖进港口。

d: adj 可靠的，可信赖的 someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or depended on

es.e: a birth control method that is cheap and reliable
es.c: 既便宜又可靠的避孕方法

es.e: Miller was a quiet and reliable man.
es.c: 米勒是个话不多且可靠的人。

d: adj 灵巧的，熟练的 a deft movement is skilful, and often quick

es.e: He sketched her with quick, deft strokes.
es.c: 他给她画素描，下笔又快又熟练。

es.e: deft footwork
es.c: 敏捷的步法

d: n (药等的)一服；一剂 A potion is a drink that contains medicine, poison, or something that is supposed to have magic powers

es.e: ...a magic potion that will make Siegfried forget Brunnhilde and fall in love with Gutrune.
es.c: …一种会使齐格弗里德忘掉布伦希德尔德而爱上古特鲁内娜的魔剂。

d: n&vt 弄乱，扰乱 the state of being untidy or not organized

es.e: The nation is in disarray following rioting led by the military.
es.c: 该国发生由军队发动的暴乱后，陷入一片混乱。

d: adj 包括一切的，全部的 considering or including everything；n 罩衫，工装裤 a loose-fitting piece of clothing like a coat, that is worn over clothes to protect them

es.e: The overall cost of the exhibition was £400,000.
es.c: 展览会的全部费用是40万英镑。

es.e: The overall result is an increase in population.
es.c: 总的结果是人口增加。

es.e: An overall winner and a runner-up were chosen.
es.c: 总冠军和第二名被选了出来。

d: n 资源；机智 something such as useful land, or minerals such as oil or coal, that exists in a country and can be used to increase its wealth

es.e: Canada’s vast mineral resources
es.c: 加拿大丰富的矿产资源

es.e: a country rich in natural resources
es.c: 自然资源丰富的国家

d: n 生物的种；种类 a group of animals or plants whose members are similar and can breed together to produce young animals or plants

es.e: Seven species of birds of prey have been observed.
es.c: 已有七种猛禽被观察到。

es.e: pandas and other endangered species
es.c: 熊猫以及其他濒危物种

d: n 月台，站台；讲台；(政党的)政纲，党纲 the raised place beside a railway track where you get on and off a train in a station

es.e: The Edinburgh train will depart from platform six.
es.c: 开往爱丁堡的火车将从六号站台发车。

d: adj 弹性的，有伸缩性的 a material that is elastic can stretch and then go back to its usual length or size；n 橡皮圈

es.e: the horny elastic pad in a horse’s hoof
es.c: 马蹄上粗硬而有弹性的肉掌

d: n 租赁；租期 the period of time that someone rents a house, land etc

es.e: a six-month tenancy
es.c: 六个月的租赁期

es.e: a tenancy agreement
es.c: 租赁合同

d: adj 最小的；最低限度的 very small in degree or amount, especially the smallest degree or amount possible

es.e: The storm caused only minimal damage.
es.c: 暴风雨只造成了轻微破坏。

es.e: The cost to taxpayers would be minimal.
es.c: 纳税人的支出将是最少的。

es.e: This is a practical course, with only a minimal amount of theory.
es.c: 这是实践课程，只有少量理论。

d: adj 不可避免的，照例必有的 certain to happen and impossible to avoid

es.e: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.
es.c: 危机的进一步升级现在看来已不可避免。

d: v 反驳，否认，同矛盾 to disagree with something, especially by saying that the opposite is true

es.e: Deborah opened her mouth to contradict, but closed it again.
es.c: 黛博拉张口想要反驳，但又把嘴闭上了。

es.e: Dad just can’t bear to be contradicted.
es.c: 爸爸就是受不了有人反驳他。

es.e: The article flatly contradicts their claims.
es.c: 这篇文章断然驳斥他们的说法。

d: n 补助金；津贴费 money that is paid by a government or organization to make prices lower, reduce the cost of producing goods etc

es.e: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
es.c: 欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

d: vi&n 熊熊燃烧，突然燃烧，火光 to suddenly begin to burn, or to burn more brightly for a short time；v&n 张开 if a person or animal flares their  nostril s (= the openings at the end of the nose )  , or if their nostrils flare, their no

es.e: The fire flared up again.
es.c: 火又忽地旺了起来。

d: v 消化；领会，融会贯通 to change food that you have just eaten into substances that your body can use；n 文摘，摘要 a short piece of writing that gives the most important facts from a book, report etc

es.e: Most babies can digest a wide range of food easily.
es.c: 大多数婴儿能轻易地消化很多种食物。

d: n&v 喧闹，嘈杂 a loud unpleasant noise that continues for a long time

es.e: They tried to make themselves heard over the din of the crowd.
es.c: 他们竭力让自己的声音盖过人群的喧闹声。

d: n 鱼群 a large group of fish swimming together

es.e: Among them swam shoals of fish.
es.c: 在他们之中游动着一群群鱼儿。

d: adj 急速的；匆促的 done in a hurry, especially with bad results

es.e: He soon regretted his hasty decision.
es.c: 他很快就对自己仓促作出的决定感到后悔了。

es.e: a hasty breakfast
es.c: 匆忙吃下的一顿早餐

d: v 使绝缘，使绝热，隔离 to cover or protect something with a material that stops electricity, sound, heat etc from getting in or out

es.e: an insulated attic
es.c: 隔热[隔音]的阁楼

d: n 殖民地；侨民 a country or area that is under the political control of a more powerful country, usually one that is far away

es.e: Algeria was formerly a French colony.
es.c: 阿尔及利亚以前是法国的殖民地。

d: vi&vt 悔悟，后悔 to be sorry for something and wish you had not done it – used especially when considering your actions in a religious way

es.e: Those who refuse to repent, he said, will be punished.
es.c: 他说，那些不肯悔悟的人将受到惩罚。

d: n 幻象，错觉 an idea or opinion that is wrong, especially about yourself

es.e: She was under no illusion that he loved her.
es.c: 她不再幻想他爱她了。

es.e: It is an illusion that the Arctic is dark in winter.
es.c: 认为北极冬天一片黑暗是错误的。

es.e: She had no illusions about her physical attractiveness.
es.c: 她对自己外表的吸引力不抱幻想。

d: n 登记，入学 the process of arranging to join a school, university, course etc

es.e: Enrolment will take place in September.
es.c: 注册将于9月进行。

d: n 混乱，纷乱 a situation in which everything is happening in a confused way and nothing is organized or arranged in order

es.e: The country was plunged into economic chaos.
es.c: 这个国家陷入了经济大混乱。

d: v 消瘦，衰弱；n 松树 a tall tree with long hard sharp leaves that do not fall off in winter

es.e: an ancient pine forest
es.c: 一片古老的松树林

d: v 给输血

es.e: There are no rules about when to transfuse and who to do it to.
es.c: 从来没有相关规定，在什么时候什么人应该被输血。

es.e: Whether you can transfuse your blood to him depends on whether your blood type matches his.
es.c: 你是否可以给他输血要看你的血型与他的血型是否想配。

es.e: They are the only medevac service to have doctors on board able to transfuse blood while in the air, and they use some of the most innovative techniques in the field.
es.c: 他们在唯一的救伤直升机上给伤员输血，在战地条件下运用一些最新的技术来救治伤员。

d: adj 喜剧的，滑稽的n连环漫画杂志；喜剧演员 amusing you and making you want to laugh

es.e: a comic novel
es.c: 滑稽小说

d: adj 传染的；感染性的 an infectious illness can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air you breathe

es.e: infectious diseases
es.c: 传染性疾病

es.e: Flu is highly infectious.
es.c: 流感传染性很强。

d: adj 有倾向的；可能遭受的；有责任的 legally responsible for the cost of something

es.e: The car is liable to overheat on long trips.
es.c: 这辆汽车跑长途容易过热。

d: adj 合成的，复合的 made up of different parts or materials

es.e: The author builds up a useful compo-site picture of contemporary consumer culture.
es.c: 作者勾勒出了一幅实用的当代消费文化全景图。

es.e: composite metals
es.c: 复合金属

d: n (嘴唇上面的)胡子 hair that grows on a man’s upper lip

es.e: He’s shaved off his moustache.
es.c: 他剃去了小胡子。

d: v 使认识；使熟悉

es.e: I need to acquaint myself with the new regulations.
es.c: 我得熟悉一下新的规章制度。

d: v 贴近，与毗连

es.e: A vacant plot of land adjoins his house.
es.c: 有一块空地紧挨着他家。

d: n 球，球面；天体；(兴趣,活动,势力等)范围 " a ball shape

es.e: Because the earth spins, it is not a perfect sphere.
es.c: 因为地球旋转，所以它不是个完完全全的球体。

d: n 轶事，趣闻 a short story based on your personal experience

es.e: The book is full of amusing anecdotes about his life in Japan.
es.c: 这本书里全是他在日本生活的趣闻轶事。

d: n 分隔间；火车车厢的分隔间 a smaller enclosed space inside something larger

es.e: The bag is divided into separate compartments .
es.c: 这个包有一些独立的隔层。

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["engine compartment"]}
es.c: 发动机室

es.e: She kept the money hidden in a secret compartment in her briefcase.
es.c: 她把钱藏在公文包的暗层里。

d: adj 耐用的 staying in good condition for a long time, even if used a lot；n 耐用品

es.e: Wood is a durable material.
es.c: 木头是耐用材料。

d: v&n 嗥叫；轰鸣；咆哮着说 Growl is also a noun

es.e: Their noise modulated to a concerted menacing growl punctuated by sharp yaps.
es.c: 它们的喧闹声逐渐变为整齐划一的、带有威胁性的吼叫，还夹杂着刺耳的狂吠。

d: v (使)服从；提交 to give a plan, piece of writing etc to someone in authority for them to consider or approve

es.e: In desperation, Mrs. Jones submitted to an operation on her right knee to relieve the pain.
es.c: 绝望中，琼斯夫人不得已接受了一次她右膝的手术以减轻疼痛。

d: adj 傲慢的，自负的 behaving in an unpleasant or rude way because you think you are more important than other people

es.e: He was unbearably arrogant.
es.c: 他的傲慢让人无法忍受。

es.e: an arrogant attitude
es.c: 傲慢的态度

d: v 迫害；烦扰 to treat someone cruelly or unfairly over a period of time, especially because of their religious or political beliefs

es.e: The Puritans left England to escape being persecuted.
es.c: 清教徒离开了英国以躲避迫害。

d: n 狭缝；槽沟 a long narrow hole in a surface, that you can put something into

es.e: Alan dropped another quarter into the slot on the pay phone.
es.c: 艾伦往付费电话的投币口里又塞了一枚 25 分的硬币。

d: n 通路 the way you use to enter a building or reach a place

es.e: Access is by means of a small door on the right.
es.c: 入口是右边的一扇小门。

d: adj 地球上的，陆地的 relating to the Earth rather than to the moon or other  planets

es.e: ...terrestrial life forms.
es.c: …地球上的生命形态。

d: n 火山口; 弹坑 a round hole in the ground made by something that has fallen on it or by an explosion

es.e: craters on the moon’s surface
es.c: 月球表面的坑

d: v 指控；控告；冲锋；要价；充电 to state officially that someone may be guilty of a crime

es.e: Even local nurseries charge $150 a week.
es.c: 即便当地的托儿所每周也要收$150的费用。

d: n&vt 养育，培育，教养 to feed and take care of a child or a plant while it is growing

es.e: plants nurtured in the greenhouse
es.c: 在温室里培育的植物

d: v&n 溅水，泼水；显示，鼓吹 If you splash around or splash about in water, you hit or disturb the water in a noisy way, causing some of it to fly up into the air

es.e: A lot of people were in the water, swimming or simply splashing about.
es.c: 很多人在水里游泳或者只是戏水。

es.e: She could hear the voices of her friends as they splashed in a nearby rock pool.
es.c: 她能听到她的朋友们在附近的岩石泳池里戏水的声音。

d: adj 谦让的，适度的；有礼貌的 A modest house or other building is not large or expensive

es.e: They had spent the night at a modest hotel.
es.c: 他们在一家普通的旅馆过夜。

d: n 灵感，鼓舞人心的人或事，好主意 a good idea about what you should do, write, say etc, especially one which you get suddenly

es.e: The Malvern Hills have provided inspiration for many artists and musicians over the decades.
es.c: 几十年来，莫尔文丘陵为很多艺术家和音乐家提供了灵感。

es.e: He raised his eyes to the altar as if seeking inspiration.
es.c: 他抬头看看祭坛，似乎在寻求灵感。

es.e: He draws inspiration from ordinary scenes.
es.c: 他从日常生活中得到灵感。

d: adv 无疑地 used when saying that something is almost certain to happen or be true

es.e: Doubtless there would be lots of rumours.
es.c: 无疑会谣言四起。

d: n 描述，译文；说法 someone’s version of an event is their description of it, when this is different from the description given by another person

es.e: Could Donna’s version of what happened that night be correct?
es.c: 唐娜对那晚发生的事情的描述是否正确呢？

d: adj 懈怠的；萧条的；呆滞的；松驰的；不紧的 hanging loosely, or not pulled tight

es.e: Keep the rope slack until I tell you to pull it.
es.c: 让绳子松着，直到我叫你拉紧。

d: v (使)相关联 if two or more facts, ideas etc correlate or if you correlate them, they are closely connected to each other or one causes the other

es.e: Attempts to correlate specific language functions with particular parts of the brain have not advanced very far.
es.c: 试图把特定的语言功能和大脑特定区域相联系的努力还没有取得很大进展。

d: v 洪水退落；土地下沉；建筑物沉降 if a building or an area of land subsides, it gradually sinks to a lower level

es.e: After the heavy rains, part of the road subsided.
es.c: 大雨过后，部分路面塌陷了。

d: n 捐款，捐赠 something, especially money, that you give to a person or an organ-ization in order to help them

es.e: There have been generous donations from EU funds.
es.c: 欧盟基金给予了慷慨的捐款。

d: v&n 感觉，摸，感知；同情 to give you a particular physical feeling, especially when you touch or hold something

es.e: It’s nice fabric - it feels like velvet.
es.c: 面料不错——摸上去像丝绒。

d: n 海上掠夺；侵犯版权
v 摆动，振动；踌躇，犹豫 to keep changing between one feeling or attitude and another

es.e: The stock market is oscillating wildly at the moment.
es.c: 股票市场现在正急剧波动。

d: n 标准，规范 the usual or normal situation, way of doing something etc

es.e: Joyce’s style of writing was a striking departure from the literary norm.
es.c: 乔伊斯的写作风格与传统的文学风格大相径庭。

d: v 踩，践踏；蔑视，粗暴对待 to step heavily on something, so that you crush it with your feet

es.e: Their in-terests and rights had been trampled underfoot .
es.c: 他们的利益和权利都被踩在了脚下。

d: n 敬意，赞扬；问候 used by a person or company when they send or give something to you；v 恭维；称赞 to say something nice to someone in order to praise them

es.e: With the compliments of J. Smith & Son. J.
es.c: 史密斯父子公司敬赠。

es.e: Please accept these tickets with our compliments.
es.c: 赠票若干，敬请笑纳。

d: adj 真正的，名副其实的 a genuine feeling, desire etc is one that you really feel, not one you pretend to feel

es.e: ‘Did he really?’ Her surprise seemed genuine.
es.c: “他真的这样？”她好像是真的惊讶。

d: adj 颜色鲜艳的;奇特的n&v想象力,设想,爱好 fancy food is of a high quality

es.e: Harry took me to a fancy restaurant for our anniversary.
es.c: 哈里带我去了一家豪华餐厅，庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

d: v 增大，增加 to increase the value, amount, effectiveness etc of something

es.e: Any surplus was sold to augment their income.
es.c: 所有多余的东西被售卖一空来增加他们的收入。

d: adj 漂亮的；聪明的；轻快的 intelligent or sensible

es.e: The smart kids get good grades and go off to college.
es.c: 聪明的孩子成绩好，可以去上大学。

es.e: I was smart enough to wait for a week.
es.c: 我很明智，等了一个星期。

es.e: His decision to become a director was a smart move (= sensible thing to do ) .
es.c: 他决定要做导演，这是明智之举。

d: adj 绚丽的 clothes, colours etc that are gaudy are too bright and look cheap – used to show disapproval

es.e: gaudy jewelry
es.c: 俗丽的珠宝

d: v 概括，归纳 to form a general principle or opinion after considering only a small number of facts or examples

es.e: Critics love to generalize, to formulate trends into which all new work must be fitted, however contradictory.
es.c: 评论家喜欢概括，归纳出所有新作品都必须符合的趋势，不管它们是如何地不符。

d: n 木工，木匠 someone whose job is making and repairing wooden objects

es.e: He is a carpenter by profession.
es.c: 他以木工为业。

es.e: At an early age, I was apprenticed to a carpenter.
es.c: 我小时候曾给木匠当过学徒。

es.e: That carpenter wanted to become a lawyer， but he was advised to stick to his last.
es.c: 那个木匠想当律师， 但别人劝他安分守己地干他自己的老本行。

d: adj 真挚的；诚恳的 a feeling, belief, or statement that is sincere is honest and true, and based on what you really feel and believe

es.e: Please accept my sincere apologies .
es.c: 请接受我真诚的道歉。

es.e: his sincere desire to find out the truth
es.c: 他想查明真相的真切愿望

d: vi&n (发)微光；少许，微量 a light that is not very bright

es.e: a weak glimmering light
es.c: 微弱的闪光

d: v 集合，检阅，集中 if soldiers muster, or if someone musters them, they come together in a group

es.e: In April 1185, he began to muster an army .
es.c: 1185年4月，他开始召集军队。

d: n 基因 a part of a cell in a living thing that controls what it looks like, how it grows, and how it develops. People get their genes from their parents

es.e: human genes
es.c: 人类基因

es.e: the genes that regulate cell division
es.c: 控制细胞分裂的基因

d: adj 破坏性的，毁灭性的 badly damaging or destroying something

es.e: It will be a devastating blow for the town if the factory closes.
es.c: 如果工厂关闭，对该镇来说将是沉重的打击。

d: v&n 法令，判决 an official order or decision, especially one made by the ruler of a country

es.e: The Emperor issued the decree repealing martial law.
es.c: 皇帝下诏令取消了军事管制。

d: n 水库；蓄水池 a lake, especially an artificial one, where water is stored before it is supplied to people’s houses

es.e: All these earthquakes happened when the water level in Zipingpu reservoir was low.
es.c: 所有这些地震都发生在紫坪铺水库水位很低的时候。

d: v 使受危害，使陷险境 To jeopardize a situation or activity means to do something that may destroy it or cause it to fail

es.e: He has jeopardized his future career.
es.c: 他损害了他的前程。

d: v 使不结果实；使绝育；使无效；杀菌 to make something completely clean by killing any  bacteria  in it

es.e: Sterilize the bottles with boiling water.
es.c: 用沸水把这些瓶子消毒。

es.e: sterilized milk
es.c: 消过毒的牛奶

es.e: sterilizing solution
es.c: 消毒溶液

d: n 僵局，僵局 a situation in which a disagreement cannot be settled

es.e: The talks have reached a complete deadlock .
es.c: 会谈完全陷入僵局。

es.e: a last-ditch effort to break the deadlock
es.c: 打破僵局的最后努力

es.e: Negotiations ended in deadlock.
es.c: 谈判最后陷入了僵局。

d: n 圣歌，赞美诗 a regularly repeated tune, often with many words sung on one note, especially used for religious prayers；v 唱，歌颂 to repeat a word or phrase again and again

es.e: ...a Gregorian chant.
es.c: …一首格列高利圣歌。

d: n&v 破裂 an occasion when something suddenly breaks apart or bursts

es.e: The pipe will rupture at its weakest point.
es.c: 管道最薄弱的地方会破裂的。

d: n 宗教仪式，典礼；仪式的程序 a ceremony that is always performed in the same way, in order to mark an important religious or social occasion；adj 仪式的 done as part of a rite or ritual

es.e: ancient pagan rituals
es.c: 古老的异教仪式

es.e: the importance of religion and ritual in our lives
es.c: 我们生活中宗教和宗教仪式的重要性

es.e: The lady of the house performs the sacred ritual of lighting two candles.
es.c: 由女主人来完成点燃两根蜡烛的神圣仪式。

d: n&vt 监狱，监禁
n 散页的印刷品，传单 a small book or piece of paper advertising something or giving information on a particular subject

es.e: Campaigners handed out leaflets on passive smoking.
es.c: 发起人分发了关于被动吸烟的传单。

d: adj 接着的，然后的 happening or coming after something else

es.e: These skills were passed on to subsequent generations.
es.c: 这些技能代代相传。

es.e: subsequent pages of the book
es.c: 接下去的书页

d: n 航空(学) the science or practice of flying in aircraft

es.e: ...the aviation industry.
es.c: …航空工业。

d: n 诈骗，骗子 the crime of deceiving people in order to gain something such as money or goods

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["electoral fraud"]}
es.c: 选举欺诈

es.e: She was found guilty of fraud.
es.c: 她被判犯有诈骗罪。

d: adj 最初的 happening at the beginning；n 人名的首字母 the first letter of someone’s first name；v 签名首字母于 to write your initials on a document to make it official or to show that you agree with something

es.e: an initial investment of £5,000
es.c: 5,000英镑的初始投资

es.e: The initial response has been encouraging.
es.c: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

d: v 擦掉，抹掉 to remove writing from paper

es.e: Some of the names had been accidentally erased.
es.c: 有几个名字无意中被擦掉了。

d: adv 迅速地；容易地 quickly and easily

es.e: Boats are readily available to visitors.
es.c: 游客可以很方便地租到船只。

es.e: The information is readily accessible on the Internet.
es.c: 这些信息在因特网上一查就能找到。

d: n 肢；翼；翅膀；大树枝 an arm or leg

es.e: She would be able to stretch out her cramped limbs and rest for a few hours.
es.c: 她将可以伸开蜷缩的四肢，休息几个小时。

d: n 薄荷；造币厂 a small plant with green leaves that have a fresh smell and taste and are used in cooking

es.e: new potatoes sprinkled with chopped mint
es.c: 撒上薄荷屑的嫩马铃薯

es.e: roast lamb with mint sauce
es.c: 配薄荷调味汁的烤羔羊肉

es.e: Decorate with a sprig of mint .
es.c: 用小薄荷枝装饰。

d: n 球场；声音的高低度；沥青；程度v投掷 a marked out area of ground on which a sport is played

es.e: He ran the length of the pitch and scored.
es.c: 他跑过全场，得分了。

d: n 柜台 the place where you pay or are served in a shop, bank, restaurant etc；v 反对，反击 to say something in order to try to prove that what someone said was not true or as a reply to something

es.e: He wondered if the girl behind the counter recognised him.
es.c: 他在想柜台后面的那个女孩是否认出了他。

d: v 奉献，供奉，题献(著作) to say at the beginning of a book or film, or before a piece of music, that it has been written, made, or performed for someone that you love or respect

es.e: She dedicated her first album to Woody Allen, who she says understands her obsession.
es.c: 她把她的第一张唱片献给伍迪·艾伦，她说艾伦理解她的痴迷。

d: v 为辩白；证明正确 to prove that someone or something is right or true

es.e: The decision to advertise has been vindicated by the fact that sales have grown.
es.c: 销售增长的事实证明做广告宣传的决定是正确的。

d: adj 当前的；通用的；流行的 happening or existing now；n 水流；气流 a continuous movement of water in a river, lake, or sea

es.e: the current President
es.c: 现任总统

es.e: In its current state, the car is worth £1,000.
es.c: 这辆车按现在的车况来看值1,000英镑。

d: v 夸耀，夸饰 to show your money, success, beauty etc so that other people notice it – used to show disapproval

es.e: The rich flaunted their wealth while the poor starved on the streets.
es.c: 富人摆阔，穷人却在大街上饿肚子。

d: n 议会，国会 the group of people who are elected to make a country’s laws and discuss important national affairs

es.e: They demanded a free parliament and press.
es.c: 他们要求议会自由和新闻自由。

d: n 载明，详述；规格，清单，说明书 a detailed instruction about how a car, building, piece of equipment etc should be made

es.e: The bolts met all the engineering specifications .
es.c: 这些螺栓符合所有的工程设计规格。

d: n 周年纪念 a date on which something special or important happened in a previous year

es.e: Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
es.c: 1月，杰克和金庆祝了他们的结婚20周年纪念日。

d: n 在当地居民家居住

es.e: You could live in a homestay.
es.c: 也可以住在当地人家中。

d: v 细看；浏览 to examine an area carefully but quickly, often because you are looking for a particular person or thing

es.e: He scanned the horizon, but there was no sign of the ship.
es.c: 他朝地平线处仔细眺望，但是找不到那艘船的踪影。

es.e: She scanned his face, looking for signs of what he was thinking.
es.c: 她端详着他的脸，想知道他在想些什么。

es.e: Video cameras scanned the car park.
es.c: 摄像机监视着停车场。

d: n 恩惠；优美；善意；饭前后祷告 a smooth way of moving that looks natural, relaxed, and attractive；v 使优美 to make a place or an object look more attractive

es.e: Lena moved with the grace of a dancer.
es.c: 莉娜走路姿势有着舞者般的优美。

d: v 引用，传讯；举例 to give the exact words of something that has been written, especially in order to support an opinion or prove an idea

es.e: The passage cited above is from a Robert Frost poem.
es.c: 以上的引文出自罗伯特•弗罗斯特的一首诗。

d: n 安静，平静
adj 严重的；严厉的，剧烈的 severe problems, injuries, illnesses etc are very bad or very serious

es.e: His injuries were quite severe.
es.c: 他的伤势很严重。

es.e: She’s suffering from severe depression.
es.c: 她患有严重的抑郁症。

es.e: The US faces severe economic problems.
es.c: 美国面临严重的经济问题。

d: n 超越；超过；暴行 more than a particular amount；adj 额外的，附加的 Excess is used to refer to additional amounts of money that need to be paid for services and activities that were not originally planned or taken into account

es.e: The car reached speeds in excess of 100 miles per hour.
es.c: 这辆汽车的时速超过了100英里。

es.e: Make sure that you don't have to pay expensive excess charges.
es.c: 确保你不需要支付昂贵的额外费用。

d: adj 考虑周到的；体谅别人的 Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people

es.e: I think he's the most charming, most considerate man I've ever known.
es.c: 我觉得他是我所认识的最有魅力、最体贴的男士。

d: v 歪曲，弄歪，曲解 to report something in a way that is not completely true or correct

es.e: His account was badly distorted by the press.
es.c: 他的话被报界严重歪曲。

d: n 尸体；被废弃的东西 the dead body of a person

es.e: The corpse was found by children playing in the woods.
es.c: 这具尸体是在林子里玩耍的孩子发现的。

d: n 实体；存在 something that exists as a single and complete unit

es.e: The mind exists as a separate entity.
es.c: 思想作为一个独立的实体存在。

es.e: Good design brings a house and garden together as a single entity.
es.c: 优秀的设计能把一所房子和花园合为一体。

d: v 漫游；迷路；离题 to walk away from where you are supposed to stay

es.e: Don’t let any of the kids wander off.
es.c: 不要让任何一个小孩走开去。

d: adj 厉害的，敏锐的，(疾病等)急性的 an acute illness or disease quickly becomes very serious

es.e: acute arthritis
es.c: 急性关节炎

d: adj 使人愉快的；美味的 extremely pleasant to taste or smell

es.e: Delectable smells rose from the kitchen.
es.c: 厨房里传来诱人的香味。

d: n 上下文，(事情)来龙去脉 the words that come just before and after a word or sentence and that help you understand its meaning

es.e: The meaning of ‘mad’ depends on its context. mad
es.c: 一词的意义要视上下文而定。

d: v 统治，支配，俯瞰，俯视 to control someone or something or to have more importance than other people or things

es.e: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
es.c: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。

es.e: New Orleans dominated throughout the game.
es.c: 新奥尔良队自始至终都控制着这场比赛。

es.e: Her loud voice totally dominated the conversation.
es.c: 她的大嗓门完全主导着这场谈话。

d: n 公路上的陆桥

es.e: On the flyover near Balintawak station, I peer down at a chessboard of tin roofs.
es.c: 在巴林塔瓦克火车站附近的一处立交桥上，我看见桥下如棋盘般的铁皮屋顶。

d: adj 古雅的；离奇的 unusual and attractive, especially in an old-fashioned way

es.e: a quaint little village in Yorkshire
es.c: 约克郡一个古色古香的小村庄

d: v 处理，处置，除去 to arrange things or put them in their places

es.e: Chinese vases are disposed around the gallery.
es.c: 中国花瓶摆放在展馆四周。

d: v 管理，控制；调整 to control an activity or process, especially by rules

es.e: strict rules regulating the use of chemicals in food
es.c: 限制化学品在食物中使用的严格规定

d: n&a 抗生素；抗菌的 a drug that is used to kill  bacteria  and cure infections

es.e: Your doctor may prescribe antibiotics.
es.c: 你的大夫可能会开抗生素。

d: n&vt 影响(力)，感化(力)，有影响的人或事 the power to affect the way someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks, without using direct force or orders

es.e: As a scientist, his influence was immense.
es.c: 身为一名科学家，他的影响力极大。

d: n 静脉，叶脉；(石头)纹理；矿脉 one of the tubes which carries blood to your heart from other parts of your body

es.e: the pulmonary vein
es.c: 肺静脉

es.e: She felt the blood racing through her veins as they kissed.
es.c: 他们接吻时她觉得热血沸腾。

d: n 缠住，被困扰；观念固执，死脑筋
n 资本，大写字母；首都 an important city where the main government of a country, state etc is；adj 可处死刑的 an offence that is punished by death

es.e: Washington D.C., the capital of the United States
es.c: 美国首都华盛顿特区

d: vt&vi 突然转向 to make a sudden sideways movement while moving forwards, usually in order to avoid hitting something

es.e: Drivers coming in the opposite direction swerved to avoid the bodies.
es.c: 从反方向过来的司机们突然转向以避开这些尸体。

d: n 残(剩)余 a small part of something that remains after the rest of it has been used, destroyed, or eaten

es.e: Beneath the present church were remnants of Roman flooring.
es.c: 在目前的这座教堂下面还有残余的古罗马地板。

d: vt&vi (使)倾斜 to move a part of your body, especially your head or chin, upwards or to the side；n 倾斜，斜坡 a movement or position in which one side of something is higher than the other

es.e: My mother tilted her head and smiled.
es.c: 我妈妈歪着头笑了。

es.e: Ned’s mouth tilted upwards slightly at the corners.
es.c: 内德的嘴角微微翘起。

d: n&v 穿过；经过 to come up to a particular place, person, or object and go past them

es.e: The crowd parted to let the truck pass.
es.c: 人群分开让卡车通过。

es.e: He gave me a smile as he passed.
es.c: 他经过时对我微笑了一下。

es.e: We passed a group of students outside the theatre.
es.c: 我们在戏院外从一群学生身旁经过。

d: adj 不透光的，不透明的 opaque glass or liquid is difficult to see through and often thick

es.e: a shower with an opaque glass door
es.c: 装有不透明玻璃门的淋浴间

d: n 威信，声望；(由于成功等而产生)显赫 the respect and admiration that someone or something gets because of their success or important position in society

es.e: The king wanted to enhance his prestige through war.
es.c: 国王想通过战争来提高自己的威信。

es.e: This little-known British firm has now gained considerable prestige .
es.c: 这家名不见经传的英国公司如今已经声名鹊起。

es.e: the personal prestige attached to owning a large property
es.c: 拥有大房子所带来的体面

d: n 悬崖，峭壁 a very steep side of a high rock, mountain, or cliff

es.e: A loose rock tumbled over the precipice.
es.c: 一块松动的岩石从悬崖上滚落下来。

d: n (尤指城市)郊区 the parts of a town or city that are furthest from the centre

es.e: Hours later we reached the outskirts of New York.
es.c: 数小时后我们到达了纽约市的外围地带。

d: n 拒绝 when you say firmly that you will not do, give, or accept something

es.e: Her country suffered through her refusal to accept change.
es.c: 她的国家因为她拒绝接受变革而受了害。

d: vt&vi 巡逻，巡查 to go around the different parts of an area or building at regular times to check that there is no trouble or danger

es.e: Armed guards patrolled the grounds.
es.c: 武装卫兵巡逻场地。

es.e: an area patrolled by special police units
es.c: 由特警部队巡逻的地区

d: rn 大使；授权代表 an important official who represents his or her government in a foreign country

es.e: ...the German ambassador to Poland.
es.c: …德国驻波兰大使。

d: n 阵雨；淋浴 a piece of equipment that you stand under to wash your whole body

es.e: Why does the phone always ring when I’m in the shower?
es.c: 为什么电话铃总是在我洗澡的时候响？

es.e: I’d like to use the shower if that’s all right.
es.c: 如果可以的话，我想用一下这里的淋浴。

es.e: The bathroom has a separate shower cubicle (= a shower in a separate part of the room ) .
es.c: 卫生间里有一个独立的淋浴间。

d: adj 破旧的，坍坏的 A building that is dilapidated is old and in a generally bad condition

es.e: ...an old dilapidated barn.
es.c: …一座破旧的谷仓。

d: n 描写，描绘，叙述 a piece of writing or speech that gives details about what someone or something is like

es.e: The booklet gives a brief description of each place.
es.c: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

es.e: Berlin sounds fascinating from your description.
es.c: 从你的描述来看，柏林是个迷人的城市。

d: n 无知，愚昧 lack of knowledge or information about something

es.e: Excuse my ignorance, but how does it actually work?
es.c: 请原谅我的无知，它究竟是如何运作的？

d: n 技术兵种；军团 a trained army unit made of two or more  divisions (= groups of soldiers )

es.e: the medical corps
es.c: 医疗部队

d: n 两栖动物；水陆两用飞机和车辆 an animal such as a  frog  that can live both on land and in water
n 爱国主义，民族主义 Patriotism is love for your country and loyalty toward it

es.e: He was a country boy who had joined the army out of a sense of patriotism and adventure.
es.c: 他是个乡下小伙子，出于爱国心和冒险精神参了军。

d: adj 周期的；定期的 Periodical events or situations happen occasionally, at fairly regular intervals；n 期刊；杂志 a magazine, especially one about a serious or technical subject

es.e: She made periodical visits to her dentist.
es.c: 她定期去看牙医。

d: adj 精力充沛的；精力旺盛的 having or needing a lot of energy or determination

es.e: an energetic man
es.c: 精力旺盛的男子

es.e: an energetic drive to get more customers
es.c: 争取更多客户的十足干劲

d: adj 有希望的；有出息的 showing signs of being successful or good in the future

es.e: a promising career in law
es.c: 很有前途的法律职业

es.e: a promising young actor
es.c: 大有前途的年轻演员

es.e: a promising start
es.c: 良好的开端

d: n 边；边缘，轮辋 the outside edge of something circular

es.e: She looked at him over the rim of her glass.
es.c: 她沿玻璃杯口看着他。

d: v 放 to move something to a particular place or position, especially using your hands

es.e: He put the coffee on the table.
es.c: 他把咖啡放在桌上。

es.e: Where did you put the programmes?
es.c: 你把节目单放在哪里了？

d: n 动脉，干线 one of the tubes that carries blood from your heart to the rest of your body

es.e: ...Connecticut Ave., one of the main arteries of Washington.
es.c: …康涅狄格大道，华盛顿的主干道之一。

d: vi&n 求助 when you must use or depend on something because nothing better is available

es.e: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
es.c: 他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

d: n 花瓣 one of the coloured parts of a flower that are shaped like leaves

es.e: rose petals
es.c: 玫瑰花瓣

es.e: The flower has seven petals.
es.c: 这种花有七片花瓣。

d: n 缺乏，不足，不足之数 a lack of something that is necessary

es.e: They did blood tests on him for signs of vitamin deficiency.
es.c: 他们给他做了血检看是否有缺乏维生素的迹象。

d: n 地区，地方 a small area of a country, city etc

es.e: weather reports from several different localities
es.c: 来自几个不同地区的天气报告

d: adj 漂亮的；大方的 an animal, object, or building that is handsome looks attractive in an impressive way

es.e: a row of handsome Georgian houses
es.c: 一排宏伟的乔治王朝时期的房子

d: n 极大数量 a very large number of things

es.e: We’re still studying a myriad of options.
es.c: 我们仍在研究各种备选方案。

d: n 碰撞；震动 the sound or effect of two things hitting each other with great force
n 例行公事，惯例，常规 the usual order in which you do things, or the things you regularly do

es.e: John’s departure had upset their daily routine .
es.c: 约翰的离去打乱了他们的日常生活。

es.e: Try to get into a routine (= develop a fixed order of doing things ) .
es.c: 尽量养成一套习惯。

es.e: my daily exercise routine
es.c: 我每天的锻炼习惯

d: vt&vi 剥去；除去；剥夺财产 to remove something that is covering the surface of something else；n 狭长一片 a long narrow area of land

es.e: Strip the beds and wash the sheets.
es.c: 把床单撤下来清洗。

d: prep =amid；在 当中

es.e: During some trials, an audible tone was played through the headphones, either amidst white noise or on its own, and afterwards the participants were asked if they had noticed it.
es.c: 在一些测试中，耳机里会播放一些可被听见的声音，该声音或混杂于白噪音中，或单独播放，之后，参与者将被问及是否注意到这些声音。

d: v 照顾，给予帮助
n 葬礼，丧葬 a religious ceremony for burying or  cremating (= burning )  someone who has died

es.e: The funeral will be held at St. Martin’s Church.
es.c: 葬礼将在圣马丁教堂举行。

es.e: Hundreds of mourners attended the funeral of the two boys.
es.c: 数百名哀悼者参加了那两个男孩的葬礼。

es.e: the minister who conducted the funeral service
es.c: 主持葬礼的牧师

d: v 腐蚀，侵蚀 if metal corrodes, or if something corrodes it, it is slowly destroyed by the effect of water, chemicals etc

es.e: Acidic water will corrode the pipes.
es.c: 酸性水会腐蚀管子。

d: n 发生率，影响的方式 the number of times something happens, especially crime, disease etc

es.e: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.
es.c: 乳腺癌的发病率随着年龄的增长而上升。

d: n&v 安排；计划，阴谋 a clever plan, especially to do something that is bad or illegal – used in order to show disapproval

es.e: a get-rich-quick scheme
es.c: 快速致富的手段

d: n 栏杆；横杆 a bar that is fastened along or around something, especially to stop you from going somewhere or from falling

es.e: Several passengers were leaning against the ship’s rail.
es.c: 几名乘客斜靠在轮船的栏杆上。

d: adj 沉重的，笨重的；(文章)冗长的 Ponderous writing or speech is very serious, uses more words than necessary, and is dull

es.e: He had a dense, ponderous style.
es.c: 他的风格是词藻堆砌、冗长沉闷。

d: v 降级，堕落，贬黜

es.e: a movie that degrades women
es.c: 贬损女性的影片

d: v (权力)使巩固；认可(任命)

es.e: X-rays have confirmed that he has not broken any bones.
es.c: X光片已经证实他没有骨折。

d: n 解剖刀，(外科用)小刀 a small, very sharp knife that is used by doctors in operations

es.e: I pointed with my scalpel to the chest cavity, where nothing but a black lump of coal squatted in the lipstick-red center.
es.c: 我用解剖刀指着她的胸腔，那里只有一团黑乎乎的煤块，伏在唇膏般红色的胸腔中部。

d: n 肤色；情况；局面；气质 the natural colour or appearance of the skin on your face

es.e: Drinking water is good for the complexion.
es.c: 喝水让气色变好。

d: a&n 被遗弃的；被遗弃者，被逐出者 someone who is not accepted by the people they live among, or who has been forced out of their home

es.e: Smokers often feel as though they are being treated as social outcasts.
es.c: 吸烟者常常觉得自己遭到社会排斥。

d: adj 较早的；更重要的 existing or arranged before something else or before the present situation

es.e: You do not need any prior knowledge of the subject.
es.c: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

es.e: Changes may not be made without the prior approval of the council.
es.c: 未经委员会事先同意，不得作出改变。

es.e: Vegetarian meals are provided by prior agreement.
es.c: 经事先协商可提供素食。

d: n 丘疹，脓疱 a small raised red spot on your skin, especially on your face

es.e: Belushi imitates a giant pimple by squeezing his cheeks and spewing chewed food out of his mouth.
es.c: 我们在等候某个毕业生领文凭的同时，可以欣赏像《动物屋》这样与学校有关的经典电影的片断：约翰-贝鲁西模仿一个脸上长满丘疹的巨人，双手挤着脸，从嘴里喷出嚼过的东西。

d: n 偷盗 the crime of stealing

es.e: Car theft is on the increase.
es.c: 汽车盗窃案在上升。

es.e: an arrest for petty theft
es.c: 以小偷小摸罪名逮捕

es.e: Three men were charged with attempted theft .
es.c: 三名男子被指控企图行窃。

d: v 组成，构成；创作；排字；使安静 to write a piece of music

es.e: Barrington has composed the music for a new production of ‘A Midsummer Night’s Dream’.
es.c: 巴林顿为新版的《仲夏夜之梦》谱了曲。

d: v 传染，受影响，受感染 to give someone a disease

es.e: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
es.c: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

d: n 对称；匀称 the quality of being symmetrical

es.e: ...the incredible beauty and symmetry of a snowflake.
es.c: …雪花令人难以置信的美丽和对称。

d: adj 意义深长的；重要的 having an important effect or influence, especially on what will happen in the future

es.e: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
es.c: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

es.e: Please inform us if there are any significant changes in your plans.
es.c: 你们的计划如有重大变动，请通知我们。

d: n 通用，流通，货币 the system or type of money that a country uses

es.e: The bank can supply you with foreign currency .
es.c: 这家银行能为你提供外币。

es.e: There are moves towards a single currency in Europe.
es.c: 欧洲有向单一货币发展的趋势。

es.e: The local currency is the Swiss franc.
es.c: 当地的货币是瑞士法郎。

d: n 序言，序幕 if an event is a prelude to a more important event, it happens just before it and makes people expect it

es.e: Living together as a prelude to marriage is now considered acceptable in many countries.
es.c: 婚前同居如今在许多国家都已被接受。

d: n 台风，强热带风暴 a very violent tropical storm

es.e: The football match have to stand over next week for the typhoon storm.
es.c: 由于台风风暴，这场足球赛延期到下个星期举行。

d: v 区别，区分；岐视 to treat a person or group differently from another in an unfair way

es.e: He is incapable of discriminating between a good idea and a terrible one.
es.c: 他没能力在一个好主意和一个坏主意之间进行区分。

d: n 障碍；不利 a disadvantage of a situation, plan, product etc

es.e: It’s a great city – the only drawback is the weather.
es.c: 这是座很不错的城市，唯一的不足就是天气。

d: adj 空的；未被占用的；空虚的，无表情的 a vacant seat, building, room or piece of land is empty and available for someone to use

es.e: Only a few apartments were still vacant.
es.c: 只有几套公寓仍然空着。

es.e: There was only a vacant lot (= empty unused area of land in a city ) where her house used to be.
es.c: 她以前房子所在的地方只剩下一块空地了。

d: n&v 行迹；踪迹；跟踪 Tracks are marks left in the ground by the feet of animals or people

es.e: The only evidence of pandas was their tracks in the snow.
es.c: 有熊猫活动的惟一证据就是它们在雪中的足迹。

d: n 人类能力的高度发展，文化，教养，文明 the beliefs, way of life, art, and customs that are shared and accepted by people in a particular society

es.e: We speak Danish at home so that the boys don’t lose touch with their language and culture.
es.c: 我们在家说丹麦语，这样男孩子们就不会脱离他们的语言和文化。

es.e: In our culture, it is rude to ask someone how much they earn.
es.c: 在我们的文化里，问别人收入多少是不礼貌的。

es.e: I love working abroad and meeting people from diffe-rent cultures.
es.c: 我喜欢在国外工作，认识来自不同文化的人。

d: v 挖掘，挖出 if a scientist or archaeologist excavates an area of land, they dig carefully to find ancient objects, bones etc

es.e: Schliemann excavated the ancient city of Troy.
es.c: 谢里曼发掘出特洛伊古城。

d: adj (病的)发作，痉挛；v&a n合适,试穿,安装 to put a piece of equipment into a place, or a new part onto a machine, so that it is ready to be used；v "

es.e: You must be very fit if you do so much running.
es.c: 如果你经常这样跑步，身体肯定很健康。

d: n 运动，动态；手势；眼色，姿势；提议 the process of moving or the way that someone or something moves

es.e: Newton’s first law of motion
es.c: 牛顿第一运动定律

d: v 驱逐，开除；排出 to officially force someone to leave a school or organization

es.e: More than five-thousand high school students have been expelled for cheating.
es.c: 五千多名中学生因考试作弊而被开除。

d: n 津贴 an amount of money that you are given regularly or for a special purpose

es.e: Sales staff get a generous mileage allowance or a company car.
es.c: 销售人员有优厚的里程补贴或者公司提供的专用汽车。

es.e: If you are entitled to sickness allowance, you must claim it from your employer.
es.c: 你如果有资格领取疾病津贴，必须向雇主申请索要。

d: n 胆怯者，懦夫 someone who is not at all brave

es.e: Try it. Don’t be such a coward.
es.c: 试一下，别那么胆小。

d: n 幼芽；起源；微生物 The germ of something such as an idea is something which developed or might develop into that thing

es.e: This was the germ of a book.
es.c: 这是一本书的创作萌芽。

d: n&v 闪光，闪现；简讯，浮华 to shine suddenly and brightly for a short time, or to make something shine in this way

es.e: Lightning flashed overhead.
es.c: 头顶上电光闪闪。

es.e: Red warning lights flashed on and off (= shone for a short time and then stopped shining ) .
es.c: 红色警告灯一闪一闪。

d: v 减去，扣除 to take a number or an amount from a larger number or amount

es.e: The pupil could add and subtract but hadn't learned to divide.
es.c: 这名小学生能做加法和减法，但还没学会做除法。

es.e: Thus, if you have staff activities in loops and want to run the above request, you need to ensure that you subtract only events which belong together.
es.c: 因此，如果您在循环中具有人员活动，并且想要运行以上的请求，那么您必须确保您只减去了属于一起的事件。

d: vi&n 闪闪发光，闪光 to shine brightly with flashing points of light

es.e: The river glittered in the sunlight.
es.c: 阳光下河面波光粼粼。

d: adj 可预言的 if something or someone is predictable, you know what will happen or what they will do – sometimes used to show disapproval

es.e: The snow had a predictable effect on traffic.
es.c: 这场雪对交通造成的影响可以预见。

es.e: an entertaining but predictable film
es.c: 一部有趣但老套的电影

es.e: Logan’s reaction was predictable.
es.c: 洛根的反应可想而知。

d: adj 过分的，过度的 more than is reasonable, suitable, or necessary

es.e: De Gaulle felt that America had undue influence in Europe.
es.c: 戴高乐感到美国在欧洲影响力过大。

es.e: The kick should be taken without undue delay.
es.c: 应立即开球，不得无故拖延。

d: n 标，镖 a small pointed object that is thrown or shot as a weapon, or one that is thrown in the game of darts；v 投掷 If you dart a look at someone or something, or if your eyes dart to them, you look at them very quickly；v 急

es.e: a poisoned dart
es.c: 毒镖

es.e: She darted a sly sideways glance at Bramwell.
es.c: 她狡猾地斜瞟了布莱威尔一眼。

d: v 恰好相合，时间巧合；意见一致 if two people’s ideas, opinions etc coincide, they are the same

es.e: The interests of the US and those of the islanders may not coincide.
es.c: 美国的利益和这些岛民的利益可能并不一致。

d: adj 连续的，连贯的 consecutive numbers or periods of time follow one after the other without any interruptions

es.e: It had rained for four consecutive days.
es.c: 雨接连下了四天。

es.e: Can they win the title for the third consecutive season?
es.c: 他们能连续第三个赛季赢得冠军称号吗？

d: prep favour used to say how something is done or happens；of赞成，以 为收款人

es.e: a room furnished in the modern style
es.c: 一间以现代风格装饰的房间

es.e: Her parents always talk to her in German.
es.c: 她的父母总是用德语和她交谈。

es.e: She shouted my name in a harsh voice.
es.c: 她用刺耳的声音叫我的名字。

d: v&n 赌博；投机 to risk money or possessions on the result of something such as a game or a race, when you do not know for certain what the result will be

es.e: Their religion forbids them to drink or gamble.
es.c: 他们的宗教禁止饮酒和赌博。

d: n 委员会 a group of people chosen to do a particular job, make decisions etc

es.e: a committee meeting
es.c: 委员会会议

d: adj 哑的；暂不说话的；愚笨的 stupid

es.e: What a dumb question.
es.c: 多么愚蠢的问题。

es.e: a bunch of dumb kids
es.c: 一帮笨孩子

es.e: ‘What is it?’ I asked, playing dumb (= pretending to be stupid ) .
es.c: “那是什么？” 我装傻问道。

d: n 卫生 the practice of keeping yourself and the things around you clean in order to prevent diseases

es.e: the importance of personal hygiene
es.c: 个人卫生的重要性

es.e: a food hygiene training course
es.c: 食品卫生培训课程

d: v 使窒息，使闷死；闷住；抑制；忍住 to kill someone by putting something over their face to stop them breathing

es.e: A teenage mother was accused of smothering her 3-month-old daughter.
es.c: 一个少女妈妈被指控闷死自己三个月大的女儿。

d: n 荒地, 废墟 " A wilderness is a desert or other area of natural land which is not used by people

es.e: ...the icy Canadian wilderness.
es.c: …冰封的加拿大荒野。

d: n&v (发)信号 a sound or action that you make in order to give information to someone or tell them to do something

es.e: At a prearranged signal the lights went out.
es.c: 预定的信号一发出，灯就全灭了。

d: n 炉子，熔炉 a large container for a very hot fire, used to produce power, heat, or liquid metal

es.e: We had better fire up the furnace.
es.c: 我们最好把炉子生起来。

es.e: It is time he banked up the furnace.
es.c: 他该把炉子封起来了。

d: v 承认；向祖父忏悔 to admit something that you feel embarrassed about

es.e: Occasionally people confess to crimes they haven’t committed just to get attention.
es.c: 偶尔人们会承认自己并未犯过的罪行，那只是为了引人注意。

d: n 未成年；少数；少数民族 a small group of people or things within a much larger group

es.e: Gaelic is still spoken in Ireland by a tiny minority.
es.c: 爱尔兰仍有极少数人在说盖尔语。

d: n 怀乡病，留恋过去，怀旧 a feeling that a time in the past was good, or the activity of remembering a good time in the past and wishing that things had not changed

es.e: He looked back on his university days with a certain amount of nostalgia.
es.c: 他带着一点留恋，回忆起大学时光。

es.e: a wave of nostalgia for how great life was in the 1960s
es.c: 一阵对20世纪60年代美好生活的强烈怀旧之情

d: adj 谨慎的，小心的 careful to avoid danger or risks

es.e: a cautious driver
es.c: 一位谨慎的司机

es.e: a cautious approach to the crisis
es.c: 处理危机的谨慎态度

es.e: The air-pollution board has reacted with cautious optimism to the announcement.
es.c: 空气污染委员会对这项通告表示谨慎乐观。

d: n 枕头 a cloth bag filled with soft material that you put your head on when you are sleeping

es.e: I’ll be asleep as soon as my head hits the pillow.
es.c: 我头一碰到枕头就会睡着。

d: adj 邻接的，邻近的 a room, building, piece of land etc that is adjacent to something is next to it

es.e: We stayed in adjacent rooms.
es.c: 我们住在毗连的房间里。

d: n 抄本，副本 a written or printed copy of a speech, conversation etc
n (岩石、墙等)裂缝 a narrow crack in the surface of something, especially in rock

es.e: small creatures that hide in crevices in the rock
es.c: 藏在岩石缝里的小生物

d: n&vt 诽谤，污蔑 a false spoken statement about someone, intended to damage the good opinion that people have of that person

es.e: He is being sued for slander .
es.c: 他被控犯有口头诽谤罪。

d: v 使屈服、征服，克制；使柔和，使安静 to defeat or control a person or group, especially using force

es.e: Police managed to subdue the angry crowd.
es.c: 警察设法控制住了愤怒的人群。

es.e: Napoleon subdued much of Europe.
es.c: 拿破仑控制了大半个欧洲。

d: v 放大，扩大；夸大，夸张 to make something seem bigger or louder, especially using special equipment

es.e: At the Sheffield arena, the speakers were magnified ten times on a giant screen.
es.c: 在谢菲尔德体育馆，演讲者在一个巨大的屏幕上被放大了十倍。

es.e: A public address system magnifies all the little noises and coughs.
es.c: 扩音系统会放大任何细小的噪音和咳嗽声。

d: v 使中立；使无效 to make a substance chemically neutral

es.e: a medicine that neutralizes the acid in the stomach
es.c: 能中和胃酸的药

d: n 条纹 a line of colour, especially one of several lines of colour all close together

es.e: a shirt with black and white stripes
es.c: 黑白条纹衬衫

d: n 一套家具，一套房间，酒店套房 a set of rooms, especially expensive ones in a hotel

es.e: a honeymoon suite
es.c: 蜜月套房

es.e: a suite of rooms for palace guests
es.c: 王室贵宾套房

d: n&ad 没有什么；毫不

es.e: I owe him nothing.
es.c: 我不欠他什么。

d: n 围困；围城 a situation in which an army or the police surround a place and try to gain control of it or force someone to come out of it

es.e: The siege lasted almost four months.
es.c: 这次封锁历时近四个月。

es.e: a three-day police siege at a remote country cottage
es.c: 警方对一座偏僻村舍历时三天的包围

d: n 结果，后果；重要性 something that happens as a result of a particular action or set of conditions

es.e: I don’t suppose it is of any consequence now.
es.c: 现在我觉得这事一点都无所谓了。

d: n 粪，肥，肥粒 waste matter from animals that is mixed with soil to improve the soil and help plants grow；v 施肥

es.e: ...bags of manure.
es.c: …一袋袋的肥料。

d: adj 易动的，运动的；易变的 moving or able to move from one job, area, or social class to another

es.e: a more mobile workforce
es.c: 具有更强流动性的劳动力

es.e: People these days are much more socially mobile .
es.c: 如今人们的社会地位容易改变多了。

es.e: an upwardly mobile (= moving to a higher social scale ) professional
es.c: 步步高升的专业人士

d: n 团结一致 loyalty and general agreement between all the people in a group, or between different groups, because they all have a shared aim

es.e: a gesture of solidarity
es.c: 团结的表示

es.e: an appeal for worker solidarity
es.c: 呼吁工人们团结

d: n 胶水，胶 a sticky substance used for joining things together；v 粘贴，紧贴 to join two things together using glue

es.e: ...a tube of glue.
es.c: …一管胶水。

d: adj 误入歧途的 a misguided idea or opinion is wrong because it is based on a wrong understanding of a situation

es.e: His parents still clung to the misguided belief that his common sense would keep him out of serious trouble.
es.c: 他的父母依然错误地认为他的常识能让他远离大的麻烦。

d: adj 强有力的，精力充沛的 using a lot of energy and strength or determination

es.e: Your dog needs at least 20 minutes of vigorous exercise every day.
es.c: 你的狗每天需要进行至少20分钟的剧烈运动。

es.e: Environmentalists have begun a vigorous campaign to oppose nuclear dumping in the area.
es.c: 环保人士已经发动了一场积极的运动，反对在该地区倾倒核废物。

es.e: a vigorous debate
es.c: 一场激烈的辩论

d: n 板球；蟋蟀 a game between two teams of 11 players in which players try to get points by hitting a ball and running between two sets of three sticks

es.e: The boy traded his knife for a cricket bat.
es.c: 那男孩用他的刀子换了一个板球棒。

es.e: He angrily stomped his cricket after failing the fight.
es.c: 比赛失败后，他生气地踏死了他的蟋蟀。

es.e: He was pressganged into playing in the charity cricket match.
es.c: 他是被强拉去参加这场板球义赛的。

d: n 新手; 初学者 someone who has no experience in a skill, subject, or activity

es.e: The computer course is ideal for novices.
es.c: 这门计算机课程非常适合初学者。

es.e: This trail is not recommended for novice bikers.
es.c: 不建议自行车新手走这条小路。

d: n 可能性 the degree to which something can reasonably be expected to happen

es.e: If I refused, it would in all likelihood mean I’d lose my job.
es.c: 如果我拒绝，那我十有八九会丢掉工作。

d: n 保险费；额外费用 the cost of insurance, especially the amount that you pay each year

es.e: insurance premiums
es.c: 保险费

d: adj 和蔼的，亲切的，温和的 friendly and happy

es.e: a genial smile
es.c: 亲切的微笑

d: adj 荒谬的，可笑的 completely unreasonable, stupid, or wrong

es.e: It is ludicrous to suggest that I was driving under the influence of alcohol.
es.c: 说我酒后驾车，这真是太荒唐了。

es.e: The court granted him the ludicrous sum of £100 in damages.
es.c: 法院裁定他获得区区100英镑损害赔偿。

es.e: That’s a ludicrous idea.
es.c: 这个想法很荒唐。

d: adj 有威信的；有声望的 admired as one of the best and most important

es.e: a prestigious literary award
es.c: 享有盛名的文学奖

es.e: a highly prestigious university
es.c: 赫赫有名的大学

d: adj 斜的，偏斜的 not looking, pointing etc directly at something

es.e: an oblique glance
es.c: 斜瞥

d: v 无意中听到，偷听到 to accidentally hear what other people are saying, when they do not know that you have heard

es.e: I overheard part of their conversation.
es.c: 我碰巧听到了他们谈话的部分内容。

es.e: I couldn’t help overhearing your argument.
es.c: 我无意中听到了你们的争吵。

d: n 预期；预料 when you are expecting something to happen

es.e: She waited in eager anticipation for Robert to arrive.
es.c: 她急切地期盼着罗伯特到来。

es.e: Taylor was excited and full of anticipation at the prospect of the trip.
es.c: 泰勒很兴奋，对这次旅行满怀期待。

d: adj 有道德的；善良的；贞洁的；简朴的 not having sex with anyone, or not with anyone except your husband or wife

es.e: She led a chaste decent life.
es.c: 她过着贞洁正派的生活。

d: v 勘察，考查；探索 to travel around an area in order to find out about it

es.e: Venice is a wonderful city to explore.
es.c: 威尼斯是一个美妙的城市，值得好好探究一番。

d: adj 刺鼻的，刺激性的 having a strong taste or smell

es.e: He expressed some fairly pungent criticisms.
es.c: 他提出了一针见血的批评。

d: v 放纵，沉迷于 to let someone have or do whatever they want, even if it is bad for them

es.e: His mother spoiled him, indulging his every whim.
es.c: 他母亲对他纵容娇惯，百依百顺。

d: v 简化 to make something easier or less complicated

es.e: an attempt to simplify the tax system
es.c: 简化税制的尝试

es.c: 他和一个同事争吵后就辞职了。

es.c: 我十六岁辍学。

es.e: She has decided to quit show business.
es.c: 她已决定退出娱乐圈。

d: v 闲逛，漫步；漫谈；蔓延 to go on a walk in the countryside for pleasure

es.e: There’s plenty to discover as you ramble around this little island.
es.c: 漫步这个小岛，你会有很多新发现。

d: n&v 鞭打，责骂；眼睫毛 to hit a person or animal very hard with a whip, stick etc

es.e: Oliver lashed the horses to go faster.
es.c: 奥利弗快马加鞭。

d: n 陶器，陶器制造厂 objects made out of baked clay

es.e: Native American pottery
es.c: 美洲印第安人的陶器

d: v 告发，起诉 to charge someone with a crime and try to show that they are guilty of it in a court of law

es.e: Shoplifters will be prosecuted.
es.c: 在商店行窃者将被起诉。

d: v 使恶化；使加剧；使气恼 to make a bad situation, an illness, or an injury worse

es.e: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
es.c: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

es.e: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation .
es.c: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。

d: v 调停；居间促成 to try to end a quarrel between two people, groups, countries etc

es.e: The former president has agreed to mediate the peace talks.
es.c: 前总统同意就和谈进行斡旋。

d: n 良心，犯罪感 the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is morally right or wrong

es.e: Well, at least I can face them all with a clear conscience (= the knowledge that you have done nothing wrong ) .
es.c: 好吧，至少我可以问心无愧地面对他们所有人。

es.e: I can’t tell you what to do – it’s a matter of conscience (= something that you must make a moral judgment about ) .
es.c: 我不能告诉你怎么办——这是良心问题。

es.e: a crisis of conscience among medical staff (= a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what is the right thing to do )
es.c: 医务人员中的良心危机

d: n 风景 the natural features of a particular part of a country that you can see, such as mountains, forests, deserts etc

es.e: The best part of the trip was the fantastic scenery.
es.c: 此次旅行最精彩之处就是那美妙绝伦的风景。

d: adj (疾病)慢性的 a chronic disease or illness is one that continues for a long time and cannot be cured

es.e: chronic arthritis
es.c: 慢性关节炎

es.e: chronic asthma
es.c: 慢性哮喘

es.e: chronic heart disease
es.c: 慢性心脏病

d: v 支撑；支持，维持 to make something continue to exist or happen for a period of time

es.e: She found it difficult to sustain the children’s interest.
es.c: 她发现很难保持孩子们的兴趣。

es.e: He was incapable of sustaining close relationships with women.
es.c: 他无法和女人维持亲密关系。

es.e: the policies necessary to sustain economic growth
es.c: 维持经济增长必需的政策

d: n 原料，材料；素质；东西 used when you are talking about things such as substances, materials, or groups of objects when you do not know what they are called, or it is not important to say exactly what they are；v 把装满 to fill someth

es.e: I’ve got some sticky stuff on my shoe.
es.c: 我鞋子上有什么黏糊糊的东西。

es.e: How do you think you’re going to fit all that stuff into the car?
es.c: 你说这么多东西你怎么装进车里？

es.e: I felt sorry for the ones who had to eat the awful stuff.
es.c: 我很同情那些只能吃这种难吃东西的人。

d: n 位置；v 设置 If something is sited in a particular place or position, it is put there or built there

es.e: He said chemical weapons had never been sited in Germany.
es.c: 他说从未在德国部署过化学武器。

d: n 老练者；老手；老兵；老式古董车 someone who has been a soldier, sailor etc in a war

es.e: a Vietnam veteran
es.c: 越战老兵

d: v 陪伴，伴奏 to go somewhere with someone

es.e: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
es.c: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

es.e: Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
es.c: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

d: n 一步；走或跑的速度 the speed at which something happens or is done

es.e: He quickened his pace , longing to be home.
es.c: 他加快步伐，盼望着早点回到家中。

d: adj 每年的，一年生的 happening once a year；n 年刊；一年生植物 a plant that lives for one year or season

es.e: The school trip has become an annual event.
es.c: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

d: adj 宇宙的 relating to space or the universe

es.e: ...the cosmic laws governing our world.
es.c: …主宰我们世界的宇宙法则。

d: adj 威严的；庄严的 very big, impressive, or beautiful

es.e: This lovely village is surrounded by majestic mountain scenery.
es.c: 这座美丽的村庄四周山色壮丽。

d: v 给，付给，允许，供给，传达 to let someone have something as a present, or to provide something for someone

es.e: Researchers were given a £10,000 grant to continue their work.
es.c: 研究人员得到一万英镑的经费以继续他们的研究。

es.e: I’ve got some old diaries that my grandmother gave me years ago.
es.c: 我有几本旧日记本，是多年前祖母给我的。

es.e: I didn’t steal it! Maria gave it to me!
es.c: 我不是偷的！是玛丽亚给我的！

d: adj 直言的，坦率的 expressing your opinions honestly and directly, even when doing this might annoy some people

es.e: an outspoken critic of the education reforms
es.c: 对教育改革直言不讳的批评者

d: n 仓库，货栈
adj 唯一的，独一无二的 being the only one of its kind

es.e: Each person’s fingerprints are unique.
es.c: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

d: n 螺旋，螺丝；螺旋浆 a thin pointed piece of metal that you push and turn in order to fasten pieces of metal or wood together；vt&vi 钉住，拧 to fasten or close something by turning it, or to be fastened in this way

es.e: Fix the frame in position and tighten the screws .
es.c: 把框子固定在正确位置上，拧紧螺丝。

d: n 毛孔 one of the small holes in your skin that liquid, especially  sweat  , can pass through, or a similar hole in the surface of a plant；v 钻研 If you pore over or through information, you look at it and study it very care

es.e: The size of your pores is determined by the amount of oil they produce.
es.c: 毛孔的大小取决于毛孔分泌油脂的多少。

es.e: We spent hours poring over travel brochures.
es.c: 我们花了几个小时仔细研究旅游宣传册。

d: v 拍 ，掌击 to hit a surface with a lot of force, making a loud sharp sound

es.e: Sarah slapped Aaron across the face.
es.c: 萨拉在阿龙的脸上掴了一巴掌。

d: n 枝条；木棍 a long thin piece of wood from a tree, which is no longer attached to the tree；v 刺；粘；陷往 to attach something to something else using a substance, or to become attached to a surface

es.e: They collected sticks to start the fire.
es.c: 他们捡来树枝生火。

d: adj 锋利的，尖锐的，强烈的；敏锐的；渴望的 wanting to do something or wanting something to happen very much

es.e: a keen photographer
es.c: 一个摄影迷

d: n 身份，地位 the official legal position or condition of a person, group, country etc

es.e: These documents have no legal status in Britain.
es.c: 这些文件在英国并无法律效力。

es.e: What is your marital status (= are you married or not ) ?
es.c: 你的婚姻状况是什么？

d: v 使润滑，使顺利 to put a lubricant on something in order to make it move more smoothly

es.e: Lubricate all moving parts with grease.
es.c: 给所有活动部件加润滑油。

d: v 压倒，淹没 if water overwhelms an area of land, it covers it completely and suddenly

es.e: But the various pros and cons should not blindly overwhelm one another.
es.c: 但是，众多的利弊得失不应盲目的一个压倒另一个。

es.e: We try not to think about it because it would overwhelm us to an extent that we would just vegetate.
es.c: 我们尽量不去想它，因为在某种我们能够想像到的程度上他会压倒我们。

es.e: For example, in a situation in which several bystanders need to band together to overwhelm a perpetrator, they will be more likely to act collectively than to act alone.
es.c: 例如, 就有这样一种情况， 在只有几个旁观者需要联合起来才能压倒一个罪犯的情况下, 他们就可能会更多地采取集体行动。

d: n 辛苦 Pain is the feeling of unhappiness that you have when something unpleasant or upsetting happens

es.e: ...grey eyes that seemed filled with pain.
es.c: …似乎充满了痛苦的灰色眼睛。

d: adj 可变的，变化的 likely to change often；n 可变物，变量 something that may be different in different situations, so that you cannot be sure what will happen

es.e: Expect variable cloudiness and fog tomorrow.
es.c: 预计明天多云有雾，天气多变。

es.e: Interest rates can be highly variable.
es.c: 利率有时会大幅波动。

d: n 手册，便览 a short book that gives information or instructions about something

es.e: the Fiction Writer’s Handbook
es.c: 《小说写作手册》

d: adj 僵硬的，不易弯的；严格的 rigid methods, systems etc are very strict and difficult to change

es.e: rigid and authoritarian methods of education
es.c: 死板、专断的教育方法

d: v&n 拥抱；利用；包含 to put your arms around someone and hold them in a friendly or loving way

es.e: Jack warmly embraced his son.
es.c: 杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。

es.e: Maggie and Laura embraced.
es.c: 玛吉和劳拉拥抱在一起。

d: n 象牙；象牙制品 the hard smooth yellowish-white substance from the  tusks(= long teeth )  of an  elephant；adj 象牙色的

es.e: an ivory chess set
es.c: 一副象牙国际象棋

d: adj 根本的，基本的，政治激进的
n 身份; 同一; 一致；特性 someone’s identity is their name or who they are

es.e: The identity of the killer is still unknown.
es.c: 凶手的身份仍未查明。

d: v 流行，盛行 if a belief, custom, situation etc prevails, it exists among a group of people at a certain time

es.e: A similar situation prevails in Canada.
es.c: 同样的情况在加拿大也普遍存在。

d: n&v 渡船；渡口，摆渡 a boat that carries people or goods across a river or a narrow area of water

es.e: They had recrossed the River Gambia by ferry.
es.c: 他们乘船又一次渡过了冈比亚河。

d: v 精确发现目标

es.e: They have to be able to pinpoint people in order to work, but satellite positioning does not work indoors.
es.c: 因为这样的技术必须精确人的位置才可以工作，而目前卫星的定位系统还不能运行到室内。

d: n 点心 small amounts of food and drink that are provided at a meeting, sports event etc

es.e: Refreshments will be served after the meeting.
es.c: 会后有茶点招待。

d: n 本质，香精 the most basic and important quality of something

es.e: In essence his message was very simple.
es.c: 实质上他想表达的意思很简单。

d: n&v (下)冰雹；(冰雹般)一阵，落下 frozen raindrops which fall as hard balls of ice

es.e: heavy showers of rain and hail
es.c: 夹着冰雹的阵阵大雨

d: n 杂乱物；一胎生下的小动物 a group of baby animals that a mother gives birth to at the same time；v 使杂乱,乱丢 if things litter an area, there are a lot of them in that place, scattered in an untidy way；n "

es.e: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.
es.c: 在有些城市，乱扔垃圾的人会被罚款。

d: v 颤抖，哆嗦 to shake slightly because you are cold or frightened

es.e: Jake stood shivering in the cold air.
es.c: 大冷天里，杰克站着冻得瑟瑟发抖。

d: n 一部分，一份，一客 a part of something larger, especially a part that is different from the other parts

es.e: Do you have any children’s portions?
es.c: 你们有儿童餐吗？

d: n 礼貌，谦恭 polite behaviour and respect for other people

es.e: It’s a matter of common courtesy to acknowledge letters.
es.c: 确认收到来信是起码的礼貌。

d: n&v 筵席，宴请，使享受 A feast is a large and special meal

es.e: Lunch was a feast of meat and vegetables, cheese, yoghurt and fruit, with unlimited wine.
es.c: 午餐是一场盛宴，有肉、蔬菜、奶酪、酸奶和水果，以及不限量的葡萄酒。

es.e: The fruit was often served at wedding feasts.
es.c: 婚宴上常有水果供应。

d: n 正当行为；正当；适当
n 余款，盈余；过剩，剩余) an amount of something that is more than what is needed or used

es.e: Any surplus can be trimmed away.
es.c: 多出来的部分可以修剪掉。

d: n 长途冒险旅行；一连串的冒险 a long journey with a lot of adventures or difficulties

es.e: a spiritual odyssey
es.c: 一次精神上的艰难历程

d: n 公事包；文件夹；大臣及部长职位 a large flat case used especially for carrying pictures, documents etc

es.e: the foreign affairs portfolio
es.c: 外交部长职责

d: adj 表面的；表皮的；肤浅的，一知半解的 not studying or looking at something carefully and only seeing the most noticeable things

es.e: They only have the most superficial understanding of prison life.
es.c: 他们对监狱生活只有最粗浅的了解。

d: n 开庭，开庭期；集会；学期 a formal meeting or group of meetings, especially of a law court or parliament

es.e: Board members met in closed session (= with nobody else present ) .
es.c: 委员会成员举行了闭门会议。

d: adj 乐于助人的 willing and eager to help

es.e: The shop assistant was very obliging.
es.c: 店员非常热情。

d: n 百叶窗；照相机快门 one of a pair of wooden or metal covers on the outside of a window that can be closed to keep light out or prevent thieves from coming in

es.e: There are a few things you should check before pressing the shutter release.
es.c: 在按快门之前，有几件事情你应该检查。

d: adj 小的；次要的 a petty problem, detail etc is small and unimportant

es.e: petty squabbles
es.c: 小口角

es.e: petty restrictions
es.c: 小限制

d: n 跛子；残疾人 someone who is unable to walk properly because their legs are damaged or injured - now considered offensive；v 使跛，使残疾 to hurt someone badly so that they cannot walk properly

es.e: She has gone from being a healthy, fit, and sporty young woman to being a cripple.
es.c: 她从一个健康、强壮、爱好体育运动的年轻姑娘变成了一个残疾人。

d: n 试用，试读；见习，试用；缓刑 a system that allows some criminals not to go to prison or to leave prison, if they behave well and see a probation officer regularly, for a particular period of time

es.e: The judge sentenced Jennings to three years’ probation.
es.c: 法官判詹宁斯三年缓刑。

d: n 钟摆 a long metal stick with a weight at the bottom that swings regularly from side to side to control the working of a clock

es.e: After several years of Republican government, the pendulum will undoubtedly swing back and voters will elect a Democrat.
es.c: 由共和党执政数年后，选民无疑会掉过头来，选出一位民主党人。

d: n&vt 流放，离乡背井 someone who has been forced to live in exile

es.e: political exiles
es.c: 政治流亡者

d: v 使信服 to make someone feel certain that something is true

es.e: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
es.c: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

d: adj 正直的，正当的，公正的 morally good and fair

es.e: a righteous God
es.c: 正义的上帝

d: n 香槟酒 a French white wine with a lot of  bubble s  , drunk on special occasions

es.e: I drank a cup of champagne.
es.c: 我喝了一杯香槟。

es.e: The champagne is spilling out of the bottle.
es.c: 香槟从瓶子中不断地溢出来。

es.e: The champagne cork popped when he pulled it out.
es.c: 他拔香槟酒的瓶塞时它砰的一声开了。

d: n 食欲 a desire for food

es.e: Her husband always had a huge appetite.
es.c: 她丈夫向来胃口极大。

es.e: Symptoms include tiredness and loss of appetite.
es.c: 症状包括疲倦和食欲不振。

d: adj 老练的，有经验的，世故的；尖端的 a sophisticated machine, system, method etc is very well designed and very advanced, and often works in a complicated way

es.e: sophisticated software
es.c: 很先进的软件

es.e: a highly sophisticated weapons system
es.c: 非常精密的武器系统

d: v&n 拨；戳 to quickly push your finger or some other pointed object into something or someone

es.e: Vanessa gave me a playful poke in the ribs.
es.c: 瓦妮莎开玩笑地戳了一下我的肋骨。

d: n [美]电梯，升降机 a machine that takes people and goods from one level to another in a building

es.e: We’ll have to take the elevator.
es.c: 我们只好坐电梯了。

d: adj 暴躁的；易怒的 easily becoming offended or annoyed

es.e: She is very touchy about her past.
es.c: 她对自己的过去非常敏感。

d: n 推荐，介绍；推荐信 a suggestion to someone that they should choose a particular thing or person that you think is very good

es.e: Try to get letters of recommendation from bosses and colleagues.
es.c: 设法得到老板和同事的推荐信。

d: n 龙头；轻拍，轻敲 a piece of equipment for controlling the flow of water, gas etc from a pipe or container；v 轻拍，轻敲 to hit your fingers lightly on something, for example to get someone’s attention

es.e: (= water that comes out of a tap ) is usually heavily treated with chemicals.
es.c: 自来水一般都用化学品严格处理过。

es.e: She went into the bathroom and turned on the taps .
es.c: 她走进浴室，打开水龙头。

d: n 棚；车库 a small building, often made of wood, used especially for storing things；v 发出；脱落 if a plant sheds its leaves or if an animal sheds skin or hair, they fall off as part of a natural process

es.e: a tool shed
es.c: 工具棚

es.e: a cattle shed
es.c: 牛棚

d: v 比更重，比更重要 to be more important or valuable than something else

es.e: The benefits of the scheme outweigh the disadvantages.
es.c: 这项计划利大于弊。

d: v 增援；加强 to give support to an opinion, idea, or feeling, and make it stronger

es.e: The film reinforces the idea that women should be pretty and dumb.
es.c: 这部影片强化了这个观点——女人要漂亮，而且要笨一些。

d: n 一块面包，块，团 bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and can be cut into slices；v 消磨时间

es.e: a loaf of bread
es.c: 一条面包

d: n 技艺，功绩，武艺 something that is an impressive achievement, because it needs a lot of skill, strength etc to do

es.e: A racing car is an extraordinary feat of engineering.
es.c: 赛车是工程学的一项非凡业绩。

d: adj 累积的，累加的 increasing gradually as more of something is added or happens

es.e: Learning is a cumulative process.
es.c: 学习是个逐渐积累的过程。

d: n 尼龙；尼龙长袜 a strong artificial material that is used to make plastics, clothes, rope etc

es.e: nylon fabric
es.c: 尼龙织物

es.e: The tent was made of nylon.
es.c: 那顶帐篷是尼龙做的。

d: v 使发疯，使发狂 to make someone very angry or annoyed

es.e: The unfortunate animal was maddened with pain.
es.c: 那可怜的动物痛得发狂。

d: n 技术，技能；行家手法 a special way of doing something

es.e: He’s a great player, with brilliant technique.
es.c: 他是个伟大的球员，球技十分精湛。

d: n (常作pl) rules or instructions about the best way to do something

es.e: This chapter gives you some guidelines to help you in your work.
es.c: 本章将介绍一些指导性原则，为你的工作提供帮助。

d: v 挂，悬挂；吊死；贴，糊 to kill someone by dropping them with a rope around their neck, or to die in this way, especially as a punishment for a serious crime

es.e: If he is found guilty, he will almost certainly hang.
es.c: 如果被判有罪，他几乎肯定会被处以绞刑。

d: n 感情；情绪；激动 a strong human feeling such as love, hate, or anger

es.e: Her voice was full of emotion.
es.c: 她的声音充满了激情。

es.e: She was good at hiding her emotions.
es.c: 她很会掩饰自己的情感。

es.e: Kim received the news without showing any visible sign of emotion.
es.c: 金接到消息时丝毫不露声色。

d: n 缝 a pleat or fold in a part of a garment, usually stitched down so as to make it a better fit or as decoration；v 打褶裥 to put a  tuck (= special fold )  in a piece of clothing
n 重要性；大小 the great size or importance of something

es.e: an increase of this order of magnitude
es.c: 如此大幅度的增长

d: n 各类粮食 a breakfast food made from grain and usually eaten with milk

es.e: a bowl of breakfast cereal
es.c: 一碗早餐麦片

d: n 丛林，密林 a thick tropical forest with many large plants growing very close together

es.e: the Amazon jungle
es.c: 亚马孙丛林

d: v 滥用，误用 to dishonestly take something that someone has trusted you with, especially money or goods that belong to your employer

es.e: He claimed the finance manager had misappropriated company funds.
es.c: 他声称财务经理挪用了公司资金。

d: n 腐蚀，侵蚀 the process by which rock or soil is gradually destroyed by wind, rain, or the sea

es.e: the problem of soil erosion
es.c: 水土流失的问题

es.e: the erosion of the coastline
es.c: 海岸线受到的侵蚀

d: v 劫持，劫机，拦路抢劫 to use violence or threats to take control of a plane, vehicle, or ship

es.c: 她从架子上拉出一个蓝色文件夹。

es.c: 由小马达驱动的小船

es.c: 她听到有脚步声走过来。

es.c: 他们开始向爱尔兰政府表示友好。

es.c: 北京一个蔬菜批发市场，一名经理说他的成本已经猛增，因为夏天天气太热，这些产品都要装在冷却箱里进行运输。

d: n 文具 materials that you use for writing, such as paper, pens, pencils etc

es.c: …信封及其他办公文具。

d: n 酒；酒类 a strong alcoholic drink such as whisky

es.c: 当地传说这个岛就是伊甸园的原型。

d: v 弄脏；污染 to make a place or substance dirty or harmful by putting something such as chemicals or poison in it

d: v 懒洋洋地倚靠,(头等)垂下n游手好闲的人" to sit or lie in a very lazy and relaxed way

es.c: 他懒洋洋地躺在炉火边一个背光的沙发上。

d: v 激励，鼓励，灌注以创造力 to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something

es.e: We need someone who can inspire the team.
es.c: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

es.e: Inspired by the sunny weather, I decided to explore the woods.
es.c: 阳光明媚的天气令人振奋，我决定到森林里寻幽探胜。

d: adj 不变的；经常的；坚定的 happening regularly or all the time

es.e: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
es.c: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

es.e: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
es.c: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

es.e: He kept in constant contact with his family while he was in Australia.
es.c: 他在澳大利亚时一直和家人保持着联系。

d: n 周边，周长，周界 the border around an enclosed area such as a military camp

es.c: …机场周边。

es.e: These patients are not neurotics.
es.c: 这些病人不是神经官能症患者。

es.c: 一大群人聚集在美国大使馆外。

es.c: 他环顾四周聚集的人群。

es.c: 她收集了一些自己最喜欢听的歌。

es.c: 这一传统源于中世纪。

es.c: 起源不明的古老民间传说

d: vt&n 猛掷，猛投 to throw something with a lot of force, especially because you are angry

es.c: 示威者在向窗里掷砖块。

es.e: He hurled a chair across the set, smashing lamps and vases.
es.c: 他抓起一把椅子扔向片场的那头，把灯和花瓶都砸得粉碎。

d: n 男女同校的学生 a woman student at a university

es.c: ...两名佛罗里达大学的女生。

d: adj 垂直的，直立的；正直的 standing or sitting straight up

es.c: 凯蒂还醒着，坐得笔直，眼睛盯着电视。

es.c: 庞贝城于公元79年在火山爆发中毁灭。

es.c: 美国正在发生重大事件。

es.c: 在一片美国经济疲软的传言中，美元贬值了。

es.c: 这瓶威士忌是1926年被蒸馏的，存放至1987年酿造成熟。
