es.e: Drinks and light snacks are served at the bar.
es.c: 酒吧里供应饮料和小吃。

es.e: snack foods like crisps and peanuts
es.c: 炸薯片和花生之类的小吃

d: v 拆毁；废除；驳倒 to completely destroy a building

es.e: The entire east wing of the building was demolished in the fire.
es.c: 大楼的整个东翼都被大火烧毁了。

d: n 口哨声；哨子 a small object that produces a high whistling sound when you blow into it；v 吹哨汽笛 to make a high or musical sound by blowing air out through your lips

es.e: The lifeguard blew his whistle.
es.c: 救生员吹响哨子。

d: n 怪物；畸形的动植物；恶人 an imaginary or ancient creature that is large, ugly, and frightening

es.e: the remains of a prehistoric monster
es.c: 史前怪兽的遗骸

es.e: the search for the Loch Ness Monster
es.c: 对内斯湖水怪的搜寻

d: n 教义，教条 a set of beliefs that form an important part of a religion or system of ideas

es.e: traditional doctrines of divine power
es.c: 神力的传统教义

es.e: Marxist doctrine
es.c: 马克思主义学说

d: n 特征，品质 a particular quality in someone’s character

es.e: The study found that some alcoholics had clear personality traits showing up early in childhood.
es.c: 这项研究发现一些酗酒者早在孩童时就表现出明显的个性特征。

d: vt&vi 唤醒，唤起；激励；激起 to wake someone who is sleeping deeply

es.e: His banging roused the neighbours.
es.c: 他重重的关门声把邻居都吵醒了。

d: adj 可兼容的，可和谐共存的 if two pieces of computer equipment are compatible, they can be used together, especially when they are made by different companies

es.e: The new software is IBM compatible (= can be used with IBM computers ) .
es.c: 这个新软件与IBM的计算机兼容。

d: n 甲板；公共汽车一层的车厢；纸牌 one of the levels on a bus, plane etc；v 装饰 to decorate something with flowers, flags etc

es.e: Eddie returned to the flight deck (= the part of an aircraft where the pilot sits ) .
es.c: 埃迪回到了驾驶舱。

d: n 退职金；小账，小费 a small gift of money given to someone for a service they provided

es.e: The porter expects a gratuity.
es.c: 那个搬运工想要小费。

d: n 历史学家 A historian is a person who specializes in the study of history, and who writes books and articles about it

es.e: I am a historian, and I teach in an American university.
es.c: 我是一位历史学家，在美国一所大学任教。

es.e: "There’s nothing I can tell you about how [this or] any other incidents were or are handled, " CIA historian David Robarge said.
es.c: “关于[这一或]或任何其他事故是如何处理的，我没有什么可以告诉你的，”中央情报局历史学家大卫·罗巴尔说。

es.e: The historian drew a horizontal line on the date to remember it.
es.c: 历史学家在日期上画了一条水平线来记住这天。

d: n&a 沙漠 a large area of land where it is always very dry, and there is a lot of sand；n 无人居住的；v 丢弃 to leave someone or something and no longer help or support them；n 离开

es.e: the Sahara Desert
es.c: 撒哈拉沙漠

es.e: This area of the country is mostly desert.
es.c: 该国的这一地区大部分是沙漠。

d: n&a 平民，民用的，民间的 anyone who is not a member of the military forces or the police

es.e: Many innocent civilians were killed during the war.
es.c: 许多无辜的平民在战争中丧生。

d: n 制成 the process of making something

es.e: people involved in decision making at the highest level
es.c: 最高层级决策参与者

d: adj 不平的；粗鲁的，粗略的；刺耳的 having an uneven surface

es.e: Her hands were rough from hard work.
es.c: 她的双手因为干重活而变得很粗糙。

es.e: the rough terrain at the base of the mountains
es.c: 山脚下崎岖不平的地形

es.e: We were bumping over the rough ground .
es.c: 我们在崎岖的地面上颠簸而行。

d: adj 值得弄到手的，吸引人的

es.e: The ability to speak a foreign language is highly desirable .
es.c: 能说一门外语是非常理想的。

d: adj 深的，极深的；渊博的；深奥的 having a strong influence or effect

es.e: a profound sense of guilt
es.c: 强烈的内疚感

d: n 运输 a system or method for carrying passengers or goods from one place to another；v 运输 to take goods, people etc from one place to another in a vehicle

es.e: commuters who travel on public transport
es.c: 乘坐公共交通车辆上下班的人

es.e: It’s easier to get to the college if you have your own transport (= a car, bicycle etc ) .
es.c: 如果你有自己的交通工具，去学院就会更方便。

d: adj 临时的，暂时性的 likely or able to be changed in the future

es.e: a provisional government
es.c: 临时政府

es.e: We accept provisional bookings by phone.
es.c: 我们接受电话临时预约。

d: adj 脆的；易断的 easily broken or damaged

es.e: Be careful with that vase – it’s very fragile.
es.c: 小心那只花瓶——很容易打碎的。

es.e: fragile bones
es.c: 脆弱的骨头

d: vt&vi 捐款，捐助；订阅；同意，赞成 to pay money, usually once a year, to have copies of a newspaper or magazine sent to you, or to have some other service

es.e: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.
es.c: 我订阅《新科学家》的主要原因是要跟上科学的进步。

d: adj 奇怪的，不平常的；可疑的；眩晕的 strange or difficult to explain

es.e: She gave a queer laugh.
es.c: 她古怪地笑了笑。

es.e: Hank was beginning to feel a little queer.
es.c: 汉克开始感觉有点不对头。

d: v 译解(密码等) to find the meaning of something that is difficult to read or understand

es.e: She studied the envelope, trying to decipher the handwriting.
es.c: 她仔细地看信封，试图辨认上面的字迹。

d: adj 想象的，有想象力的 containing new and interesting ideas

es.e: an imaginative use of computer technology
es.c: 计算机技术的妙用

es.e: children’s imaginative play
es.c: 儿童富有想象力的游戏

es.e: an imaginative solution to the litter problem
es.c: 解决乱扔垃圾的问题的有创意的方法

d: adj 包括的，包含的 an inclusive price or cost includes everything

es.e: Not everyone shares his vision of an inclusive America.
es.c: 不是所有人都同意他的观点，认为美国是个包容性很强的国家。

d: n&v 蘑菇，迅速发展 one of several kinds of  fungus  with stems and round tops, some of which can be eaten

es.e: mushroom soup
es.c: 蘑菇汤

d: adj 可怕的，恐怖的；讨厌的 very bad - used, for example, about things you see, taste, or smell, or about the weather

es.e: The weather has been really horrible all week.
es.c: 整个星期天气都很糟。

es.e: a horrible smell
es.c: 极难闻的气味

es.e: The food looked horrible, but it tasted OK.
es.c: 那食物看上去很糟，可吃起来还不错。

d: v 闪光，闪耀 to shine in small bright flashes

es.e: The sea sparkled in the sun.
es.c: 阳光下大海碧波闪耀。

es.e: The crystal chandelier sparkled.
es.c: 那水晶枝形吊灯闪闪发光。

d: adj 有节制的，不过分的；(气候)温和的 behaviour that is temperate is calm and sensible

es.e: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
es.c: 尼罗河流域全年气候温和。

d: n 特权 a right that someone has, especially because of their importance or social position

es.e: Arriving late is a woman’s prerogative .
es.c: 迟到是女人的特权。

es.e: {"GLOSS":["the rights of kings and queens"],"COLLOINEXA":["the royal prerogative"]}
es.c: 君主特权

d: n (书籍)副标题；译文字幕 the words printed over a film in a foreign language to translate what is being said by the actors

es.e: a French film with English subtitles
es.c: 附有英语字幕的法国电影

d: n 剧烈痛苦；折磨，烦扰 severe mental or physical suffering；v 折磨；纠缠 to make someone suffer a lot, especially mentally

es.e: The journey must have been a torment for them.
es.c: 这次旅途对他们来说一定十分痛苦。

d: adv 好像；似乎 If something is seemingly the case, you mean that it appears to be the case, even though it may not really be so

es.e: A seemingly endless line of trucks waits in vain to load up.
es.c: 看上去没有尽头的一排卡车徒劳地等着装货。

d: n 瓦，瓦片 a thin curved piece of baked clay used for covering roofs

es.e: ...a fine building, with a neat little porch and ornamental tiles on the roof.
es.c: …一幢精致建筑，有个整洁的小门廊，屋顶上盖着装饰瓦。

d: n 岛，小岛 a word for an island, used in poetry or in names of islands

es.e: the British Isles
es.c: 不列颠群岛

d: n 询问，打听
n 侦察员，侦察机，侦察舰 a soldier, plane etc that is sent to search the area in front of an army and get information about the enemy

es.e: He sent three scouts ahead to take a look at the bridge.
es.c: 他派出三名侦察兵到前面侦察大桥的情况。

d: n 赎金，赎救 an amount of money that is paid to free someone who is held as a prisoner

es.e: The kidnappers were demanding a ransom of $250,000.
es.c: 绑匪索取25万美元的赎金。

es.e: The government refused to pay the ransom .
es.c: 政府拒绝交付赎金。

es.e: He’s got the ransom money .
es.c: 他得到了赎金。

d: v 崇敬，崇拜 to honour or respect someone or something because they are old, holy, or connected with the past

es.e: a symbol of Arab courage, to be venerated for generations
es.c: 受到世代尊崇的阿拉伯人勇气的象征

d: adj 断然的；明白无误的

es.e: an outright refusal
es.c: 断然拒绝

d: n 露天表演，庆典 A pageant is a colourful public procession, show, or ceremony. Pageants are usually held outdoors and often celebrate events or people from history.

es.e: ...a historical pageant of kings and queens.
es.c: …一场历史上的国王和王后们的盛大庆典。

d: n 曲线图，图表 a drawing that uses a line or lines to show how two or more sets of measurements are related to each other

es.e: Martin showed me a graph of their recent sales.
es.c: 马丁给我看了他们最近销售情况的图表。

d: n 班机，班轮 A liner is a large ship in which people travel long distances, especially on holiday

es.e: ...luxury ocean liners.
es.c: …豪华远洋客轮。

d: n 公证人，公证员 someone, especially a lawyer, who has the legal power to make a signed statement or document official

es.e: Want to be an assistant judge or notary.
es.c: 想成为一名助理法官或公证人。

es.e: The notary looked at the count with astonishment.
es.c: 那公证人惊异地望着伯爵。

es.e: "Very well; and where is this house that I purchase?" asked the count carelessly, addressing himself half to Bertuccio, half to the notary.
es.c: “好极了，我买的这座房子在什么地方？” 伯爵随意地问道，这句话一半是对贝尔图乔说的，一半是对公证人说的。

d: n 音律；歌曲 a song or tune

es.e: They played some lovely melodies.
es.c: 他们演奏了一些动听的曲子。

es.e: a haunting melody
es.c: 难以忘怀的曲调

d: adj 类似的 almost the same

es.e: We have similar tastes in music.
es.c: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

es.e: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
es.c: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

es.e: A number of his friends had been affected in a similar way .
es.c: 他的一些朋友也受到了类似的影响。

d: adj 同时代的，当代的 belonging to the present time；n 同龄人，同时代的人 someone who lived or was in a particular place at the same time as someone else

es.e: She writes a lot of contemporary music for people like Whitney Houston.
es.c: 她为惠特尼·休斯敦等人创作大量当代音乐作品。

d: adj 鲁莽的 not caring or worrying about the possible bad or dangerous results of your actions

es.e: He was accused of causing death by reckless driving .
es.c: 他被控因鲁莽驾驶致人死亡。

es.e: a reckless disregard for safety
es.c: 不顾安全的鲁莽行为

es.e: He ran into the burning house with reckless abandon (= without caring about the danger ) .
es.c: 他不顾危险冲入着火的房子里。

d: n 刺棒，刺痛物；激励 something that forces someone to do something；v 激励，刺激 If you goad someone, you deliberately make them feel angry or irritated, often causing them to react by doing something

es.e: The offer of economic aid was a goad to political change.
es.c: 提供经济援助是政治改革的推动力。

es.e: Charles was always goading me.
es.c: 查尔斯老是刺激我。

d: n 漏洞，泄漏 a small hole that lets liquid or gas flow into or out of something

es.e: There is a leak in the ceiling.
es.c: 天花板上有条裂缝。

es.e: The boat had sprung a leak (= a hole had appeared in it ).
es.c: 小船出现了漏洞。

d: adj 精明的；明智的 sensible and likely to gain you an advantage

es.e: Many towns often found it politic to change their allegiance.
es.c: 许多城镇经常发现改变拥戴对象不失为明智之举。

d: v 登记，注册 to put someone’s or something’s name on an official list

es.e: The tanker is registered in Rotterdam.
es.c: 这艘油轮是在鹿特丹登记的。

d: n&vt 诱惑(力)；引诱，吸引 to persuade someone to do something, especially something wrong or dangerous, by making it seem attractive or exciting

es.e: He lured her to his home and shot her with his father's gun.
es.c: 他把她诱骗到家里，然后用父亲的枪把她打死。

d: adv 终于，最后 after a long time, or after a lot of things have happened

es.e: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
es.c: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

es.e: Eventually, she got a job and moved to London.
es.c: 最终，她找到了工作并移居伦敦。

d: adj 可谈判的，可(通行)商议的；可兑换现金的 an offer, price, contract etc that is negotiable can be discussed and changed before being agreed on

es.e: Part-time barman required. Hours and salary negotiable.
es.c: 招聘兼职酒吧男服务员，工作时间及薪金面议。

es.e: The price is not negotiable.
es.c: 价格没有商量的余地。

d: adj 反响的；共鸣的 resonant materials increase any sound produced inside them

es.e: the violin’s smooth, resonant tone
es.c: 小提琴圆润悠扬的音色

d: v 归因于 If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation；n 属性；象征；标志 a quality or feature, especially one that is considered to be good or useful

es.e: Women tend to attribute their success to external causes such as luck.
es.c: 女性往往把她们的成功归因于外因，如运气。

d: v 证明有罪 to prove or officially announce that someone is guilty of a crime after a  trial  in a law court；n 罪犯 someone who has been proved to be guilty of a crime and sent to prison

es.e: a convicted murderer
es.c: 已定罪的谋杀犯

d: v 断言，使确信；保(人寿)险 to tell someone that something will definitely happen or is definitely true so that they are less worried

es.e: The document is genuine, I can assure you .
es.c: 我能向你保证，这文件是真的。

d: n 观光，游览 when you visit famous or interesting places, especially as tourists

es.e: She swam and sunbathed, went sightseeing and relaxed.
es.c: 她游泳，晒日光浴，观光，放松。

d: adj 潜在的；潜伏的 something that is latent is present but hidden, and may develop or become more noticeable in the future

es.e: latent aggression
es.c: 潜在的侵略

d: adj 各种各样的 consisting of or including many different kinds of things or people, especially in a way that seems interesting

es.e: a varied diet
es.c: 丰富多样的饮食

es.e: The responsibilities of government are many, and they are varied.
es.c: 政府有很多职责，而且各不相同。

d: v 不理(某人的愿望要求)，不顾

es.e: The EU commission exercised its power to override British policy.
es.c: 欧盟委员会行使其权力来否决英国的政策。

d: n 木排，木筏 a flat floating structure, usually made of pieces of wood tied together, used as a boat

es.e: ...a river trip on bamboo rafts through dense rainforest.
es.c: …一次乘着竹筏穿过茂密雨林的河上旅行。

d: v 察觉，发觉 to notice, see, or recognize something

es.e: That morning, he perceived a change in Franca’s mood.
es.c: 那天早上，他注意到弗兰卡情绪的变化。

es.e: Cats are not able to perceive colour.
es.c: 猫不能辨别颜色。

d: n 专题论文集，讨论会 a formal meeting in which people who know a lot about a particular subject have discussions about it

es.e: He had been taking part in an international symposium on population.
es.c: 他那时在参加一个有关人口的国际研讨会。

d: adj 合适的 correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose

es.e: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
es.c: 通告发布的时机很合适。

es.e: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
es.c: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

es.e: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
es.c: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

d: adj 在内的；内部的，内地的，国内的 inside or indoors；n 内部 the inner part or inside of something

es.e: The interior walls are all painted white.
es.c: 室内墙壁都粉刷成了白色。

d: n 泡沫，浮垢，糟粕，渣滓 an unpleasant dirty substance that forms on the surface of water

es.e: a pond covered with green scum
es.c: 漂满绿色浮沫的池塘

d: n 订婚；约会，交战 an agreement between two people to marry, or the period of time they are engaged

es.e: Their engagement was announced in the paper.
es.c: 他们订婚的消息在报上公布了。

es.e: Tony was stunned when Lisa suddenly broke off their engagement (= finished it ).
es.c: 托尼对莉萨突然解除他俩的婚约感到震惊。

d: n 陷阱；圈套；双轮轻便马车 a piece of equipment for catching animals

es.e: The only way to catch mice is to set a trap .
es.c: 抓老鼠的唯一办法就是放置捕鼠器。

es.e: He stepped into a bear trap covered in snow.
es.c: 他踩到了埋在雪里的一个捕熊夹。

d: v 超出，超过 to go beyond the usual limits of something

es.e: The desire for peace transcended political differences.
es.c: 对和平的渴望超越了政治分歧。

d: n 情况，形势；环境；事件 the conditions that affect a situation, action, event etc

es.e: The Soviet Union had been forced by circumstances to sign a pact with Nazi Germany.
es.c: 苏联为形势所迫同纳粹德国签订了一项条约。

es.e: I can’t imagine a circumstance in which I would be willing to steal.
es.c: 我无法想象我在什么情况下会愿意去偷东西。

d: v 授权 to give official permission for something

es.e: an authorized biography
es.c: 授权传记

d: n 细颈瓶，扁形酒瓶 a  hip flask

es.e: He took out a metal flask from a canvas bag.
es.c: 他从帆布袋里拿出了一个金属水瓶。

d: adj 自发的；自然产生的 something that is spontaneous has not been planned or organized, but happens by itself, or because you suddenly feel you want to do it

es.e: The crowd gave a spontaneous cheer.
es.c: 人群自发地欢呼起来。

es.e: My spontaneous reaction was to run away.
es.c: 我的本能反应就是逃跑。

d: n 处罚，惩罚 a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or legal agreement

es.e: No littering. Penalty $500.
es.c: 禁止乱扔垃圾。 违者罚款500美元。

es.e: Withdrawing the money early will result in a 10% penalty.
es.c: 提前支取这笔钱将被处以10%的罚金。

es.e: If he is convicted, he could receive the death penalty (= be killed as a punishment ) .
es.c: 一旦定罪，他可能会被判处死刑。

d: v 设防于；增强 to make someone feel physically or mentally stronger

es.e: The town was heavily fortified.
es.c: 该镇设有重防。

d: n 季风，雨季 the season, from about April to October, when it rains a lot in India and other southern Asian countries

es.e: ...the end of the monsoon.
es.c: …雨季的结束。

d: n 回顾；回想 thinking back to a time in the past, especially with the advantage of knowing more now than you did then

es.e: In retrospect, I wonder if we should have done more.
es.c: 回过头看，我在想我们是否应该做得更多些。

d: v vi吐(唾沫) to force something out of your mouth

es.e: Billy stood up slowly, rubbed his jaw, and spat blood.
es.c: 比利慢慢站起来，揉揉下巴，吐了口血。

d: n 疏忽，粗心大意 failure to take enough care over something that you are responsible for

es.e: negligence in carrying out safety procedures
es.c: 执行安全程序时的疏忽

es.e: The bridge’s architect was sued for criminal negligence.
es.c: 那座桥梁的建筑师被控犯有玩忽职守罪。

d: n&vt 养老金，退休金；给予养老金 an amount of money paid regularly by the government or company to someone who does not work any more, for example because they have reached the age when people stop working or because they are ill

es.e: At what age can you start drawing your pension ?
es.c: 从多少岁可以开始领取养老金？
