es.e: I couldn’t look after him any more; the strain was too much for me.
es.c: 我不能再照看他了，压力太大。

es.e: Did you find the job a strain ?
es.c: 你觉得这份工作紧张吗？

es.e: the stresses and strains of police life
es.c: 警察生活的紧张和压力

d: v 啃，一点一点咬 to eat small amounts of food by taking very small bites

es.e: He nibbled the biscuit cautiously.
es.c: 他小心地啃着饼干。

d: n&vt 同盟者，伙伴；结盟 a country that agrees to help or support another country in a war

es.e: a meeting of the European allies
es.c: 欧洲盟国会议

d: v 使便利

es.e: Modern inventions facilitate housework.
es.c: 许多现代发明便利了家务劳动。

es.e: All of these agencies and people either complement or facilitate our work, or express the health needs of populations.
es.c: 所有这些机构和人士要么补充或便利我们的工作，要么表达人民的卫生需求。

d: n 嫩枝, 细枝 " a small very thin stem of wood that grows from a branch on a tree

es.e: There is the bird, sitting on a twig halfway up the tree.
es.c: 鸟儿在那里，栖息在树中段的一根细枝上。

d: v 张口，张开，裂开 If you say that something such as a hole or a wound gapes, you are emphasizing that it is big or wide；n 目瞪口呆

es.e: The front door was missing. A hole gaped in the roof.
es.c: 前门没有了，屋顶裂开一个洞。

d: adj 宽敞的，丰富的 large in a way that is attractive or pleasant

es.e: an ample bosom
es.c: 丰满的胸部

d: n 偶然，偶然事件

es.e: a contingency plan
es.c: 应变计划

d: n 有效，正当

es.e: So that satisfies the definition of validity.
es.c: 所以这满足了有效性的定义。

es.e: Does this argument satisfy the definition of validity or does it not?
es.c: 这个论点满足有效性的定义吗？,还是不满足？

es.e: While each of these might have some validity, in many cases the same general comments may also apply to many of the other projects you work on.
es.c: 尽管其中每个问题可能具有某些正确性，但是在许多情况下，一般性评论还可能适用于您从事的其他项目。

d: adj 单调的，无变化的 boring because of always being the same

es.e: a monotonous diet
es.c: 单调的饮食

es.e: a little boy who wet his bed with monotonous regularity
es.c: 一个老是尿床的小男孩

d: v&n 剥皮；皮 to remove the skin from fruit or vegetables

es.e: Peel and dice the potatoes.
es.c: 把马铃薯去皮并切成丁。

d: v 放，放置，安置；下蛋 to put someone or something down carefully into a flat position

es.e: He laid his hand on my shoulder.
es.c: 他把一只手搭在我的肩上。

es.e: They laid a wreath at the place where so many people died.
es.c: 他们在这么多人丧生的地方放了一个花圈。

es.e: Lay the material flat on the table.
es.c: 把布料平铺在桌上。

d: v 扑向，欣然接受；n 跳，跃 a big jump

es.e: He threw a stick into the river and the dog went after it in a flying leap.
es.c: 他把一根枝条扔到河里，那条狗一个飞跃就追了过去。

d: v 使成为必需 to make it necessary for you to do something

es.e: Lack of money necessitated a change of plan.
es.c: 由于缺乏资金，只能改变计划。

d: n 定罪；深信 a very strong belief or opinion

es.e: It was a reasonable explanation, but his voice lacked conviction .
es.c: 这解释合情合理，只是他的语气不坚定。

d: n&v 畏惧；恐惧 to feel anxious or worried about something that is going to happen or may happen

es.e: I’ve got an interview tomorrow and I’m dreading it.
es.c: 明天我要去面试，我正担心呢。

d: n 手迹，笔迹; 手稿; 剧本 writing done by hand

es.e: a diary entry written in neat black script
es.c: 用工整的黑色字写下的一则日记

d: v 把奉献给 If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it

es.e: He decided to devote the rest of his life to scientific investigation.
es.c: 他决定把余生奉献给科学研究。

es.e: Considerable resources have been devoted to proving him a liar.
es.c: 大量的资源已被用来证明他是个撒谎者。

d: adj 超声的，超声速的 faster than the speed of sound

es.e: supersonic aircraft
es.c: 超音速飞机

d: n 鳞；尺度；等级；比例规模；天平 the size or level of something, or the amount that something is happening

es.e: A structural survey revealed the full scale of the damage.
es.c: 结构检验揭示了实际受损程度。

es.e: I was shocked by the sheer scale (= very big scale ) of the destruction.
es.c: 破坏程度之大让我大为震惊。

es.e: Large firms benefit from economies of scale (= ways of saving money because they are big ) .
es.c: 大公司从规模经济中得益。

d: n&a 外侨；外国人的；不相容的 someone who is not a legal citizen of the country they are living or working in

es.e: illegal aliens entering the country.
es.c: 非法入境的外国人

d: n (plaxes)轴，轴心 the imaginary line around which a large round object, such as the Earth, turns

es.e: The Earth rotates on an axis between the north and south poles.
es.c: 地球绕着南北两极之间的地轴自转。

d: adj 说话流利的，(演说等)流畅的 able to speak a language very well

es.e: He spoke in fluent Italian.
es.c: 他用流利的意大利语讲话。

d: n&v 设计，构思；设计制图术 the art or process of making a drawing of something to show how you will make it or what it will look like

es.e: The new plane is in its final design stage.
es.c: 这种新型飞机正处于最后的设计阶段。

es.e: the design process
es.c: 设计过程

es.e: the design team
es.c: 设计团队

d: adj 世间的；世俗的 concered with ordinary daily life rather than religious matters

es.e: Initially, the work was pretty mundane.
es.c: 刚开始，这工作非常乏味。

d: vt&vi 收回，取回；撤回；撤退 to stop taking part in an activity, belonging to an organization etc, or to make someone do this

es.e: calls for Britain to withdraw from the European Union
es.c: 要求英国退出欧盟的呼声

d: v 使同时发生，使同步发生 to happen at exactly the same time, or to arrange for two or more actions to happen at exactly the same time

es.e: It was virtually impossible to synchronize our lives so as to take vacations and weekends together.
es.c: 为了一起度假和过周末而要让我们的生活同步几乎是不可能的。

d: adj 个人的，个别的；个体的 considered separately from other people or things in the same group；n 个人，个体 a person, considered separately from the rest of the group or society that they live in

es.e: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
es.c: 树上每片叶子都不相同。

es.e: the needs of the individual customer
es.c: 每位顾客的需求

d: v 冒险；得起；供给 to provide something or allow something to happen

es.e: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
es.c: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

es.e: The new law will afford protection to employees.
es.c: 新法律将为雇员提供保障。

d: adj 明亮的；轻的；不重要的 if it is light, there is the natural light of day；n 光，光线 the time when light first appears in the morning sky

es.e: We’ll keep on looking while it’s still light.
es.c: 我们会趁天亮继续寻找。

es.e: It was seven o’clock and just starting to get light.
es.c: 那是早上7点钟，天刚蒙蒙亮。

d: adj 察觉得到的，看得出的 something that is perceptible can be noticed, although it is very small

es.e: a small but perceptible change
es.c: 微小但可以察觉的变化

es.e: The sound was barely perceptible .
es.c: 那声音几乎听不见。

d: n 奢侈，奢侈品 very great comfort and pleasure, such as you get from expensive food, beautiful houses, cars etc

es.e: He was leading a life of luxury in Australia.
es.c: 他在澳大利亚过着豪华舒适的生活。

es.e: The dress is lambswool – pure luxury.
es.c: 礼服是用羔羊毛制作的——绝对奢华。

d: v 得到，起源于 to get something, especially an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from something

es.e: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
es.c: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

d: adj 执行的，行政的 relating to the job of managing a business or organization and making decisions；n 行政部门，行政人员 the part of a government that makes sure decisions and laws work well

es.e: a commission with executive powers
es.c: 有执行权的委员会

d: v 鸟高飞，翱翔；[喻]高涨，猛增 to increase quickly to a high level

es.e: Her temperature soared.
es.c: 她的体温骤然升高。

es.e: The price of petrol has soared in recent weeks.
es.c: 最近几个星期汽油价格猛涨。

es.e: soaring unemployment
es.c: 急剧上升的失业率

d: n 丰富 a large quantity of something

es.e: This area of Mexico has an abundance of safe beaches and a pleasing climate.
es.c: 墨西哥的这个地区有大量的安全沙滩与宜人的气候。

d: adj 敏感的；易受感动的 likely to suffer from a particular illness or be affected by a particular problem

es.e: A lot of TV advertising is aimed at susceptible young children.
es.c: 很多电视广告瞄准了易受影响的幼儿。

d: adj 自动的，无意识的 an automatic machine is designed to work without needing someone to operate it for each part of a process；n 小型自动武器 a weapon that can fire bullets continuously

es.e: an automatic weapon
es.c: 自动武器

es.e: an automatic gearbox
es.c: 自动变速箱

es.e: My camera is fully automatic .
es.c: 我的照相机是全自动的。

d: adj 腐败的，贪污的 using your power in a dishonest or illegal way in order to get an advantage for yourself；v (使)腐败，贿赂 to encourage someone to start behaving in an immoral or dishonest way

es.e: Corrupt judges have taken millions of dollars in bribes.
es.c: 腐败的法官接受了几百万美元的贿赂。

d: adj 多边的；多国参加的 involving several different countries or groups

es.e: a multilateral arms treaty
es.c: 多边军火协定

d: v 精确地表达；制订；用公式表示

es.e: We are studying the situation but have not formulated any response yet.
es.c: 我们正在研究形势，但尚未考虑好如何回应。

d: n 刻面，(问题的)一个方面 one of several parts of someone’s character, a situation etc

es.e: The issues are complex and multi-faceted.
es.c: 这些问题很复杂，涉及诸多方面。

d: v 代替 if a new idea, product, or method supersedes another one, it becomes used instead because it is more modern or effective

es.e: Their map has since been superseded by photographic atlases.
es.c: 他们的地图从此被摄影地图册取代。

d: adj 敌对的，敌方的，不友好的 angry and deliberately unfriendly towards someone, and ready to argue with them

es.e: Southampton fans gave their former coach a hostile reception .
es.c: 南安普敦队的球迷对球队的前任教练很不友善。

es.e: Carr wouldn’t meet Feng’s stare, which was openly hostile .
es.c: 卡尔不愿意面对冯公然敌视的目光。

es.e: his hostile attitude
es.c: 他敌对的态度

d: n 独唱，独奏 a piece of music for one performer

es.e: a gorgeous piano solo
es.c: 一首极其美妙的钢琴独奏曲

d: adj 残忍的，无情的 so determined to get what you want that you do not care if you have to hurt other people in order to do it

es.e: a ruthless dictator
es.c: 无情的独裁者

es.e: They have shown a ruthless disregard for basic human rights.
es.c: 他们冷酷地无视基本人权。

d: vi&n 咔嗒一声 to make a short hard sound, or make something produce this sound

es.e: The door clicked shut behind me.
es.c: 门在我身后咔嗒一声关上了。

es.e: Mother clicked her tongue (= made a short sound to show disapproval ) and sighed.
es.c: 妈妈咂咂嘴，叹了口气。

es.e: Edmund clicked his fingers (= made a short sound to get someone’s attention ) for John to follow him.
es.c: 埃德蒙弹了个响指示意约翰跟着他。

d: v 争论，争义，斗争；n 争夺，竞争；比赛 a competition or a situation in which two or more people or groups are competing with each other

es.e: His wife is contesting a seat on the council.
es.c: 他妻子在角逐市政会的一个席位。

d: adj 令人愉快的；乐于同意的 pleasant

es.e: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
es.c: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

es.e: an agreeable young man
es.c: 一个讨人喜欢的年轻人

d: n 管；(伦敦)地下铁道 a round pipe made of metal, glass, rubber etc, especially for liquids or gases to go through

es.e: a tube of toothpaste
es.c: 一管牙膏

d: v&n 繁荣，挥舞 to develop well and be successful

es.e: The economy is booming and small businesses are flourishing.
es.c: 经济繁荣，小企业蒸蒸日上。

d: v 发现，发觉；侦察 to notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear etc

es.e: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
es.c: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

d: vt&vi (尤指金属表面)失去光泽；玷污 if an event or fact tarnishes someone’s  reputation  , record, image etc, it makes it worse

es.e: His regime was tarnished by human rights abuses.
es.c: 他的政权因践踏人权而形象受损。

d: adj 伪造的 made to look exactly like something else, in order to deceive people；n 伪造 Counterfeit is also a noun；v 伪造，仿造 to copy something exactly in order to deceive people

es.e: He admitted possessing and delivering counterfeit currency.
es.c: 他承认持有和运送了假币。

es.e: Levi Strauss says counterfeits of the company's jeans are flooding Europe.
es.c: 利瓦伊·斯特劳斯说该公司牛仔裤的仿冒品充斥着欧洲市场。

d: v&n 嚼；咀嚼 to bite food several times before swallowing it

es.e: This meat’s so tough I can hardly chew it!
es.c: 这肉太老了，我几乎嚼不动！

d: v 狼吞虎咽地吃；挥霍，耗尽 to eat something quickly because you are very hungry

es.e: The boys devoured their pancakes.
es.c: 男孩子们狼吞虎咽地把薄煎饼吃了。

d: n 犯罪；冒犯；攻击
n 条款，项目，一条(新闻) a single thing, especially one thing in a list, group, or set of things

es.e: He opened the cardboard box and took out each item.
es.c: 他打开纸板箱把里面的物品一一拿出来。

es.e: The store is having a sale on furniture and household items.
es.c: 这家商店正在减价出售家具和家居用品。

es.e: luxury items such as exotic spices and perfumes
es.c: 异国香料和香水之类的奢侈品

d: n 信任，信心，自信 the feeling that you can trust someone or something to be good, work well, or produce good results；adj 骗得信任的

es.e: I felt I was doing well and my confidence began to grow.
es.c: 我觉得自己干得不错，自信心就开始增加了。

d: adj 温暖而舒适的，安逸的 a place that is cosy is small, comfortable, and warm

es.e: The living room was warm and cosy .
es.c: 客厅暖和又舒适。

d: n&v 吸，舔 to take air, liquid etc into your mouth by making your lips form a small hole and using the muscles of your mouth to pull it in

es.e: They waited in silence and sucked their sweets.
es.c: 他们静静地等着，吮着糖果。

d: n 职业；雇用；使用 the act of paying someone to work for you

es.e: She was offered employment in the sales office.
es.c: 她获聘在销售部工作。

d: v 改进，修正 to correct or make small changes to something that is written or spoken

es.e: The law was amended to include women.
es.c: 该法律经修改把女性也包括在内。

es.e: The defendant later amended his evidence.
es.c: 被告后来修改了证词。

es.e: ‘Steve stole it – or rather borrowed it,’ he amended.
es.c: “史蒂夫偷的——应该说是借的。”他改口道。

d: v 使现代化；使靠最近 to make something more modern in the way it looks or operates

es.e: plans to update manufacturing procedures
es.c: 更新生产流程的计划

d: n 报仇 a violent or harmful action that someone does to punish someone for harming them or their family

es.e: a desire for vengeance
es.c: 复仇的愿望

es.e: a vow of vengeance
es.c: 复仇的誓言

es.e: an act of vengeance
es.c: 复仇的行为

d: n 因素，要素 one of several things that influence or cause a situation

es.e: The rise in crime is mainly due to social and economic factors.
es.c: 犯罪率上升主要由社会和经济因素造成。

d: v 取消；流产 to deliberately end a  pregnancy  when the baby is still too young to live

es.e: The disease causes pregnant animals to abort.
es.c: 这种疾病会导致怀孕的动物流产。

d: n 替罪羊 someone who is blamed for something bad that happens, even if it is not their fault

es.e: I don't think I deserve to be made the scapegoat for a couple of bad results.
es.c: 我认为我不该为出现的一些不良后果充当替罪羊。

d: adj 壮观的，气势雄伟的 large, impressive, and appearing important

es.e: an imposing building
es.c: 宏伟的建筑

es.e: He’s a tall, quietly spoken, but imposing figure.
es.c: 他高高的个子，说话轻声细语，但气宇轩昂。

d: n (道路，桥梁)通行费；损失，代价；税收 the money you have to pay to use a particular road, bridge etc

es.e: You can pay a toll to drive on Pike's Peak Highway or relax and take the Pike's Peak Cog Railway.
es.c: 你可以付通行费开车上派克斯峰公路，或者放松一下，乘坐派克斯峰齿轨式火车。

d: v 激怒；使烦躁，使感到不适 to make someone feel annoyed or impatient, especially by doing something many times or for a long period of time

es.e: It really irritates me when he doesn’t help around the house.
es.c: 家里的事情他一点都不帮忙，真让我恼火。

d: n 暗杀 the act of murdering an important person

es.e: He narrowly escaped an assassination attempt (=  when someone tries but fails to kill someone else  ) .
es.c: 他在一次暗杀行动中死里逃生。

d: adj 主观的 a state-ment, report, attitude etc that is subjective is influenced by personal opinion and can therefore be unfair

es.e: As a critic, he is far too subjective.
es.c: 作为评论家，他过于主观。

es.e: a highly subjective point of view
es.c: 相当主观的看法

d: n 外科，外科手术 medical treatment in which a surgeon cuts open your body to repair or remove something inside

es.e: Dr. Hanson is in surgery.
es.c: 汉森医生在手术室。

d: n 牛轭；枷锁；纽带 a wooden bar used for keeping two animals together, especially cattle, when they are pulling heavy loads

es.e: People are still suffering under the yoke of slavery.
es.c: 人们仍然生活在奴隶制的枷锁之下。

d: vt&vi [数]乘；增加，增多；繁殖 to increase by a large amount or number, or to make something do this

es.e: The amount of information available has multiplied.
es.c: 可获得的信息大大增加了。

es.e: Smoking multiplies the risk of heart attacks and other health problems.
es.c: 吸烟大大增加了患心脏病和其他疾病的危险性。

d: v 击败，推翻，使毁灭 to remove a leader or government from power, especially by force

es.e: Rebels were already making plans to overthrow the government.
es.c: 反叛者已在密谋颠覆政府。

d: v 浸，使浸透；淋湿 if you soak something, or if you let it soak, you keep it covered with a liquid for a period of time, especially in order to make it softer or easier to clean

es.e: Soak the clothes in cold water.
es.c: 把衣服浸泡在冷水里。

es.e: Let the pans soak; I’ll wash them later.
es.c: 把锅泡着吧，我过一会儿再洗。

d: v 平衡，保持平衡 to put or hold something in a carefully balanced position, especially above something else；n 泰然自若，自信 a calm confident way of behaving, combined with an ability to control your feelings or reactions in difficult

es.e: Louisa seems to have much more poise and confidence.
es.c: 路易莎似乎更加沉着自信了。

d: adj 临时的，暂时的 intended to be used or accepted for a short time only, until something or someone final can be made or found

es.e: an interim report
es.c: 中期报告

es.e: He received an interim payment of £10,000.
es.c: 他收到暂时支付的一万英镑。

es.e: An interim government was established.
es.c: 一个临时政府成立了。

d: adj 迅速的 done quickly, immediately, or at the right time；v 敦促 to make someone decide to do something

es.e: Prompt action must be taken.
es.c: 必须立即采取行动。

es.e: Prompt payment is requested.
es.c: 请立即付款。

es.e: a prompt response
es.c: 迅速的答复

d: v 鼓掌欢迎；赞成 to hit your open hands together, to show that you have enjoyed a play, concert, speaker etc

es.e: The audience applauded loudly.
es.c: 观众掌声雷动。

es.e: A crowd of 300 supporters warmly applauded her speech.
es.c: 300名支持者为她的演讲热烈鼓掌。

d: adj 充分的；可胜任的 enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose

es.e: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
es.c: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

es.e: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
es.c: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

es.e: The standard of his work is barely adequate .
es.c: 他的工作水准勉强合格。

d: v 详述；引申；增强 to increase the effects or strength of something

es.e: These stories only amplified her fears.
es.c: 这些故事徒增了她的恐惧感。

d: v 抱紧，坚守 If someone clings to a position or a possession they have, they do everything they can to keep it even though this may be very difficult

es.e: Instead, he appears determined to cling to power.
es.c: 反而，他看来坚决要握紧权力不放。

es.e: Another congressman clung on with a majority of only 18.
es.c: 另一位国会议员在获得仅仅18张多数票的情况下保住了位子。

d: n&v 监狱; 监禁 a place where criminals are kept as part of their punishment, or where people who have been charged with a crime are kept before they are judged in a law court

es.e: He’s been in jail for three months already.
es.c: 他已经入狱三个月。

d: n 似是而非的论点；看似悖谬实则正确的观点 a statement that seems impossible because it contains two opposing ideas that are both true

es.e: The paradox is that fishermen would catch more fish if they fished less.
es.c: 悖论就是: 如果渔夫减少捕鱼，反而会打到更多的鱼。

d: n (鸟兽)群，一群人；群集 a group of sheep, goats, or birds

es.e: They kept a small flock of sheep.
es.c: 他们养了一小群绵羊。

d: v 转向 to change the direction in which something travels

es.e: The high street is closed and traffic is being diverted .
es.c: 大街封闭，车辆正改道而行。

d: n 污秽，淫猥 very offensive language, stories, or pictures about sex

es.e: I don’t know how you can watch that filth!
es.c: 我不知道你怎么会看那种淫秽的东西！

d: v 询问，打听

es.e: I am writing to confirm /enquire/inform you…
es.c: 我写信是要确认/询问/通知你…

es.e: I recently e-mailed one website to enquire why my goods had not yet arrived.
es.c: 我最近给一个网站发邮件去询问为什么我订购的商品还没有到达。

es.e: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
es.c: 你们无论进那一城，那一村，要打听那里谁是好人，就住在他家，直住到走的时候。

d: n 急速，仓促 great speed in doing something, especially because you do not have enough time

es.e: I soon regretted my haste.
es.c: 我很快就对自己的仓促感到后悔。

d: adj 有吸引力的，讨人喜欢的 someone who is attractive is good looking, especially in a way that makes you sexually interested in them

es.e: an attractive young woman
es.c: 妩媚动人的年轻女子

es.e: Women seem to find him attractive .
es.c: 女性似乎觉得他很有吸引力。

d: n 种植园 a large area of land in a hot country, where crops such as tea, cotton, and sugar are grown

es.e: a rubber plantation
es.c: 橡胶园

d: v 开垦，开拓；要求归还 to make an area of desert, wet land etc suitable for farming or building

es.e: This land will be reclaimed for a new airport.
es.c: 这块土地将被开发用来建新机场。

d: vt&vi 使混乱；弄糟 to put things in the wrong order

es.e: Someone’s muddled up all the papers on my desk.
es.c: 有人把我桌上的文件全都弄乱了。

es.e: The government seems to have lost its way and muddled its priorities.
es.c: 政府似乎迷失了方向，分不清轻重缓急。

d: adj 金属的 a metallic noise sounds like pieces of metal hitting each other

es.e: The key turned in the lock with a loud metallic click.
es.c: 钥匙在锁里转动发出金属撞击的咔嗒声。

es.e: The pans made a metallic clatter as they crashed to the floor.
es.c: 那些锅哐啷一声摔到地上。

d: adj 明显的，清楚的 easy to notice or understand

es.e: The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less.
es.c: 减少污染显而易见的办法就是少用汽车。

d: n 思想感情；情操；情绪 A sentiment that people have is an attitude which is based on their thoughts and feelings

es.e: Public sentiment rapidly turned anti-American.
es.c: 公众的情绪迅速转向反美。

es.e: He's found growing sentiment for military action.
es.c: 他已经发现支持军事行动的情绪在日益增长。

d: v 使烦恼, 折磨，骚扰" to make someone’s life unpleasant, for example by frequently saying offensive things to them or threatening them

es.e: A number of black youths have complained of being harassed by the police.
es.c: 一些黑人青年投诉称受到警察骚扰。

d: v 强迫；限制；克制 to limit something

es.e: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
es.c: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

es.e: Women’s employment opportunities are often severely constrained by family commitments.
es.c: 女性的就业机会常常受到家庭责任的严重限制。

d: adj 不幸的，可怜的；令人难受的 someone who is wretched is very unhappy or ill, and you feel sorry for them

es.e: the poor, wretched girl
es.c: 极其不幸的可怜姑娘

d: v 怨恨 to feel angry or upset about a situation or about something that someone has done, especially because you think that it is not fair

es.e: Paul resented the fact that Carol didn’t trust him.
es.c: 保罗非常气愤，因为卡萝尔不信任他。

d: n 犯罪，犯规；冒犯 an illegal action or a crime

es.e: His solicitor said he committed the offence because he was heavily in debt.
es.c: 他的律师说他犯罪是因为欠下巨债。

d: v without You can use go with words like "further" and "beyond" to show the degree or extent of something；sth在缺少 的情况下勉强对付

es.e: The governor went further by agreeing that all policy announcements should be made first in the House.
es.c: 该州长进一步同意所有政策的宣布都应首先在议院进行。

d: adj 精确的 precise information, details etc are exact, clear, and correct

es.e: precise sales figures
es.c: 准确的销售数据

es.e: It was difficult to get precise information.
es.c: 很难得到确切的消息。

es.e: ‘She’s a lot older than you, isn’t she?’ ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .’
es.c: “她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

d: v 与…互搭，与重叠，与部分相同 If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

es.e: When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
es.c: 把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。

es.e: Overlap the slices carefully so there are no gaps.
es.c: 把薄片小心地叠放在一起，那样就没有间隙。

d: n 一系列事件中的一个事件 a television or radio programme that is one of a series of programmes in which the same story is continued each week

es.e: Watch next week’s thrilling episode!
es.c: 请收看下周精彩的一集！

d: n 恶意，怨恨 the desire to harm someone because you hate them

es.e: James bore her no malice (= did not feel any malice towards her ) .
es.c: 詹姆斯对她并无恶意。

d: adj 可口的，美味的；惬意的 palatable food or drink has a pleasant or acceptable taste

es.e: a very palatable wine
es.c: 口感极佳的酒

d: v 雕刻；切(熟肉等) to make an object or pattern by cutting a piece of wood or stone

es.e: carved wooden chairs
es.c: 木雕椅子

d: n 智力，心理状态 a particular attitude or way of thinking, especially one that you think is wrong or stupid

es.e: a get-rich-quick mentality
es.c: 一夜暴富的心态

es.e: I can’t understand the mentality of the people who are behind this kind of violence.
es.c: 我不能理解这种暴力行为的幕后指使者是什么心态。

d: n 陈述，主张；报价 A proposition is a statement or an idea that people can consider or discuss to decide whether it is true

es.e: The proposition that democracies do not fight each other is based on a tiny historical sample.
es.c: 民主国家间互不交战的观点是基于一个微不足道的历史实例。

d: adj 陡峭的 a road, hill etc that is steep slopes at a high angle

es.e: The road became rocky and steep.
es.c: 路变得崎岖陡峭起来。

es.e: a steep climb to the top
es.c: 到山顶的一段陡坡

d: v 免费搭乘他人便车 If you hitchhike, you travel by getting rides from passing vehicles without paying

es.e: Neff hitchhiked to New York during his Christmas holiday.
es.c: 内夫在圣诞节休假期间搭免费便车去了纽约。

d: n 肿瘤 a mass of diseased cells in your body that have divided and increased too quickly

es.e: a brain tumour
es.c: 脑瘤

d: n 联盟，同盟 an arrangement in which two or more countries, groups etc agree to work together to try to change or achieve something

es.e: independent organizations and alliances
es.c: 独立组织和联盟

d: n&a 漂亮(的)，时式(的)
n 命名 取名 单位
vi&n 皱眉，不赞成 to make an angry, unhappy, or confused expression, moving your  eyebrows  together

es.e: She frowned as she read the letter.
es.c: 她看着信皱起了眉头。

d: v 强迫，迫使 to force someone to do something they do not want to do by threatening them

es.e: Potter had argued that the government coerced him into pleading guilty.
es.c: 波特曾争辩说是政府胁迫他认罪。

d: adj 笨重的，不便携带的 heavy and difficult to move

es.e: a large cumbersome machine
es.c: 大而笨重的机器

d: n 信任，信誉；存款；信用贷款 an arrangement with a shop, bank etc that allows you to buy something and pay for it later；v 相信 to believe or admit that someone has a quality, or has done something good

es.e: The store agreed to let him have credit.
es.c: 商店同意他赊购。

es.e: What’s the credit limit on your Visa card?
es.c: 你的维萨卡信用额度是多少？

d: n 韵律，格律；有规律的反复(循环)，周期性 A rhythm is a regular pattern of changes, for example changes in your body, in the seasons, or in the tides

es.e: Begin to listen to your own body rhythms.
es.c: 开始聆听你自己身体的规律性变化。

d: v 碰撞，坠毁，冲过 to have an accident in a car, plane etc by violently hitting something else；n 突然坠落；事故 an accident in which a vehicle violently hits something else

es.e: The jet crashed after take-off.
es.c: 这架喷气式飞机起飞后就坠毁了。

d: adj 单调的，沉闷的 a toneless voice does not express any feelings

es.e: ‘I’m sorry,’ he said, in a flat toneless voice.
es.c: “对不起。”他以淡淡的声调说道。

d: vt&vi 呕吐；大量喷出 to bring food or drink up from your stomach out through your mouth, because you are ill

es.e: He had swallowed so much sea water he wanted to vomit.
es.c: 他呛了这么多海水，所以想吐。

es.e: I knew I was really in trouble when I began vomiting blood.
es.c: 我开始吐血的时候才知道我的麻烦大了。

d: n 电工，电学家 someone whose job is to connect or repair electrical wires or equipment

es.e: I've heard an electrician got hurt when he hiked.
es.c: 我听说有个电工在高空检修电线时摔伤了。

d: a&v 发音清晰的；说话表达力强 to express your ideas or feelings in words

es.e: Many people are unable to articulate the unhappiness they feel.
es.c: 许多人都表达不出内心的痛苦。

d: n 门廊，走廊 an entrance covered by a roof outside the front door of a house or church

es.e: He was standing on the porch, waving as we drove away.
es.c: 我们开车离开的时候，他站在走廊上向我们挥手。

d: n 两星期 two weeks

es.e: a fortnight’s holiday
es.c: 十四天的假期

es.e: in a fortnight’s time
es.c: 两周后

es.e: a fortnight ago
es.c: 两周前

d: v 唤醒；唤起 to wake someone

es.e: His revolutionary work in linguistics has aroused intense scholarly interest.
es.c: 他在语言学方面的革命性著作引起了强烈的学术兴趣。

d: n 战士；拥护者；冠军 someone or something that has won a competition, especially in sport；v 支持，拥护；保卫 to publicly fight for and defend an aim or principle, such as the rights of a group of people

es.e: the world heavyweight boxing champion
es.c: 世界重量级拳击冠军

es.e: the Olympic champion
es.c: 奥运会冠军

d: n&vt 危险，危害，冒险；做出 something that may be dangerous, or cause accidents or problems

es.e: That pile of rubbish is a fire hazard (= something that is likely to cause a fire ).
es.c: 那堆垃圾是火灾隐患。

d: n 条款，从句 a part of a written law or legal document covering a particular subject of the whole law or document

es.e: A confidentiality clause was added to the contract.
es.c: 合同中加上了一项保密条款。

d: adj 热情的，热心的 feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something

es.e: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
es.c: 改革的热心支持者

d: n 起源；原件，原稿 a work of art or a document that is not a copy, but is the one produced by the writer or artist；adj 最初的；有独创性的 existing or happening first, before other people or things

es.e: The colours are much more striking in the original.
es.c: 原作的色彩要鲜艳得多。

es.e: I’ll keep a copy of the contract, and give you the original.
es.c: 我将留一份合同副本，把原件给你。

d: n 产量；产出 the amount of goods or work produced by a person, machine, factory etc

es.e: Output is up 30% on last year.
es.c: 产量比去年提高了30%。

d: adj 似乎有道理的 reasonable and likely to be true or successful

es.e: His story certainly sounds plausible.
es.c: 他的叙述听上去当然很合理。

es.e: a plausible explanation
es.c: 说得过去的解释

d: n 恶心，晕船 the feeling that you have when you think you are going to vomit (= bring food up from your stomach through your mouth )；vt 使恶心

es.e: I was overcome with a feeling of nausea.
es.c: 我感到一阵恶心。

d: n 折扣 a reduction in the usual price of something；v 不全信，低估，漠视

es.e: They are often available at a discount.
es.c: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

d: n 雷，雷声；轰隆声 the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

es.e: We were woken in the night by thunder.
es.c: 晚上我们被雷声惊醒。

d: n 结果，后果 the final result of a meeting, discussion, war etc – used especially when no one knows what it will be until it actually happens

es.e: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
es.c: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

d: n 表面，钟面；拨号盘 the round part of a clock, watch, machine etc that has numbers that show you the time or a measurement；v 打电话

es.e: The lighted dial of her watch said 1.20.
es.c: 她手表上的夜光表面显示时间为1点20分。

es.e: She looked at the dial to check her speed.
es.c: 她看了看仪表盘，以确认自己的速度。

d: adj 机密的；信任的 spoken or written in secret and intended to be kept secret

es.e: a confidential government report
es.c: 一份机密的政府报告

es.e: Doctors are required to keep patients’ records completely confidential .
es.c: 医生必须对病人的病历完全保密。

es.e: The information will be regarded as strictly confidential (= completely confidential ) .
es.c: 这一信息将被视为绝对机密。

d: "n 合页，铰链，关键 a piece of metal fastened to a door, lid etc that allows it to swing open and shut；v 给安铰链,随而定 to attach something, using a hinge；n "
v 崇拜；非常喜爱 to like something very much

es.e: I simply adore chocolate.
es.c: 我简直太喜欢巧克力了。

d: adj 有限的，限定的 having an end or a limit

es.e: the earth’s finite resources
es.c: 地球有限的资源

d: adj 男性的，阳性的 having qualities considered to be typical of men or of what men do

es.e: They’re nice curtains, but I’d prefer something a little more masculine.
es.c: 这些窗帘很好，但我更喜欢男性化一点的。

es.e: She has a very masculine voice.
es.c: 她的嗓音非常男性化。

es.e: Hunting was a typically masculine occupation.
es.c: 打猎是典型的男性消遣活动。

d: v&n 轻声低语；怨言 If you mutter, you speak very quietly so that you cannot easily be heard, often because you are complaining about something

es.e: "God knows," she muttered, "what's happening in that madman's mind."
es.c: “天知道，”她低声抱怨，“那个疯子脑子里正在想什么。”

es.e: She can hear the old woman muttering about consideration.
es.c: 她能听见这老妇人低声说要考虑考虑。

d: n 比赛，比赛会 the people or groups that are competing against you, especially in business or in a sport

es.e: Going to trade fairs is an ideal opportunity to size up the competition .
es.c: 参加商品交易会是估量竞争规模的理想机会。

d: n 接受者 someone who receives something

es.e: ...the largest recipient of U.S. foreign aid.
es.c: …最大的美国对外援助接受方。

d: n&v 禁止贸易 an official order to stop trade with another country

es.e: Several countries embargoed arms shipments to Yugoslavia.
es.c: 好几个国家对南斯拉夫实行武器禁运。

d: adj 数字的，计数的 using a system in which information is recorded or sent out electronically in the form of numbers, usually ones and zeros

es.e: digital TV
es.c: 数字电视

es.e: a digital signal
es.c: 数字信号

es.e: a digital camera
es.c: 数码照相机

d: n 学问；奖学金 an amount of money that is given to someone by an educational organization to help pay for their education

es.e: Her latest publication is a fine piece of scholarship.
es.c: 她最新出版的作品是一部优秀的学术著作。

d: v 把…强加于；征(税)，利用 If you impose your opinions or beliefs on other people, you try and make people accept them as a rule or as a model to copy

es.e: Parents should beware of imposing their own tastes on their children.
es.c: 父母应该提防把自己的兴趣强加给孩子。

d: adj 复杂的 consisting of many different parts and often difficult to understand；n 复合体；变态心理 a large number of things which are closely related

es.e: a complex system of highways
es.c: 复杂的公路网

es.e: Photosynthesis is a highly complex process.
es.c: 光合作用是一个非常复杂的过程。

es.e: Peter seemed to have an instant understanding of the most complex issues.
es.c: 再复杂的问题彼得似乎也是一看就明白。

d: vi&n 同意，允许 permission to do something

es.e: He took the car without the owner’s consent .
es.c: 他没有得到车主的许可就把车开走了。

es.e: Her parents gave their consent to the marriage.
es.c: 她父母同意了这桩婚事。

es.e: A patient can refuse consent for a particular treatment at any time.
es.c: 任何时候病人都可以拒绝同意某一治疗方法。

d: n 吵闹，喧哗 a mixture of loud noises, especially the noise of a lot of people talking at the same time

es.e: the hubbub from the market
es.c: 市场的嘈杂声

d: n 矛；矿井；车辕；轴；光线 a passage which goes down through a building or down into the ground, so that someone or something can get in or out

es.e: a drive shaft
es.c: 驱动轴

d: n 报纸文章的标题；照片说明 A caption is the words printed underneath a picture or cartoon which explain what it is about

es.e: The local paper featured me standing on a stepladder with a caption, "Wendy climbs the ladder to success."
es.c: 当地的报纸刊登了一幅我站在活梯上的特写，下面写着：“温迪登上了成功之梯。”

d: n 港，港口，安全处，避难所 an area of water next to the land where the water is calm, so that ships are safe when they are inside it；v 隐匿，包庇 to protect and hide criminals that the police are searching for

es.e: as they sailed into Portsmouth Harbour
es.c: 当他们驶入朴次茅斯港的时候

d: vt&vi 跌倒，跌落；摇摇欲坠；使倾覆 to fall down quickly and suddenly, especially with a rolling movement

es.e: Oil prices have tumbled.
es.c: 石油价格猛跌。

d: n 洗涤漕 a large open container that you fill with water and use for washing yourself, washing dishes etc

es.e: Dirty plates were piled high in the sink.
es.c: 脏盘子在洗涤槽里堆得很高。

d: n 赞助人；资助人；老顾客，主顾 someone who supports the activities of an organization, for example by giving money

es.e: a wealthy patron
es.c: 富有的赞助人

d: n 流感 a common illness that makes you feel very tired and weak, gives you a sore throat, and makes you cough and have to clear your nose a lot

es.e: Steven’s still in bed with flu .
es.c: 史蒂文患了流感，仍卧病在床。

es.e: She’s got the flu .
es.c: 她得了流感。

es.e: I couldn’t go because I had flu .
es.c: 我得了流感，去不了。

d: n 柱; 柱状物；书报上的栏；纵列 a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a decoration

es.e: He writes a weekly column for ‘The Times’.
es.c: 他每周为《泰晤士报》写一篇专栏文章。

d: v 否决，驳回
n 礼仪, 礼节 " the formal rules for polite behaviour in society or in a particular group

es.e: strict rules of professional etiquette
es.c: 严格的行规

d: v 扣除，减去 to take away an amount or part from a total

es.e: The company deducted this payment from his compensation.
es.c: 公司从他的补偿金中扣除了这笔款项。

d: adj 浓密的，密集的；愚笨的 made of or containing a lot of things or people that are very close together

es.e: a dense rurally-based population
es.c: 居住在乡村的密集人口

d: v (较淡)着色于，染色；使带有气息 to give something a small amount of a particular colour, emotion, or quality

es.e: Pink tinged her cheeks.
es.c: 她面色粉红。

d: adj 适合的，一致的，全等的 fitting together well

es.e: They want to work in an organization whose values are congruent with their own.
es.c: 他们想在一家与他们自己的价值观相同的组织里工作。

d: vi&n 蹲伏 to lower your body close to the ground by bending your knees completely

es.e: He crouched in the shadows near the doorway.
es.c: 他蹲在门道近旁的阴暗处。

es.e: Paula crouched down and held her hands out to the fire.
es.c: 葆拉蹲下来，把手伸向火堆。

d: v 保存，保藏 to protect something and prevent it from changing or being damaged；n 果酱，蜜饯 fruit that is preserved by being cooked with sugar

es.e: We must conserve our woodlands for future generations.
es.c: 我们必须为子孙后代保护林地。

es.e: efforts to conserve fish stocks
es.c: 保护鱼类资源的努力

d: n 华氏温度计 Fahrenheit is also a noun

es.e: He was asked for the boiling point of water in Fahrenheit.
es.c: 有人问他华氏温标下水的沸点。

d: n 市镇自治机关；法人；公司 a big company, or a group of companies acting together as a single organization

es.e: He works for a large American corporation.
es.c: 他在一家美国大公司工作。

es.e: multinational corporations
es.c: 跨国公司

es.e: the Siemens Corporation
es.c: 西门子公司

d: v 熄灭，扑灭 to stop a fire from burning

es.e: a desperate bid to quench the raging flames
es.c: 为扑灭熊熊大火而不顾一切的努力

d: n 警报，惊慌 a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger；v 使忧虑

es.e: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
es.c: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

es.e: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
es.c: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

es.e: a sophisticated alarm system
es.c: 精密的警报系统

d: adj 令人作呕的，令人不快的，下流的 someone who is nasty behaves in an unkind and unpleasant way

es.e: I went to school with him e_SEnD he was nasty then and he’s nasty now.
es.c: 我和他一起上过学他那时很讨厌，现在还是很讨厌。

es.e: You’re a nasty little brute!
es.c: 你这个讨厌的小家伙！

d: n 铁锨，铲 a tool with a rounded blade and a long handle used for moving earth, stones etc；v 铲起 to lift and move earth, stones etc with a shovel

es.e: ...a coal shovel.
es.c: …一把煤铲。

d: adj 可疑的，疑心的 thinking that someone might be guilty of doing something wrong or dishonest

es.e: His reluctance to answer my questions made me suspicious .
es.c: 他不愿回答我的问题，这引起我的怀疑。

es.e: She gave him a suspicious glance.
es.c: 她向他投去怀疑的一瞥。

es.e: You’ve got a very suspicious mind!
es.c: 你真是疑心太重！

d: n 树干；人躯干；大衣箱 the thick central woody stem of a tree

es.e: He left his bicycle leaning against a tree trunk .
es.c: 他把他的自行车斜靠在树干上。

d: n 热烈欢迎，欢呼 if a group of people give someone an ovation, they clap to show approval

es.e: The Chancellor’s entrance was greeted with a standing ovation (= everyone stood up ).
es.c: 总理进来时，全体起立鼓掌欢迎。

es.e: Fans gave the rock group a thunderous ovation.
es.c: 歌迷对这个摇滚乐队报以雷鸣般的掌声。

d: n 马鞍，鞍座；鞍状山脊 a leather seat that you sit on when you ride a horse
n 悲剧；惨事 a very sad event, that shocks people because it involves death

es.e: The tragedy happened as they were returning home from a night out.
es.c: 悲剧发生在他们夜里外出归来的路上。

es.e: Tragedy struck the family when their two-year-old son was killed in an accident.
es.c: 悲剧降临到这个家庭，他们两岁的儿子在一次事故中丧生。

d: n 气象学 the scientific study of weather conditions

es.e: This is a book about meteorology.
es.c: 这本书是讲气象的。

es.e: It plays an increasingly important part in meteorology for cloud, precipitation, hail and thunderstorm detection as well as the navigation of aircraft and ships.
es.c: 它在对云层、降水、冰雹和雷暴的气象探测以及在船舰和飞机的导航中，起着日益重要的作用。

es.e: All of this depends on certain assumptions and the meteorology, the geology and the hydrology of the area plus the contours of the land around this particular power plant.
es.c: 所有的这些都是根据某些假设,和气象状态，地质情况，还有，水文请跨国,在加上土地的等高线,在这个特定的核能电站的周围。

d: v 浸透，浸湿；使满，使饱和 to make something very wet

es.e: Water poured through the hole, saturating the carpet.
es.c: 水从洞里流进来，浸湿了地毯。

d: n 肘；衣服肘部 the joint where your arm bends；v 用肘推、挤 to push someone with your elbows, especially in order to move past them

es.e: He slipped and fell, badly bruising an elbow.
es.c: 他滑倒了，严重挫伤了一只胳膊肘。

d: adj 可怕的，难以对付的 very powerful or impressive, and often frightening

es.e: The building is grey, formidable, not at all picturesque.
es.c: 那幢建筑呈灰色，气势凛然，与漂亮沾不上边。

es.e: The new range of computers have formidable processing power.
es.c: 该系列的新型计算机处理能力惊人。

d: adj 结构的，构造的 connected with the structure of something

es.e: structural changes in the computer industry
es.c: 电脑行业的结构性改变

es.e: The earthquake caused minor structural damage.
es.c: 这次地震造成了轻微的结构破坏。

d: v 点燃，引起，激发 if you kindle a fire, or if it kindles, it starts to burn

es.e: The Second World War kindled his enthusiasm for politics.
es.c: 第二次世界大战激发了他的政治热情。

d: n&v 下降，衰退，减弱；拒绝 If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength

es.e: The number of staff has declined from 217,000 to 114,000.
es.c: 员工人数已从217000人减少到114000人。

es.e: Hourly output by workers declined 1.3% in the first quarter.
es.c: 工人每小时的产量在第1季度下降了1.3%。

d: v 招收，入伍，入学

es.e: The school will enroll new students in August.
es.c: 这所学校将于八月份招收新生.

d: n 斜线，斜度；倾斜面，斜坡 a piece of ground or a surface that slopes

es.e: a steep slope
es.c: 陡坡

es.e: a gentle
es.c: 缓坡

es.e: She looked back up the grassy slope.
es.c: 她回头望了一眼那绿草如茵的坡地。

d: v (使)扩张；膨胀 to swell or make something swell because of pressure from inside

es.e: Through this incision, the abdominal cavity is distended with carbon dioxide gas.
es.c: 通过此切口，二氧化碳气体把胸腔充得肿胀起来。

d: v 发挥，行使，尽力

es.e: He has exerted himself tirelessly on behalf of the charity.
es.c: 他为这个慈善组织奋斗不懈。

d: adj 可见的；明显的 large enough to be noticed or considered important

es.e: There’s no appreciable change in the patient’s condition.
es.c: 病人的状况没有明显改变。

d: n 共计，合计 the total after a lot of different figures or points have been added together

es.e: (=  as a group or in total  ) , women outlive men by 7 or more years.
es.c: 总体来看，女性比男性多活七年或以上。

d: vt&n 渴；渴望 the feeling of wanting or needing a drink

es.e: Ice water is the only thing that really quenches my thirst (= gets rid of it ) .
es.c: 只有冰水才能让我真正解渴。

es.e: We had worked up a thirst (= done something that made us thirsty ) ，and so we decided to stop for a beer.
es.c: 我们干得口渴了，因此决定停下来喝杯啤酒。

es.e: Maggie woke up with a raging thirst (= an extremely strong thirst ) .
es.c: 玛吉醒来时感到口干舌燥。

d: n 飓风 a storm that has very strong fast winds and that moves over water

es.e: The hurricane devastated a large section of the coast.
es.c: 飓风毁坏了沿海地区的大部分。

es.e: The hurricane demage was assessed at three million dollars.
es.c: 飓风损害赔偿金的金额被确定为三百万美元。

es.e: The building can accommodate all of the offshore workers and protect them from hurricane damage.
es.c: 这个建筑能容纳所有的海上工人并且保护他们不受飓风的伤害。

d: n 奇迹 something very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible

es.e: It’s a miracle you weren’t killed!
es.c: 你没有死真是奇迹！

es.e: By some miracle, we managed to catch the plane.
es.c: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

es.e: the economic miracle of the 1950s
es.c: 20世纪50年代的经济奇迹

d: n 恶梦；可怕的经历 A nightmare is a very frightening dream

es.e: All the victims still suffered nightmares.
es.c: 所有的受害者仍为恶梦所扰。

d: adj 对面的；相反的，对立的 as different as possible from something else；prep 在对面 if one thing or person is opposite another, they are facing each other

es.e: I thought the medicine would make him sleep, but it had the opposite effect.
es.c: 我以为这药会让他睡觉，但是它却起了反作用。

es.e: At the opposite extreme, Ashworth’s style is very simple and modern.
es.c: 截然相反的是，阿什沃思的风格非常简单和现代。

es.e: Bob was quicker than Ed? It’s usually the opposite way round.
es.c: 鲍勃比埃德快？通常是反过来的。

d: adj 献身的，一心一意的，热诚的

es.e: a dedicated and thoughtful teacher
es.c: 一位富有敬业精神、待人体贴的教师

d: adj 脆弱的，娇嫩的；温柔的 tender food is easy to cut and eat, especially because it has been well cooked；v 提供，投标 to make a formal offer to do a job or provide goods or services for a particular price

es.e: Continue cooking until the meat is tender.
es.c: 把肉一直烧到松软为止。

d: v 误用，使人堕落 to influence someone so that they begin to think or behave in an immoral way；n 堕落者，反常者 someone whose sexual behaviour is considered unnatural and unacceptable

es.e: TV violence perverts the minds of young children.
es.c: 电视暴力腐蚀了孩子们的心灵。

d: n 白痴 someone who is mentally ill or has a very low level of intelligence

es.e: Are you an idiot?
es.c: 你是一个白痴吗？

d: n 锻工车间，铁匠店 a place where metal is heated and shaped into objects；v 锻造，伪造 to illegally copy something, especially something printed or written, to make people think that it is real

es.e: Someone stole my credit card and forged my signature.
es.c: 有人偷了我的信用卡，并假冒我的签名。

es.e: a forged passport
es.c: 假护照

d: adj 清醒的；故意的 noticing or realizing something

es.e: The driver was still conscious when the ambulance arrived.
es.c: 救护车赶到时，司机仍然神志清醒。

d: adj 简明的，简要的 short, with no unnecessary words

es.e: Your summary should be as clear and concise as possible.
es.c: 你的总结应该尽可能地明白简洁。

d: n 漫画，动画片 a short film that is made by photographing a series of drawings

es.e: cartoon characters such as Donald Duck
es.c: 唐老鸭一类的卡通人物

d: v 超过，赶上；突然降临 to go past a moving vehicle or person because you are going faster than them and want to get in front of them

es.e: He pulled out to overtake the van.
es.c: 他把车驶出所在车道想超过那辆小货车。

es.e: Never try to overtake on a bend.
es.c: 绝不要在转弯处超车。

d: n 布置，设计 the way in which something such as a town, garden, or building is arranged

es.e: All the flats in the building had the same layout.
es.c: 大楼里所有的公寓布局都是一样的。

d: adj 过时的，不流行的 if something is outdated, it is no longer considered useful or effective, because something more modern exists

es.e: outdated teaching methods
es.c: 不合时宜的教学方法

es.e: a factory with outdated equipment
es.c: 设备陈旧的工厂

es.e: His writing style is now boring and outdated.
es.c: 他的写作风格如今已显得乏味而过时了。

d: v&n 叹气 to breathe in and out making a long sound, especially because you are bored, disappointed, tired etc

es.e: ‘Well, there’s nothing we can do about it now,’ she sighed.
es.c: “唉，我们现在对此无能为力。”她叹口气说。

d: adj 随之发生的 happening as a result of a particular event or situation

es.e: the rise in inflation and consequent fall in demand
es.c: 通货膨胀的加剧和随之而来的需求下降

d: n&v 砍，劈；剁 to cut something into smaller pieces

es.e: He went outside to chop some more wood for the fire.
es.c: 他出去再砍些木材来生火。

es.e: Can you chop up some carrots for me?
es.c: 你能帮我切一些胡萝卜吗？

es.e: Add two finely chopped onions and a clove of garlic.
es.c: 加上两个切碎的洋葱和一瓣大蒜。

d: n 阐述，讲解；展览会 a clear and detailed explanation

es.e: Aristotle was valued because of his clear exposition of rational thought.
es.c: 亚里士多德因其对理性思维的清晰阐述而被重视。

d: n 河流等出口，出路；发泄(感情等)的方法 a way of expressing or getting rid of strong feelings

es.e: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.
es.c: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的途径。

d: n 衣柜，衣橱，全部服装；剧服，行头 a piece of furniture like a large cupboard that you hang clothes in

es.e: Can you hang these in the wardrobe, please?
es.c: 请你把这些衣服挂到衣橱里去好吗？

d: n 分子 the smallest unit into which any substance can be divided without losing its own chemical nature, usually consisting of two or more atoms

es.e: The molecules of oxygen gas contain just two atoms.
es.c: 氧分子中只有两个原子。

d: n 碑，书板；药片 a small round hard piece of medicine which you swallow

es.e: She took a couple of headache tablets .
es.c: 她吃了几片头痛药。

d: n 天文台，气象台，了望台 a special building from which scientists watch the moon, stars, weather etc
adj 不同的，清楚的，独特的 clearly different or belonging to a different type

es.e: two entirely distinct languages
es.c: 两种完全不同的语言

d: n 用户电报；直通专用电传 a method of communica-tion, in which messages are written on a special machine and then sent using the telephone network
n 君主，最高统治者；君主政体，君主国 the system in which a country is ruled by a king or queen

es.e: the abolition of the monarchy
es.c: 君主制的废除

d: adj 否定的；消极的；负的；阴性的；底片的 considering only the bad qualities of a situation, person etc and not the good ones

es.e: students with a negative attitude to school
es.c: 对上学抱消极态度的学生

es.e: They have a uniformly negative image of the police.
es.c: 他们都对警察印象不好。

es.e: Jean rarely sounded so negative about her mother.
es.c: 琼很少这么说她母亲不好。

d: v (牲畜)吃草；放牧；擦过(牲畜)n擦伤 to accidentally break the surface of your skin by rubbing it against something

es.e: I fell on the gravel, severely grazing my knee.
es.c: 我摔倒在砾石路上，膝盖擦伤得很严重。

d: v 挨饿 to suffer or die because you do not have enough to eat

es.e: Thousands of people will starve if food doesn’t reach the city.
es.c: 如果食品不能运到那座城市，成千上万的人就要饿死。

es.e: pictures of starving children
es.c: 饥饿儿童的照片

es.e: They’ll either die from the cold or starve to death (= die from lack of food ) .
es.c: 他们要么会冻死，要么会饿死。

d: n 潮汐，(舆论，公众情绪)潮流趋势 the regular rising and falling of the level of the sea

es.e: Is the tide going out or coming in ?
es.c: 现在是退潮还是涨潮？

es.e: We went for a walk and got cut off by the tide .
es.c: 我们去散步，结果被潮水困住了。

d: n 寄生虫，寄生植物；靠他人为生的人 a plant or animal that lives on or in another plant or animal and gets food from it

es.e: Kangaroos harbour a vast range of parasites.
es.c: 袋鼠身上有各种各样的寄生虫。

d: n 层 an amount or piece of a material or substance that covers a surface or that is between two other things

es.e: He pulled off layer upon layer of clothing (= many layers of clothing ).
es.c: 他把衣服一件件地脱掉。

d: vt&vi 加强；巩固 to become stronger or make something stronger

es.e: Our friendship has steadily strengthened over the years.
es.c: 我们的友谊逐年加深。

es.e: Steve’s opposition only strengthened her resolve to go ahead.
es.c: 史蒂夫的反对反而坚定了她继续下去的决心。

es.e: The company plans to strengthen its hand (= make itself more powerful ) in Europe by opening an office in Spain.
es.c: 该公司计划在西班牙设立办事处，以此增强在欧洲的实力。

d: n 流行物，时髦 a popular and fashionable style, activity, method etc

es.e: Suntanning first came into vogue in the mid-1930s.
es.c: 晒黑皮肤最早流行于20世纪30年代中期。

d: adv 然而，不过，仍然 in spite of a fact that you have just mentioned

es.e: What you said was true. It was, nevertheless, a little unkind.
es.c: 你说的都是实话，只不过有点刻薄。

d: n 陈腐思想，陈词滥调
n&v 征收, 征税" to officially say that people must pay a tax or charge

es.e: ...an annual levy on all drivers.
es.c: …向所有司机征收的年税。

d: n 百科全书 a book or cd, or a set of these, containing facts about many different subjects, or containing detailed facts about one subject

es.e: the Encyclopedia of Music
es.c: 音乐百科全书

d: n 排水系统，下水道，排水 the process or system by which water or waste liquid flows away

es.e: A handful of pebbles in the bottom of a flowerpot will help drainage.
es.c: 在花盆底下放一把鹅卵石能够帮助排水。

es.e: a plan to improve the town’s drainage system
es.c: 改善城里排水系统的计划

d: n 地道；隧道 a passage that has been dug under the ground for cars, trains etc to go through

es.e: a railway tunnel
es.c: 铁路隧道

es.e: the Channel Tunnel (= between England and France )
es.c: 〔英吉利〕海峡隧道

d: v 杰出，胜过，优于 to do something very well, or much better than most people

es.e: You have excelled yourself with the new exhibition.
es.c: 你新办的这次展览特别成功。

d: n 周游；电路；协会 the complete circle that an electric current travels

es.e: an electrical circuit
es.c: 电路

d: n 猛推；冲锋，突击；推力 a sudden strong movement in which you push something forward

es.e: He jumped back to avoid another thrust of the knife.
es.c: 他往后一闪，躲避再次捅来的一刀。

d: v 减轻，修改 to make small changes to something in order to improve it and make it more suitable or effective

es.e: The feedback will be used to modify the course for next year.
es.c: 这些反馈意见将用于修改明年的课程。

es.e: The regulations can only be modified by a special committee.
es.c: 这些法规只能由特别委员会来修改。

d: adj 最远的，最大的，极度的 You can use utmost to emphasize the importance or seriousness of something or to emphasize the way that it is done

es.e: It is a matter of the utmost urgency to find out what has happened to these people.
es.c: 当务之急是弄清楚这些人出了什么事。

es.e: Security matters are treated with the utmost seriousness.
es.c: 安全问题受到极为严肃的对待。

d: n 忍耐力，忍耐 the ability to continue doing something difficult or painful over a long period of time

es.e: She was pushed beyond her powers of endurance.
es.c: 她被逼得忍无可忍。

es.e: The marathon is a test of endurance.
es.c: 马拉松赛跑是对耐力的考验。

d: v 爬上，骑上；增加 to increase gradually in amount or degree；n 山 used as part of the name of a mountain

es.e: Tension here is mounting , as we await the final result.
es.c: 我们等待着最终结果，这里的气氛也越来越紧张。

es.e: Casualties on both sides of the battle have continued to mount.
es.c: 交战双方的伤亡人数继续增加。

d: n 一致，合意 an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with or accepts

es.e: The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
es.c: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

es.e: the current consensus of opinion
es.c: 目前观点上的一致

es.e: The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
es.c: 大家都认为科技是好东西。

d: v 强迫服从；实施；加强 to make people obey a rule or law

es.e: Parking restrictions will be strictly enforced.
es.c: 停车限制将会严格执行。

d: n 标签 a small piece of paper, plastic etc attached to something to show what it is, who owns it, what it costs etc

es.e: Staff wore name tags and called inmates by their first names.
es.c: 工作人员戴着姓名标签，对同僚直呼其名。

d: v 承认; 给予 to admit that something is true or correct, although you wish it were not true

es.e: ‘That’s the only possible solution.’ ‘Yes, I suppose so,’ Charles conceded.
es.c: “那是唯一可行的解决办法。”“对，我想是。”查尔斯承认道。

d: n 粗砂；刚毅，勇气 determination and courage；v 铺沙砾于 to scatter grit on a frozen road to make it less slippery

es.e: If they gave gold medals for grit, Karen would be right up there on the winners' podium.
es.c: 如果他们颁发毅力金牌，卡伦应该站在领奖台上。

d: v 升高，抬起，提高 to lift someone or something to a higher position

es.e: Gradually elevate the patient into anupright position.
es.c: 把病人慢慢托到直立的位置。

d: n 地平线，眼界，视野 the line far away where the land or sea seems to meet the sky

es.e: In the distance, the dot of a boat appeared on the horizon.
es.c: 远处小黑点般的一条小船出现在地平线上。

d: v 爬行;缓慢地行进，爬满 to move along on your hands and knees with your body close to the ground；n 爬行；自由泳 a way of swimming in which you lie on your stomach and move one arm, and then the other, over your head

es.e: We crawled into bed at 2 am.
es.c: 我们凌晨两点爬上了床。

d: v 使混合；交往
adj 坚固的，巨大的；富有的 large in amount or number

es.e: We have the support of a substantial number of parents.
es.c: 我们有相当多家长的支持。

es.e: a substantial salary
es.c: 丰厚的薪水

es.e: a substantial breakfast
es.c: 丰盛的早餐

d: adj 很少的，微量的 a marginal change or difference is too small to be important

es.e: a marginal increase in the unemployment figures
es.c: 失业人数的小幅增加

es.e: a marginal improvement in profits
es.c: 利润的小幅提高

d: v 预见，预知 to think or know that something is going to happen in the future

es.e: I’ve put your name on the list and I don’t foresee any problems.
es.c: 我把你的名字写在名单上了，估计不会有什么问题。

es.e: The disaster could not have been foreseen.
es.c: 这场灾难是始料未及的。

d: v 弄脏 to make something dirty, especially with waste from your body；n 泥土 the top layer of the earth in which plants grow

es.e: She moistenend  the soil round the plant.
es.c: 她把植物周围的土壤弄湿。

d: adj 可怕的；糟糕的；极度的 very bad or unpleasant

es.e: The weather was awful.
es.c: 天气很糟糕。

es.e: He is a pretty awful driver.
es.c: 他开车水平相当糟糕。

es.e: That fridge smells awful.
es.c: 那台冰箱气味难闻极了。

d: n 政体，政权；政治制度 a government, especially one that was not elected fairly or that you disapprove of for some other reason

es.e: The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
es.c: 该政权清除了大多数反对者。

d: adj 神的，极好的 coming from or relating to God or a god；v 占卜

es.e: divine power
es.c: 神的力量

es.e: divine love
es.c: 上帝的慈爱

d: v 假定；承担；使用 to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof

es.e: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
es.c: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

es.e: When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
es.c: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

d: n 复活节 a Christian holy day in March or April when Christians remember the death of Christ and his return to life

es.e: on Easter Sunday
es.c: 在复活节星期日

d: v vi粉碎，毁损 to break suddenly into very small pieces, or to make something break in this way

es.e: The explosion shattered the building.
es.c: 这次爆炸把大楼炸成一片废墟。

d: v 打听，询问 to ask someone for information

es.e: ‘Why are you doing that?’ the boy inquired.
es.c: “你为什么这么做？”男孩问道。

es.e: Toby would have liked to inquire further (= ask more questions ).
es.c: 托比本想问更多的问题。

d: n 年金 a fixed amount of money that is paid each year to someone, usually until they die

es.e: He received a paltry annuity of $100.
es.c: 他收到了微不足道的100美元年金。

d: adj 愤世嫉俗的 unwilling to believe that people have good, honest, or sincere reasons for doing something

es.e: a cynical view of human nature
es.c: 认为人性本恶的一种观点

d: v 附加；贴上；盖印 to fasten or stick something to something else；n 词缀 a group of letters added to the beginning or end of a word to change its meaning or use, such as ‘un-’, ‘mis-’, ‘-ness’, or ‘-ly’

es.e: We could reprint at a cost of X, or she had found a service that would affix stickers over the price to correct at a cost of X.
es.c: 我们可以按成本价格重新印刷，这将花费X，或根据她找到的一种修正服务，可以重新粘贴上正确的价格，这将花费X。

d: v 使语言精炼，压缩 to press something or make it smaller so that it takes up less space, or to become smaller

es.e: Light silk is best for parachutes, as it compresses well and then expands rapidly.
es.c: 轻质丝绸最适合制作降落伞，因为这种面料便于压缩，而且展开迅速。

es.e: Isobel nodded, her lips compressed.
es.c: 伊索贝尔紧闭着双唇点了点头。

es.e: The miners used rock drills and compressed air to drive through hard rock.
es.c: 矿工使用钻岩机和压缩空气来凿穿坚硬的岩石。

d: n 边缘，边界 the edge of a road, path etc

es.e: The car skidded across the road and came to a stop on the grass verge.
es.c: 汽车滑过路面，在路缘草带上停了下来。

d: n 面包屑；一点点 a very small piece of dry food, especially bread or cake

es.e: She stood up to brush the crumbs off her uniform.
es.c: 她站起来拂去制服上的面包屑。

es.e: Coat with bread crumbs and bake.
es.c: 涂上面包屑后烘烤。

d: n 食物，营养 food that people or animals need in order to live

es.e: Without sustenance, the animals will soon die.
es.c: 没有食物，动物很快就会死亡。

es.e: Potatoes were their only means of sustenance.
es.c: 马铃薯是他们唯一的食物。

d: v 减少，减小，缩小 to become or make something become smaller or less

es.e: The party’s share of the electorate has diminished steadily.
es.c: 支持这个政党的选民比例持续下降。

es.e: These drugs diminish blood flow to the brain.
es.c: 这些药物会减少流向脑部的血液量。

d: n 旅行计划，旅行日记，旅程 a plan or list of the places you will visit on a journey

es.e: The next place on our itinerary was Sedona.
es.c: 我们旅行计划的下一站是塞多纳。

d: n 展示；一系列 An array of objects is a collection of them that is displayed or arranged in a particular way

es.e: We visited the local markets and saw wonderful arrays of fruit and vegetables.
es.c: 我们参观了当地的市场，看到了漂亮地摆放着的水果蔬菜。

d: n 天文馆 a building where lights on a curved ceiling show the movements of planets and stars

es.e: The motions of the stars can be approximated in a planetarium.
es.c: 星星的运动可在天文馆里模拟。

es.e: Washington lived in an impoverished West Side community and has strong memories of preschool field trips to the library, zoo and planetarium where he learned to love science.
es.c: 华盛顿住在贫困的西部社区，他深深地记得那时候在学前班时的图书馆，动物园和天文馆的活动，在那里，他学会了热爱科学。

es.e: Thecomplex also has Europe’s largest planetarium, an IMAX theater, and an opera house.
es.c: 其综合设施还有欧洲最大的天文馆，IMAX电影院和一个歌剧院。

d: n 腺 an organ of the body which produces a substance that the body needs, such as hormones, sweat, or saliva

es.e: the pituitary gland
es.c: 脑垂体腺

d: adj 优美的，精巧的 extremely beautiful and very delicately made

es.e: the most exquisite craftsmanship
es.c: 最精美的工艺

d: n 代表，代理人 someone who is directly below another person in rank, and who is officially in charge when that person is not there

es.e: His brother was acting as his deputy in America.
es.c: 他的兄弟充当他在美洲的代理人。

d: adj 荒谬的，可笑的 very silly or unreasonable

es.e: That’s a ridiculous idea!
es.c: 那主意很荒唐！

es.e: Don’t be ridiculous!
es.c: 别傻了！

es.e: I’d look ridiculous in a dress like that.
es.c: 我穿那样的裙子会显得很可笑。

d: v 使和解；使复交；调解，调停 to have a good relationship again with someone after you have quarrelled with them

es.e: Jonah and his youngest son were, on the surface at least, reconciled.
es.c: 乔纳和他小儿子和好了，至少表面上如此。

d: n 漏斗，烟囱 a thin tube with a wide top that you use for pouring liquid into a container with a narrow opening, such as a bottle；v 汇集 to send money, information etc from various places to someone

es.e: ...a ship with three masts and two funnels.
es.c: …一艘有3根桅杆和2个烟囱的轮船。

d: n&v 壳，剥壳 the outside structure of something, especially the part of a building that remains when the rest of it has been destroyed

es.e: They cracked the nuts and removed their shells.
es.c: 他们打破坚果并剥掉果壳。

d: adj 简明的，扼要的 clearly expressed in a few words – use this to show approval

es.e: a succinct explanation
es.c: 简明扼要的解释

d: adj 著名的，卓越的 an eminent person is famous, important, and respected

es.e: an eminent lawyer
es.c: 杰出的律师

d: v 压紧，夹住，发生故障，塞进 If something such as a part of a machine jams, or if something jams it, the part becomes fixed in position and is unable to move freely or work properly；n 阻塞物 Jam is also a noun

es.e: The second time he fired his gun jammed.
es.c: 他开第二枪时，枪卡壳了。

es.e: A rope jammed the boat's propeller.
es.c: 一条绳子卡住了船的推进器。

es.e: 400 trucks may sit in a jam for ten hours waiting to cross the limited number of bridges.
es.c: 400 辆卡车可能会堵上10个小时才能通过有限的几座桥。

d: vt&vi 终止，结束 if something terminates, or if you terminate it, it ends

es.e: The court ruled that the contract must be terminated.
es.c: 法庭裁决该合同必须终止。

es.e: a woman’s decision on whether or not to terminate the pregnancy
es.c: 女子关于是否终止妊娠的决定

d: adj 暂时的；临时的 continuing for only a limited period of time

es.e: temporary pain relief
es.c: 疼痛的暂时缓解

es.e: I’m living with my parents, but it’s only temporary.
es.c: 我和父母住在一起，但这只是暂时的。

es.e: You might want to consider temporary work until you decide what you want to do.
es.c: 在你定下来想做什么之前，也许可以考虑干点临时性工作。

d: n&vi 狂怒 a strong feeling of uncontrollable anger

es.e: Sobbing with rage, Carol was taken to the hospital.
es.c: 卡罗尔气得呜呜哭，被送往医院。

es.e: Richens was 17 when he flew into a rage and stabbed another teenager.
es.c: 里琴斯17岁那年一怒之下捅了一名少年。

d: n&v 跨度；跨越 A bridge or other structure that spans something such as a river or a valley stretches right across it

es.e: Travellers get from one side to the other by walking across a footbridge that spans a little stream.
es.c: 旅游者通过一座横跨小溪的人行桥从一边走到另一边。

d: n 方言，俚语 a form of a language which is spoken only in one area, with words or grammar that are slightly different from other forms of the same language

es.e: the local dialect
es.c: 当地方言

d: n 熟练，进步 a good standard of ability and skill

es.e: I brought her proficiency up to the required level.
es.c: 我把她的熟练程度提高到所规定的水平。

es.e: With study and practice, almost anyone can do it with some level of proficiency, but most people don't learn how to think critically or analytically—nor are they even aware of its value.
es.c: 通过学习和实践，几乎任何人都能以不同的熟练程度来掌握它，但是大多数人都不会去学习如何进行批判性或分析性思维，或者说，他们根本意识不到其价值。

es.e: How do you think of your proficiency in written and spoken English?
es.c: 你认为你的书面 英语和 口语熟练程度如何？

d: n 香客，朝圣者 a religious person who travels a long way to a holy place

es.e: pilgrims visiting a holy shrine
es.c: 祭拜圣庙的朝圣者

d: vt&vi 收缩；退缩；畏缩 to become smaller, or to make something smaller, through the effects of heat or water

es.e: I’m worried about washing that shirt in case it shrinks.
es.c: 我不太敢洗那件衬衫，怕它会缩水。

d: n 半径；以半径度量的面积 the distance from the centre to the edge of a circle, or a line drawn from the centre to the edge

es.e: The shock of the explosion was felt over a radius of forty miles.
es.c: 爆炸引起的剧烈震动在方圆40英里内都能感觉得到。

d: n 桨；橹 a long pole with a wide flat blade at one end, used for rowing a boat

es.e: Cold worlds shake from the oar.
es.c: 冰冷的世界从桨上摇落。

es.e: The roaring oar hit the coarse keyboard on the cupboard aboard the boat.
es.c: 轰鸣的桨击中了船上碗柜上的粗糙键盘。

es.e: Suchen never understood what had driven her to grasp the oar at the last moment.
es.c: 苏晨从来没有想明白，是什么驱使她在最后一刻抓住了一条船桨。

d: n 网 the system on the Internet that allows you to find and use information that is held on computers all over the world

es.e: He watched a spider spinning its web.
es.c: 他观察一只蜘蛛织网。

d: n 外交家 someone who officially represents their government in a foreign country

es.e: French diplomats
es.c: 法国外交官

d: n 数据库 a large amount of data stored in a computer system so that you can find and use it easily

es.e: customer details held on a database
es.c: 存储在数据库内的客户详细信息

d: adj 永存的，常务的 permanently agreed or arranged；n 持续，期间；地位 someone’s rank or position in a system, organization, society etc, based on what other people think of them

es.e: You have to pay standing charges whether or not you use the service.
es.c: 无论是否使用这项服务，你都必须一直付费。

es.e: A standing committee was established to coordinate the army and navy.
es.c: 成立了常务委员会以协调陆军和海军。

d: n 地窖；酒窖 a room under a house or other building, often used for storing things

es.e: a coal cellar
es.c: 煤窖

d: v 合作，协作 to work with someone else to achieve something that you both want

es.e: They agreed to co-operate with Brazil on a programme to protect the rain forests.
es.c: 他们同意和巴西合作进行一个保护热带雨林的项目。

d: v 听写，命令，支配 to say words for someone else to write down

es.e: Federal funds have to be used as dictated by Washington.
es.c: 联邦款项得按照华盛顿规定的途径使用。

d: n 党派人士 an adherent or devotee of a cause, party, etc

es.e: a media campaign to represent Democrats as angry partisans
es.c: 把民主党人描述成愤怒的死硬派的媒体宣传

d: vt&vi 除草；除去，剔除 to remove unwanted plants from a garden or other place

es.e: Caspar was weeding the garden.
es.c: 卡斯帕正在给花园除草。

d: n 领袖，部门主任；adj 主要的，首席的 highest in rank

es.e: Most health chiefs believe the reforms have gone too far.
es.c: 大多数卫生部领导人都觉得改革搞得过火了。

d: n (跑道的)一圈；腰以下及大腿的前面部分 the upper part of your legs when you are sitting down

es.e: Rubens Barrichello finished a lap ahead of his team-mate.
es.c: 鲁本斯·巴里切罗领先队友一圈跑完全程。

d: v&n 投降，自首；放弃；屈服 to say officially that you want to stop fighting, because you realize that you cannot win

es.e: Germany surrendered on May 7th, 1945.
es.c: 德国于 1945 年 5 月 7 日投降。

es.e: The terrorists were given ten minutes to surrender.
es.c: 恐怖分子被限定在十分钟之内投降。

d: vt&vi 误解 to have the wrong idea; fail to understand

es.e: Since namely namely misconceive, that explanation clear nice.
es.c: 既然是个误会，那解释清楚就好了。

es.e: Because some designers misconceive Chinese characters, therefore we should use it sensitively and rationally to give the design more persuasion and inspiration.
es.c: 但是设计师在利用汉字时，又存在着种种误区。因此，必须对汉字有足够的感性和理性认识，才能使设计作品更具说服力、感染力。

d: adj 热烈的；热情的 believing or feeling something very strongly and sincerely

es.e: a fervent appeal for peace
es.c: 对和平的强烈呼吁

d: n 通道 a long passage between rows of seats in a church, plane, theatre etc, or between rows of shelves in a shop

es.e: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat (=  seat next to the aisle  ) ?
es.c: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位？

d: n 配置，布局；构造 the shape or arrangement of the parts of something

es.e: ...Stonehenge, in southwestern England, an ancient configuration of giant stones.
es.c: …史前巨石柱群，位于英国西南部，是一座古代巨石阵列。

d: vt&vi 收割，收获 to cut and collect a crop of grain

es.e: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
es.c: 你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

d: n 发射物；导弹 a weapon that can fly over long distances and that explodes when it hits the thing it has been aimed at

es.e: a nuclear missile
es.c: 核导弹

es.e: a missile attack
es.c: 导弹袭击

d: adj 即将来临的；接近的

es.e: He crashed into an oncoming car.
es.c: 他撞上了一辆迎面驶来的汽车。

d: adj 成熟的，充分发展的 someone, especially a child or young person, who is mature behaves in a sensible and reasonable way, as you would expect an adult to behave；v 使成熟，使成长 to become fully grown or developed

es.e: Laura is very mature for her age .
es.c: 相对她的年龄来说劳拉是很成熟的。

es.e: We’re mature enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.
es.c: 我们都很成熟，尽管我们对此事意见不同，但还是彼此尊重。

d: n 的时刻；机会；需要 a suitable or favourable time；v 引起，导致 to cause something

es.e: I often think fondly of an occasion some years ago in New Orleans.
es.c: 我经常深情地想起一些年前在新奥尔良所发生的一幕。

d: adj 自负的，自命不凡的 if someone or something is pretentious, they try to seem more important, intelligent, or high class than they really are in order to be impressive

es.e: a pretentious film
es.c: 矫饰的电影

d: n 不幸，灾难 bad luck, or a situation that results from bad luck

es.e: If by some mischance the government get elected again, I think taxes will rise.
es.c: 如果不幸这届政府再次当选，我想税收会提高。

d: v 征服；攻克 to get control of a country by fighting

es.e: The Normans conquered England in 1066.
es.c: 诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。

es.e: Egypt was conquered by the Persian king Kambyses.
es.c: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

d: v 养育，怀有(希望) to keep a feeling, idea, or belief strong or help it to grow stronger

es.e: We need to nourish our hopes and dreams.
es.c: 我们应该怀有希望和梦想。

d: n 旅游事业 the business of providing things for people to do, places for them to stay etc while they are on holiday

es.e: The country depends on tourism for much of its income.
es.c: 该国的大部分收入依靠旅游业。

d: n 定价，估价；评定的价值 a professional judgment about how much something is worth

es.e: The property has a valuation of $1.6 billion.
es.c: 那处房地产估价为16亿美元。

d: n 妥协，折衷 an agreement that is achieved after everyone involved accepts less than what they wanted at first, or the act of making this agreement；v 妥协；使遭受危害 to reach an agreement in which everyone involved accepts less than

es.e: Compromise is an inevitable part of marriage.
es.c: 妥协是婚姻生活中必不可少的。

es.e: To stop the argument they decided on a compromise.
es.c: 为停止争吵，他们决定作出妥协。

es.e: If moderates fail to reach a compromise , the extremists will dominate the agenda.
es.c: 如果温和派不能达成妥协，激进派就会主宰议事日程。

d: n 盾；保护者，保护物 something that protects a person or thing from harm or damage；v 保护，庇护 to protect someone or something from being harmed or damaged

es.e: He used his left hand as a shield against the reflecting sunlight.
es.c: 他用左手遮挡反射过来的阳光。

d: adj 贪吃的；贪婪的 always wanting more food, money, power, possessions etc than you need

es.e: a greedy and selfish society
es.c: 一个贪婪自私的社会

es.e: He looked at the gold with greedy eyes.
es.c: 他贪婪地看着这些金子。

es.e: Have you eaten them all, you greedy pig?
es.c: 你把那些全吃了？你这贪吃的猪！

d: n&vi 饮食，规定的饮食，忌食 a way of eating in which you only eat certain foods, in order to lose weight, or to improve your health

es.e: Lyn always seems to be on a diet.

es.c: 匆忙中她绊了一下，把牛奶洒得满地都是。

es.c: 我穿着红外套，感觉自己十分显眼。

es.c: 把螺丝拧紧。

es.c: 拖动火车的蒸汽机车

es.c: 在马赛住了几星期后，我开始待不住了，决定换个地方。

d: n 终点站；航空枢纽 a big building where people wait to get onto planes, buses, or ships, or where goods are loaded；adj 每期的；终点的 a terminal illness cannot be cured, and causes death

es.e: the airport’s passenger terminal
es.c: 机场航站楼

d: n&vi 落下，降落，倒坍，垂下 to move or drop down from a higher position to a lower position

es.e: The tree was about to fall.
es.c: 那棵树快要倒下了。

es.e: The book fell from his hands.
es.c: 书从他手上跌落。

es.e: Enough rain had fallen to flood the grounds.
es.c: 雨量很大，淹没了地面。

d: v 减轻(痛苦等) to make something less painful or difficult to deal with

es.e: measures to alleviate poverty
es.c: 扶贫措施

d: adj 友好的，喜好交际的 someone who is sociable is friendly and enjoys being with other people

es.e: a pleasant, sociable couple
es.c: 一对和善且喜欢与人交往的夫妇

d: adj 健康的，有益于健康的 likely to make you healthy

es.e: good wholesome fun
es.c: 健康有益的娱乐

d: n 立方(体) a solid object with six equal square sides

es.e: a sugar cube
es.c: 一块方糖

es.e: an ice cube
es.c: 一小方块冰

es.e: Cut the meat into small cubes.
es.c: 把肉切成丁。

d: v 激怒；引起 to cause a reaction or feeling, especially a sudden one

es.e: The novel has provoked fierce debate in the US.
es.c: 那部小说在美国引发了激烈的争论。

d: v 取得；获得 to obtain something by buying it or being given it

es.e: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
es.c: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

es.e: She has acquired an email address and a site on the World Wide Web.
es.c: 她获得了一个电子邮件地址和万维网网址。

d: v 类似，像 to look like or be similar to someone or something

es.e: It’s amazing how closely Brian and Steve resemble each other.
es.c: 布赖恩和史蒂夫真是惊人地相像。

es.e: He grew up to resemble his father.
es.c: 他长大了，很像他父亲。

d: adj 黏着的；连贯的 if a piece of writing, set of ideas etc is coherent, it is easy to understand because it is clear and reasonable

es.e: The three years of the course are planned as a coherent whole.
es.c: 这三年的课程是作为连贯的整体来安排的。

es.e: a coherent account of the incident
es.c: 对该事件条理分明的陈述

d: n (页边)空白；边缘；(时间，金钱)多余 the edge of something, especially an area of land or water

es.e: the western margin of southern Africa
es.c: 非洲南部的西隅

d: v 离开，启程 to leave, especially when you are starting a journey

es.e: Flights by Air Europe depart Gatwick on Tuesdays.
es.c: 欧洲航空公司的航班每逢周二从盖特威克机场起飞。

d: n 方法；样式 a particular way or style of behaving, living or doing something

es.e: Set the monitor to 256 colour mode.
es.c: 把显示器调成256色彩模式。

d: adj 初步的，开端的 happening before something that is more important, often in order to prepare for it

es.e: the preliminary stages of the competition
es.c: 竞赛的预赛阶段

es.e: a preliminary draft
es.c: 初稿

d: adj 固有的，内在的 being part of the nature or character of someone or something

es.e: the intrinsic interest of the subject
es.c: 该话题本身的趣味

d: v 把围起来，把封入信封 to surround something, especially with a fence or wall, in order to make it separate

es.e: The pool area is enclosed by a six-foot wall.
es.c: 游泳区用六英尺高的高墙围了起来。

es.e: an enclosed area
es.c: 有围墙的区域

d: v 使必需 to involve something as a necessary part or result

es.e: A new computer system entails a lot of re-training.
es.c: 使用新的计算机系统需要大量的再培训。

es.e: Some foreign travel is entailed in the job.
es.c: 做这份工作有时要到国外出差。

d: n 心脏；感情；内心 the organ in your chest which pumps blood through your body

es.e: Regular exercise is good for the heart.
es.c: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。

es.e: Can you hear my heart beating?
es.c: 你能听见我的心跳吗？

es.e: Her cheeks were hot and her heart was pounding.
es.c: 她脸颊发烫，心怦怦直跳。

d: adj 确定的；确信的，实际的；正的；阳性的 if you take positive action, you do something definite in order to try and achieve something

es.e: We need to take positive steps to improve the situation of families in poverty.
es.c: 我们需要采取积极措施来改善贫困家庭的状况。

es.e: Positive action was required.
es.c: 要求采取积极行动。

es.e: It’s a relief to know that something positive is being done.
es.c: 知道正在采取积极的措施让人宽心。

d: v&n 倒塌；(精神)垮下来 if a building, wall etc collapses, it falls down suddenly, usually because it is weak or damaged

es.e: Uncle Ted’s chair collapsed under his weight.
es.c: 椅子承受不了特德叔叔的重量，塌架了。

es.e: The roof had collapsed long ago.
es.c: 屋顶早就塌了。

d: n 政治家，政客 a political or government leader, especially one who is respected as being wise and fair

es.e: a respected elder statesman
es.c: 一位受人尊敬的政界元老

d: v 嘲笑 to laugh at someone or shout unkind things at them in a way that shows you do not respect them；n 讥笑的言语

es.e: ‘You know I’m right!’ she jeered.
es.c: “你知道我是对的！”她嘲笑道。

es.e: The President was booed and jeered by a crowd of protesters.
es.c: 总统被一群抗议者报以嘘声和嘲笑。

d: n 麻袋，解雇 when someone is dismissed from their job；v 解雇；劫掠 to dismiss someone from their job

es.e: They’ve never actually given anyone the sack .
es.c: 他们从未真的辞退过什么人。

es.e: He got the sack for stealing.
es.c: 他因偷东西而被解雇。

es.e: She claimed she’d been threatened with the sack.
es.c: 她称自己受到过解雇的威胁。

d: n 麻醉剂 a type of drug which makes you sleep and reduces pain；adj 麻醉的，麻醉剂的 a narcotic drug takes away pain or makes you sleep

es.e: The truth of Johnson’s comment was recently brought home to me by the serene calm of a resident who was treating a particularly complicated narcotic-dependent patient.
es.c: 最近，一位住院医生对待一位异常复杂的麻醉药依赖病人的平静态度让我领会到了塞缪尔.约翰逊这句话的真谛。

es.e: As a result, almost 50 years after the agreement was adopted, adequate availability of narcotic drugs for pain treatment remains an unfulfilled promise.
es.c: 因此虽然条约早在50年前被通过，但确保治疗疼痛的麻醉药物供应充足仍是个未兑现的承诺。

d: v 深思，考虑 to spend time thinking carefully and seriously about a problem, a difficult question, or something that has happened

es.e: He continued to ponder the problem as he walked home.
es.c: 他一边往家走一边继续思考那个问题。

d: v 不同意；辩论 to state, giving clear reasons, that something is true, should be done etc

es.e: She argued the case for changing the law.
es.c: 她提出论据，力主修改法律。

es.e: The researchers put forward a well-argued case for banning the drug.
es.c: 研究人员为禁止这种药提出了充足的论据。

es.e: They argued the point (=  discussed it  ) for hours without reaching a conclusion.
es.c: 这个问题他们讨论了几个小时，还是没有得出结论。

d: adj 健康的，健全的；可靠的，充分的；彻底的 complete and thorough

es.e: a sound understanding of money and banking systems
es.c: 对货币和银行业体制的透彻理解

es.e: a sound knowledge of English
es.c: 扎实的英语知识

es.e: He has sound grasp of European history.
es.c: 他对欧洲历史有着透彻的理解。

d: n 灌溉

es.e: Rivers and lakes provide us with water transport and irrigation.
es.c: 江河湖泽给我们以舟楫和灌溉之利。

es.e: In the United States, by contrast, 41% goes for agriculture, almost all of it for irrigation.
es.c: 与之相比，美国全年41%的水投向了农业，并几乎全都用在了灌溉上。

d: n&vi 绝望，丧失信心 a feeling that you have no hope at all

es.e: The noise from the neighbours used to drive him to despair .
es.c: 过去，邻居的噪音常常吵得他心烦意乱。

d: n 牙医 someone whose job is to treat people’s teeth

es.e: Visit your dentist twice a year for a checkup.
es.c: 每年看两次牙医做检查。

d: n&v 焦点，集中 to give special attention to one particular person or thing, or to make people do this

es.e: His eyes were focussed straight ahead.
es.c: 他的双眼盯着正前方。

d: v 淹没，泛滥，压倒 to cover an area with a large amount of water

es.e: The tidal wave inundated vast areas of cropland.
es.c: 海啸淹没了大片农田。

d: v 爱护，抱有(希望)；怀有(情感) If you cherish someone or something, you take good care of them because you love them

es.e: He genuinely loved and cherished her.
es.c: 他真爱并珍惜过她。

d: adj 无意义的，无目标的 worthless or not likely to have any useful result

es.e: Life just seemed pointless to me.
es.c: 生活对我来说简直没什么意义。

es.e: a pointless quarrel
es.c: 无谓的争吵

d: n 修辞学 the art of speaking or writing to persuade or influence people

es.e: ...the noble institutions of political life, such as political rhetoric, public office, and public service.
es.c: …政治生活中令人尊崇的机制，诸如政治修辞艺术、政府机构以及公益服务。

d: n 人类；仁慈，仁爱 people in general

es.e: We want a clean healthy environment for all humanity .
es.c: 我们希望全人类拥有一个干净健康的生存环境。

es.e: crimes against humanity
es.c: 反人类罪

d: n&vt 厌恶，讨厌 a strong feeling of dislike, annoyance, or disapproval

es.e: He reached into the bin with a look of disgust on his face.
es.c: 他把手伸进垃圾箱，脸上带着厌恶的表情。

d: n 赌注 an agreement in which you win or lose money according to the result of something such as a race；v 押注，打赌 to agree to win or lose an amount of money on the result of something such as a race

es.e: There have been various wagers on certain candidates since the senator announced his retirement.
es.c: 自从那位参议员宣布引退之后，对某些候选人的打赌猜测纷纷出现。

d: n&v 诺言；指望；前途 If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone that you will definitely do it

es.e: The post office has promised to resume first class mail delivery to the area on Friday.
es.c: 邮局已承诺在星期五恢复该地区第一类邮件的递送。

es.e: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment.
es.c: 他已承诺富人和特权阶层将不会再得到优待。

es.e: Promise me you will not waste your time.
es.c: 向我承诺你不会浪费你的时间。

d: n 渴望；抱负 a strong desire to have or achieve something

es.e: a high level of political aspiration
es.c: 崇高的政治抱负

d: n 费，报名费，会费 an amount of money that you pay to do something or that you pay to a professional person for their work

es.c: 月付35英镑，即可使用健身房和游泳池。

es.c: 我真的很抱歉——都是我的错。

es.e: I didn’t sleep well that night, but it was my own fault .
es.c: 那天晚上我没有睡好，但这是我自己的问题。

d: n&vt 忌妒，妒忌的对象；羡慕 to wish that you had someone else’s possessions, abilities etc

es.c: 我真是羡慕你和伊恩，你俩在一起看起来多幸福。

es.e: She has a lifestyle which most people would envy.
es.c: 她的生活方式会令大多数人感到羡慕。

d: vt&vi 生产；让步；投降；屈服 to produce a result, answer, or piece of information；n 产量 the amount of profits, crops etc that something produces

es.c: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

d: adj 古怪的，反复无常的，不稳定的 something that is erratic does not follow any pattern or plan but happens in a way that is not regular

es.e: His breathing was becoming erratic.
es.c: 他的呼吸越来越不均匀。

es.e: his erratic behaviour
es.c: 他难以捉摸的行为

d: adj (目光)不能移的，集中的，专心的，坚决的 giving careful attention to something so that you think about nothing else

es.e: his intent gaze
es.c: 他专注的凝视

d: n 肉片，鱼片，牛排 good quality  beef  , or a large thick piece of any good quality red meat

es.c: …新鲜的三文鱼排。

d: n 氏族，部落；宗派 a large group of families who often share the same name

es.c: 坎贝尔家族

es.e: warring clans
es.c: 交战的各氏族

es.e: "In anthropology, you can't equate third gender with homosexuality," he said.
es.c: “在人类学中，你不能将同性恋和第三性别混同，”他说。

es.c: 当我还在剑桥读书的时候，我记得有一位人类学的教授拿出一张照片，上面是一根有28个切口的骨头。

es.e: Not to be the skunk at this party, but I think it's important to ask whether neuroscience reveals anything more than we already know from, say, anthropology.
es.c: 我并不想成为派对上的讨厌鬼，但我认为很重要的是，要问清楚神经科学是否揭示出我们已知之外的东西，比如人类学。

d: adj 可信任的，可靠的 deserving or able to be believed or trusted

es.c: 她的借口无法让人信服。

es.e: a credible alternative to nuclear power
es.c: 原子能的可靠替代物

es.c: 院子里亮着三盏巨大的聚光灯。

d: v 走得慢，落后 to move or develop more slowly than others；n 相隔时间 a delay or period of waiting between one event and a second event

es.e: Western banks still lag behind financial institutions in most other regions of the country.
es.c: 西部地区的银行仍然落后于这个国家其他大部分地区的金融机构。

d: n 活塞 a part of an engine consisting of a short solid piece of metal inside a tube, which moves up and down to make the other parts of the engine move
