es.c: 填充汽缸的蒸汽将活塞推出。

es.e: The new series also includes a piston design that makes digressive forces for added pitch and roll control. This helps with performance over rough terrains and on off-road surfaces.
es.c: 新系列还包括一个活塞设计，它可降低阻力，增加间距和滚转控制，这有助于军用车辆在崎岖的地形和越野路面的表现。

d: n&v 评论；批评 an opinion that you express about someone or something

es.e: He was fined for making abusive comments to the referee.
es.c: 他因谩骂裁判而被罚款。

d: n 新陈代谢 the chemical processes by which food is changed into energy in your body

es.e: This drug speeds up your metabolism.
es.c: 这种药物会加快你的新陈代谢。

es.c: 我生性爱说“不”。

es.c: 克里丝蒂娜不得不去医院切除阑尾。

d: n 总教堂；大教堂 the main church of a particular area under the control of a  bishop

es.c: 圣保罗大教堂

d: adj 各式各样的 of various different types

es.c: 各种大小的画笔

es.e: assorted vegetables
es.c: 各种各样的蔬菜

d: n 所有，拥有；财产 if something is in your possession, you own it, or you have obtained it from somewhere

es.e: That information is not in our possession.
es.c: 那则信息不归我们所有。

es.c: 这幅画是怎么到你手上的？

es.c: 这家金融公司目前拥有这所房子。

es.c: 和房子同宽的有顶露台

d: n 变化，改变；变量；变异 a difference between similar things, or a change from the usual amount or form of something

es.e: Most of his poems are variations on the theme of love.
es.c: 他的大部分诗作都是有关爱情主题的形式不同的作品。

d: v 纪念 to do something to show that you remember and respect someone important or an important event in the past

es.e: a parade to commemorate the town’s bicentenary
es.c: 庆祝该镇建立200周年的游行

d: n&a 镶嵌细工的，镶嵌工艺品的，嵌花式的 a group of different things that exist next to each other or together

es.e: rooms decorated with wall paintings and mosaics
es.c: 用壁画和马赛克装饰的房间

d: n 不端行为 a wrong or illegal action

es.e: He now repents of his past misdeeds.
es.c: 他现在对自己过去犯下的种种恶行感到懊悔。

d: v 使缓和；使镇静 To mitigate something means to make it less unpleasant, serious, or painful

es.e: ...ways of mitigating the effects of an explosion.
es.c: …减轻爆炸后果的方法。

d: n 网，筛孔 material made from threads or wires that have been woven together like a net, or a piece of this material

es.c: 窗户上装了铁丝纱网，防止苍蝇飞入。

es.c: 网状围栏

es.c: 我们站着观看狂欢节彩车经过。

d: v 照亮；用灯装饰；阐明 to make a light shine on something, or to fill a place with light

es.c: 一支蜡烛照亮了他的脸。

es.e: At night the canals are beautifully illuminated.
es.c: 晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

d: n 采石场；猎物 a place where large amounts of stone or sand are dug out of the ground

es.c: 板岩采石场

d: n&a 混合物(的)，复合词(的)；院子(的) a substance containing atoms from two or more  elements

es.e: man-made organic compounds
es.c: 人造有机化合物

d: v 使混乱，弄错 to think wrongly that a person or thing is someone or something else

es.e: People might well confuse the two products.
es.c: 人们很容易混淆这两种产品。

d: n (大学)院长，系主任，教务长 a priest of high rank in the Christian church who is in charge of several priests or churches

es.e: the admissions dean
es.c: 招生主任

d: n 流言蜚语；报上社会新闻；爱传流言的人 information that is passed from one person to another about other people’s behaviour and private lives, often including unkind or untrue remarks

es.c: 最近有些什么传闻？

es.c: 你想听些有趣的传闻吗？

es.e: She had no time for idle gossip .
es.c: 她没有时间说长道短。

d: v 屈服，屈从，死 to stop opposing someone or something that is stronger than you, and allow them to take control

es.e: Don't succumb to the temptation to have just one cigarette.
es.c: 不要屈服于只抽一支烟的诱惑。

n 消遣，娱乐，精神涣散 a pleasant activity
n 误判，误罚；流产；失败 if a woman who is going to have a baby has a miscarriage, she gives birth before the baby is properly formed and it dies

es.e: She had two miscarriages before she had her first child.
es.c: 她生第一个孩子之前流产了两次。

es.c: 有五分之一的妊娠以流产告终。

d: adj 休眠的，暂死的 not active or not growing at the present time but able to be active later

d: adj 整洁的，整齐的 neat and well cared for

es.c: 修剪齐整的郊区花园

es.c: 控制平民骚乱的军事训练

d: n&vt 审查，审查员；删改 someone whose job is to examine books, films, letters etc and remove anything considered to be offensive, morally harmful, or politically dangerous

es.c: 发布给报界的信息经过了国防部的仔细审查。

d: n 杆，杠杆；施加影响的手段 a stick or handle on a machine or piece of equipment, that you move to operate it；v 用杠杆移动 to move something with a lever

es.c: 拉此横杆开启大门。

es.c: 基于个人主义的新思想体系

d: adj 永久的，永恒的 continuing for ever, even after someone has died

es.c: 上帝永恒之爱的象征

es.e: a belief in life everlasting
es.c: 对永生的信念

d: n 洞察，洞悉，见识 the ability to understand and realize what people or situations are really like

es.c: 一位极有眼光的妇女

d: adj 人工的；娇揉造作的 not real or not made of natural things but made to be like something that is real or natural

es.c: 假花

es.c: 人造光

es.e: artificial fertilizers

d: v 支持；赞成；确认 to defend or support a law, system, or principle so that it continues to exist

es.c: 旨在保持教育水准的委员会

d: n 宪法；体格；构造 a set of basic laws and principles that a country or organization is governed by

d: n 粗帆布；油画布 strong cloth used to make bags, tents, shoes etc

es.c: 帆布包

d: adj 突出的，显要的，著名的 important

es.c: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

es.c: 世界杯赛将占据议程表的重要位置。

es.c: 爸爸在和所有的女士打情骂俏，或者说她们都在和他调情，跟平常一样。

d: adv 按时地，适当地 in the proper or expected way

es.e: Here are your travel documents, all duly signed.
es.c: 这是你的旅行证件，都签好了。

d: n 玉米 a tall plant with large yellow seeds that grow together on a  cob (= long hard part )  , and that are cooked and eaten as a vegetable

es.c: 这块地可以种高粱或玉米。

es.c: 玉米粟子刚刚吐穗。

es.c: 她的乳房长了个恶性肿瘤。

es.c: 他工资挺高。

es.c: 他做鬼脸逗孩子们开心。

es.c: 这个问题似乎不知怎么把他给逗乐了。

es.c: 这种杀虫剂用水稀释后直接施用在田里。

es.c: 那个衣衫褴褛的人拉著一货车破布碎片.

es.e: They mounted in front of the waggon, and Abraham grew reflective.
es.c: 他们上了车，坐在马车的前面，亚伯拉罕开始沉思起来。

es.e: He was harnessed to the waggon of beehives in the place of Prince, and the load taken on towards Casterbridge.
es.c: 他把那匹小马套上拉蜂箱的马车，代替了王子的位置，往卡斯特桥方向驶去了。

d: adj 决定的，明确的；最后的 a definitive agreement, statement etc is one that will not be changed

es.e: a definitive agreement to buy the company
es.c: 收购这家公司的最终协议

d: adj 迫近的，紧迫的 an event that is imminent, especially an unpleasant one, will happen very soon

es.e: A new trade agreement is imminent.
es.c: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

d: v&n 争论，争执，质疑 a serious argument or disagreement

es.e: It is beyond dispute that advances in medicine have enabled people to live longer.
es.c: 医学的发展使人们更加长寿，这是无可置疑的。

d: n 园艺 the practice or science of growing flowers, fruit, and vegetables

es.e: The area has a long tradition of horticulture.
es.c: 园艺是这个地区源远流长的传统。

es.e: Thus, to earn a Plant Science merit badge, a scout can choose between agronomy, horticulture, or field botany.
es.c: 因此，为了赚取植物科学奖章，一个童子军可以选择农学，园艺，或田野植物学。

es.e: All volunteers first go through orientation sessions, which are followed with one of three more specific training tracks:horticulture, “Ambassadors, ” and animal care.
es.c: 所有的志愿者先要通过新成员训练，然后再在三种特殊训练规划（园艺、“大使”和动物照料）中选择一种。

d: n 外貌，外表 If there is a semblance of a particular condition or quality, it appears to exist, even though this may be a false impression

es.e: At least a semblance of normality has been restored to parts of the country.
es.c: 这个国家的部分地区至少在表面上已恢复正常。

d: v 损害，削弱 to damage something or make it not as good as it should be

es.e: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
es.c: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

d: n&vt 灰心丧气；惊愕
n&v 撞击；冲，短跑；破折号；闯劲 If you dash somewhere, you run or go there quickly and suddenly

es.e: Suddenly she dashed down to the cellar.
es.c: 她猛地朝地窖冲过去。

d: adj 远离中心的，偏僻的 far from the centre of a city, town etc or from a main building

es.e: one of the outlying suburbs
es.c: 边远郊区之一

d: adj 传染性的 an illness that is catching is easily passed to other people

es.e: Julia’s enthusiasm was catching.
es.c: 朱莉娅的热情很有感染力。

d: v 阻止，使不敢，吓住 to stop someone from doing something, by making them realize it will be difficult or have bad results

es.e: The company’s financial difficulties have deterred potential investors.
es.c: 该公司的财务困境令潜在的投资者望而却步。

d: n 汇集，流入
"vt 哀悼, 非难"
n 引起怜悯的因素 the quality that a person, situation, film, or play has that makes you feel pity and sadness

es.e: the pathos of the woman trying to keep her lover
es.c: 那个女人试图留住爱侣的哀婉之情

d: adv 即；也就是 used when saying the names of the people or things you are referring to

es.e: Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
es.c: 有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

d: vt 放弃；撤回
n 脚底 the bottom surface of your foot, especially the part you walk or stand on；adj 单独的；惟一的 the sole person, thing etc is the only one

es.e: The soles of his feet were caked in mud.
es.c: 他的脚掌上沾满了泥巴。

d: vt&vi (冰雪)融化；使变得友善 if ice or snow thaws, or if the sun thaws it, it turns into water；n 解冻 a period of warm weather during which snow and ice melt

es.e: The lake thawed in March.
es.c: 3月里，湖水解冻了。

d: v&n 掷，抛；猛烈地移动；投入 to throw something somewhere using a lot of force

es.e: He flung his coat over the back of a chair.
es.c: 他把外套扔在椅背上。

d: adj 足够的，充分的 as much as is needed for a particular purpose

es.e: We can only prosecute if there is sufficient evidence.
es.c: 有了足够的证据，我们才能提出起诉。

es.e: Unauthorized absence is sufficient reason for dismissal.
es.c: 旷工足以成为解雇的理由。

es.e: We need sufficient time to deal with the problem.
es.c: 我们需要足够的时间来处理这个问题。

d: n 道德，美德；伦理体系 beliefs or ideas about what is right and wrong and about how people should behave

es.e: ...standards of morality and justice in society.
es.c: …社会中道德和正义的标准。

d: v&n 剃；刮 to cut off hair very close to the skin, especially from the face, using a  razor

es.e: He hadn’t shaved for days.
es.c: 他已经好几天没刮脸了。

es.e: Brian had cut himself shaving .
es.c: 布赖恩刮胡子时割破了脸。

d: n 联络 the regular exchange of information between groups of people, especially at work, so that each group knows what the other is doing

es.e: Liaison between police forces and the art world is vital to combat art crime.
es.c: 警方和艺术界之间的联络对于打击艺术犯罪是至关重要的。

d: v 把往上抛，掷，抽打 to make a flat object such as a coin go upwards and turn over in the air；v 用指轻弹

es.e: We flipped a coin to see who would go first.
es.c: 我们抛硬币决定谁先去。

es.e: There’s quite an art to flipping pancakes.
es.c: 翻煎饼真是门艺术。

d: v 剪 to cut the wool off a sheep

es.e: Her long fair hair had been shorn.
es.c: 她长长的金发已经剪掉了。

d: v (鸟)盘旋，翱翔，(人)逗留在附近徘徊 If you hover, you stay in one place and move slightly in a nervous way, for example because you cannot decide what to do

es.e: Judith was hovering in the doorway.
es.c: 朱迪丝在门口徘徊。

d: n 蜡，蜂蜡 a solid substance made of fat or oil and used to make candles, polish etc；v 上蜡 to rub a layer of wax into a floor, surface etc to protect it or make it shine

es.e: wax crayons
es.c: 蜡笔

d: adv 快乐地，娱乐地 in a happy way

es.e: ‘Morning, Albert,’ she called gaily.
es.c: “早安，艾伯特。”她快乐地喊道。

d: n 滑；幻灯片 a large structure with steps leading to the top of a long sloping surface which children can slide down；v 滑动 to move smoothly over a surface while continuing to touch it, or to make something move in this way

es.e: a slide show
es.c: 幻灯片放映

d: n 团，块，肿块 a small piece of something solid, without a particular shape；v 合在一起，结块 to put two or more different people or things together and consider them as a single group, sometimes wrongly

es.e: Strain the custard to remove lumps.
es.c: 滤去牛奶蛋糊里的面块。

d: n 检查；审视，检阅 an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed

es.e: An inspection was carried out at the school.
es.c: 有人来学校视察了一遍。

d: n 竞技场，比赛场所 a building with a large flat central area surrounded by seats, where sports or entertainments take place

es.e: a sports arena
es.c: 运动场

es.e: an indoor arena
es.c: 室内剧场

d: adj 节约的 using money, time, goods etc carefully and without wasting any

es.e: A small car is more economical to run.
es.c: 开小型汽车比较省油。

es.e: good-quality clothes at economical prices
es.c: 物美价廉的衣服

d: adj 有磁性的，有吸引力的 concerning or produced by  magnetism

es.e: magnetic forces
es.c: 磁力

d: n (织物上的)绒毛 soft light bits of thread that have come from wool, cotton, or other materials；v 抖开，抖松 to make something soft become larger by shaking it

es.e: He was picking bits of fluff off his trousers.
es.c: 他在揪裤子上的绒毛球。

es.e: a ball of carpet fluff
es.c: 地毯的绒毛团

d: n 出纳员 someone whose job is to receive or pay out money in a shop

es.e: The cashier absconded with the money.
es.c: 出纳员携款潜逃。

es.e: The cashier had run out with eighty thousand pounds in cash.
es.c: 这个出纳员带着八万镑现钞消失得无影无踪。

d: n (文学)少女，未嫁女人 a young girl, or a woman who is not married；adj 未婚女子的

es.e: ...stories of noble princes and their brave deeds on behalf of beautiful maidens.
es.c: …高贵的王子以及他们英雄救美的故事。

d: v 使大吃一惊 to make someone suddenly surprised or slightly shocked

es.e: Sorry, I didn’t mean to startle you.
es.c: 抱歉，我不是故意吓你一跳的。

d: n&a&v 寒冷，扫兴的，(使)感冒 a feeling of coldness

es.e: There was a slight chill in the air .
es.c: 空气中有些微的寒意。

es.e: I turned on the heater in the hall to take the chill off the house (= to heat it slightly ) .
es.c: 我开了厅里的暖气给屋子驱寒。

d: n&vt 保存；预定 to arrange for a place in a hotel, restaurant, plane etc to be kept for you to use at a particular time in the future

es.e: Do you have to reserve tickets in advance?
es.c: 你必须预先订票吗？

d: n 代替人，代用品 someone who does someone else’s job for a limited period of time, especially in a sports team or school；v 代替 to use something new or diffe-rent instead of something else

es.e: Germany brought on a substitute at half time.
es.c: 德国队在比赛半场时换上一名替补队员。

es.e: substitute goalkeeper
es.c: 替补守门员

d: n 会堂；礼堂 a large building used for concerts or public meetings

es.e: ...a high school auditorium.
es.c: …一所中学的礼堂。

d: n&vt 尊重，珍重 a feeling of respect for someone, or a good opinion of someone

es.e: Peden was greatly esteemed by the people of Ayrshire.
es.c: 佩登深受艾尔郡人的尊敬。

d: n 创作，创造，创造物 the act of creating something

es.e: a job creation scheme
es.c: 创造就业机会的计划

d: adj 明白的，明显的 plain and easy to see；v 显示，出现 to show a feeling, attitude etc

es.e: a manifest error of judgment
es.c: 明显的判断错误

d: v 授予(称号，学位等)；协商 to officially give someone a title etc, especially as a reward for something they have achieved

es.e: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
es.c: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。

d: prep&ad 在下面，在底下 directly under another object or covered by it

es.e: He got out of the car and looked underneath.
es.c: 他下车往底下看了看。

es.e: It’s near where the railway goes underneath the road.
es.c: 它靠近铁路从公路下方穿过的地方。

es.e: She was wearing a smart jacket with a T-shirt underneath.
es.c: 她穿了件时髦的夹克，里面是一件 T 恤衫。

d: v 升起，扯起，向上推 to raise, lift, or pull something up, especially using ropes；n 起重机，升降机 a piece of equipment used for lifting heavy objects with ropes

es.e: The crew hurried to hoist the flag.
es.c: 船员们急忙把旗子升起来。

d: n 容量；容积；理解力；地位；资格 the amount of space a container, room etc has to hold things or people

es.e: The room had seating capacity for about 80.
es.c: 这房间能坐80个人左右。

es.e: The orchestra played to a capacity crowd (= the largest number of people who can fit into a hall, theatre etc ) .
es.c: 管弦乐队为满场的观众演奏。

es.e: All the hotels were filled to capacity .
es.c: 所有的宾馆都住满了。

d: n 燃料；刺激感情之物 a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that can be burned to produce heat or energy；v 供给燃料 if you fuel a vehicle, or if it fuels up, fuel is put into it

es.e: Coal is one of the cheapest fuels.
es.c: 煤是最廉价的燃料之一。

d: adv 偶然地，顺便地 in a way that was not planned, but as a result of something else

es.e: Quite incidentally, I got some useful information at the party.
es.c: 我在聚会上无意中得到了一些有用信息。

d: v&n 咯咯地笑，傻笑 to laugh quickly, quietly, and in a high voice, because something is funny or because you are nervous or embarrassed

es.e: If you can’t stop giggling you’ll have to leave the room.
es.c: 如果你再咯咯地笑个不停，就给我离开屋子。

d: n 护卫者；护航舰 a person or a group of people or vehicles that go with someone in order to protect or guard them；v 护送，护卫 to take someone somewhere, especially when you are protecting or guarding them

es.e: a police escort
es.c: 警察护卫队

d: n 彩票 a game used to make money for a state or a  charity  in which people buy tickets with a series of numbers on them. If their number is picked by chance, they win money or a prize.

es.e: a lottery ticket
es.c: 彩票

es.e: Do you really think winning the lottery would make you happy?
es.c: 你真的认为彩票中奖会带给你幸福吗？

d: v 保持，保有；聘请(律师) to keep something or continue to have something

es.e: You have the right to retain possession of the goods.
es.c: 你有权保留这些物品。

es.e: The state wants to retain control of food imports.
es.c: 政府想保留对食品进口的控制权。

d: n 潜流；(思想，情绪)暗流
n 同义词 a word with the same meaning as another word in the same language

es.e: The term "industrial democracy" is often used as a synonym for worker participation.
es.c: “工业民主”这一词语常被用作“工人参与”的同义词。

d: n 草地，草皮 a surface that consists of soil with grass on top, or an artificial surface that looks like this

es.e: soft green turf
es.c: 柔软的绿色草皮

d: v 欠债；感激；由于 to need to pay someone for something that they have done for you or sold to you, or to need to give someone back money that they have lent you

es.e: How much do I owe you (= often used to show that you want to pay for something )?
es.c: 我该付你多少钱？

d: v 耗尽，用尽 To deplete a stock or amount of something means to reduce it

es.e: ...substances that deplete the ozone layer.
es.c: …消耗臭氧层的物质。

d: n 要塞; 堡垒 a strong building or group of buildings used by soldiers or an army for defending an important place

es.e: The fort flanked on a swamp.
es.c: 堡垒侧面靠着沼泽。

d: v 欺骗；哄骗 to make someone believe something that is not true

es.e: I was angry with him for trying to delude me.
es.c: 他想骗我，因此我很恼火。

es.e: Don’t be deluded into thinking your house is burglarproof.
es.c: 不要误以为你的房子是绝对防盗的。

d: adj 机灵的；制作精巧的，灵巧的 an ingenious plan, idea, or object works well and is the result of clever thinking and new ideas

es.e: Many fish have ingenious ways of protecting their eggs from predators.
es.c: 很多鱼都有绝妙的方法来保护它们产的卵不被捕食者吃掉。

es.e: an ingenious device
es.c: 精巧的装置

d: v 比较，对照；喻为 to consider two or more things or people, in order to show how they are similar or different

es.e: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
es.c: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

d: adj 内地的，内陆的 an inland area, city etc is not near the coast；adv 在内地，向内地 in a direction away from the coast and towards the centre of a country

es.e: the largest area of inland water in the southeast
es.c: 东南部最大的内陆水域

d: v 镇压；平定；抑制；隐瞒 to stop people from opposing the government, especially by using force

es.e: The uprising was ruthlessly suppressed.
es.c: 起义受到了残酷的镇压。

d: n 恐怖 a feeling of extreme fear

es.e: There was a look of sheer terror (= complete terror ) on his face.
es.c: 他脸上的表情异常惊恐。

d: n 过程，步骤 a way of doing something, especially the correct or usual way

es.e: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
es.c: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

d: n 借口 a false reason given for an action, in order to hide the real reason

es.e: He’ll phone on some pretext or other.
es.c: 他会以这样或那样的理由打电话的。

d: n&v 拍打，挥动，垂下物；袋盖；慌乱 the noisy movement of something such as cloth in the air

es.e: the flap of the sails
es.c: 船帆的拍动

d: adj 已废弃的，过时的 no longer useful, because something newer and better has been invented

es.e: obsolete weapons
es.c: 已被淘汰的武器

es.e: computer hardware that quickly became obsolete
es.c: 很快就变得过时的电脑硬件

es.e: Will computers render (= make ) books obsolete?
es.c: 计算机会把书籍淘汰掉吗？

d: adj 故意的，从容的 intended or planned；v 仔细考虑 to think about something very carefully

es.e: a deliberate attempt to humiliate her
es.c: 对她的故意羞辱

es.e: The attack on him was quite deliberate.
es.c: 对他的袭击完全是有预谋的。

d: n 誓言，誓约 a formal and very serious promise

es.e: The president took the oath of office (= made the official public promises that every president makes when starting their job ) .
es.c: 总统宣誓就职。

es.e: She could not break her oath .
es.c: 她不能违背誓言。

d: n 取尽，用尽
vt&n 预测，预报 a description of what is likely to happen in the future, based on the information that you have now

es.e: The weather forecast is good for tomorrow.
es.c: 天气预报说明天是晴天。

d: adj 疼痛的；恼火的 a part of your body that is sore is painful, because of infection or because you have used a muscle too much

es.e: I had a sore throat and aching limbs.
es.c: 我喉咙疼，四肢酸痛。

d: adj 十进制的，公制的 using or connected with the  metric system  of weights and measures

es.e: a metric tonne
es.c: 一公吨

es.e: The parts all come in metric sizes now.
es.c: 现在配件都采用公制规格。

d: vt&vi 辩护；提出为理由 If you plead the case or cause of someone or something, you speak out in their support or defence

es.e: He appeared before the committee to plead his case.
es.c: 他出现在委员会上为他的案子辩护。

d: n&vt 猛扭，猛拉 to twist and pull something roughly from the place where it is being held

es.e: I wrenched the packet from his grasp.
es.c: 我用力夺过他攥在手里的纸袋。

es.e: The door had been wrenched open.
es.c: 门被猛地拉开了。

d: n 外科医生 a doctor who does operations in a hospital

es.e: ...a heart surgeon.
es.c: …一位心脏外科医生。

d: n 赔偿 money paid to someone because they have suffered injury or loss, or because something they own has been damaged

es.e: People who are wrongly arrested may be paid compensation .
es.c: 被误抓的人有可能得到补偿费。

d: n 证明；出处；参照 a number that tells you where you can find the information you want in a book, on a map etc

es.e: a list of towns, each with a map reference
es.c: 一份城镇清单，每个城镇都有地图参照号

d: v 挤作一团，乱堆 if a group of people huddle together, they stay very close to each other, especially because they are cold or frightened；n 一堆，一团 a group of people or things that are close together, but not arranged in any part

es.e: We lay huddled together for warmth.
es.c: 我们紧紧挤在一起取暖。

d: n 船坞；码头；刑事被告席 a place in a port where ships are loaded, unloaded, or repaired；v 引入船坞

es.e: A crowd was waiting at the dock to greet them.
es.c: 一群人在码头等着迎接他们。

d: n&a 古怪(的)，偏执(的)，不同心(的) An eccentric is an eccentric person

es.e: Askew used several names, and had a reputation as an eccentric.
es.c: 艾斯丘用过几个名字，并以“怪人”著称。

d: adj 模糊的，不明确的，无定限的 an indefinite action or period of time has no definite end arranged for it

es.e: The next day the union voted to begin an indefinite strike.
es.c: 第二天工会投票表决决定开始无限期罢工。

es.e: The picture has been loaned for an indefinite period to the National Gallery.
es.c: 那幅画长期出借给国家美术馆。

d: n 承保险别；新闻报道(范围)；保证金 when a subject or event is reported on television or radio, or in newspapers

es.e: live coverage of the match (= the match is broadcast at the same time that it is happening )
es.c: 这场比赛的现场直播

d: adj 固定的，定置的；不变动的，不移动的 standing still instead of moving

es.e: How did you manage to drive into a stationary vehicle?
es.c: 你是怎么开车的，竟会撞上一辆停着的车子？

d: n 最大量；最大限度 the largest number or amount that is possible or is allowed

es.e: We might have a third child, but that’s the absolute maximum .
es.c: 我们可能会要第三个孩子，但这绝对是极限了。

d: v 编辑，剪辑 to prepare a book, piece of film etc for printing or broadcasting by removing mistakes or parts that are not acceptable

es.e: The newspaper edits letters before printing them.
es.c: 这家报社刊登读者来信前先作校订。

d: adv 以某种方式 in some way, or by some means, although you do not know how

es.e: Don’t worry, we’ll get the money back somehow.
es.c: 别担心，我们总会把那些钱拿回来的。

es.e: Somehow, I managed to lose my keys.
es.c: 我不知怎的竟然把钥匙弄丢了。

es.e: Maybe we could glue it together somehow or other .
es.c: 也许我们可以想什么办法把它粘起来。

d: adj 顽固的，倔强的，不易屈服的，较难治愈的 determined not to change your ideas, behaviour, opinions etc, even when other people think you are being unreasonable

es.e: He was the most obstinate man I’ve ever met.
es.c: 他是我遇到过的最固执的人。

es.e: Don’t be so obstinate!
es.c: 别这么固执！

es.e: an obstinate refusal to obey
es.c: 固执地拒绝服从

d: n 线，细绳；弦 a strong thread made of several threads twisted together, used for tying or fastening things

es.e: Her key hung on a string around her neck.
es.c: 她的钥匙穿了根绳子挂在脖子上。

es.e: a ball of string
es.c: 一团细绳

es.e: I need a piece of string to tie this package.
es.c: 我需要一根绳子来捆这个包裹。

d: n 白天，一天 a period of 24 hours

es.e: We spent three days in Paris.
es.c: 我们在巴黎度过了三天。

es.e: ‘What day is it today?’ ‘Friday.’
es.c: “今天星期几？” “星期五。”

es.e: He left two days ago.
es.c: 他两天前离开的。

d: adj 许许多多的 many

es.e: Numerous attempts have been made to hide the truth.
es.c: 为掩盖事实作了很多尝试。

es.e: The two leaders have worked together on numerous occasions.
es.c: 那两位领导人已经多次合作。

d: n 辞职书；放弃；听从，顺从 when someone calmly accepts a situation that cannot be changed, even though it is bad

es.e: She gave a sigh of resignation.
es.c: 她无奈地叹了一口气。

d: adj 装满的，载满的 heavily loaded with something, or containing a lot of something

es.e: snow-laden branches
es.c: 积满雪的树枝

d: n 本能 a natural tendency to behave in a particular way or a natural ability to know something, which is not learned

es.e: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
es.c: 直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

d: n&v 末端，尽头，结束 a situation in which something is finished or no longer exists

es.e: At last it seemed the war might be coming to an end.
es.c: 终于战争似乎即将结束。

es.e: The spacecraft is nearing the end of its useful life.
es.c: 该航天器的使用寿命快要终结。

es.e: Well, I hope that’s the end of the matter.
es.c: 好啦，我希望事情就到此为止。

d: adj 消灭了的，熄灭了的，绝种的 an extinct type of animal or plant does not exist any more

es.e: Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.
es.c: 恐龙已灭绝数千万年了。

es.e: Pandas could become extinct in the wild.
es.c: 熊猫在野生环境中可能会绝种。

es.e: an extinct species
es.c: 已灭绝的一个物种

d: n 题目；主题 the main subject or idea in a piece of writing, speech, film etc

es.e: The book’s theme is the conflict between love and duty.
es.c: 本书的主题是爱与责任之间的冲突。

es.e: Nature is a recurrent theme (= a theme that appears repeatedly ) in Frost’s poetry.
es.c: 大自然是弗罗斯特诗作中反复出现的一个主题。

es.e: Most of Kurt’s other pictures were variations on the same theme .
es.c: 库尔特的其他大部分画作都是同一主题的变奏。

d: n 序言；开端 the introduction to a play, a long poem etc

es.e: The prologue to the novel is written in the form of a newspaper account.
es.c: 该小说的前言是以新闻报道的形式写的。

d: n 图解 a simple drawing or plan that shows exactly where something is, what something looks like, or how something works

es.e: ...a circuit diagram.
es.c: …电路图。

d: adj 适合的，恰当的 right for a particular situation or occasion；n 试衣；建筑物中的装置 an occasion when you put on a piece of clothing that is being made for you, to see if it fits properly

es.e: I thought the memorial was a fitting tribute to the President.
es.c: 我认为这座纪念碑恰如其分地表达了对总统的敬意。

es.e: a fitting end to what was a memorable trip
es.c: 一次难忘旅行的完美收尾

d: v 任命；安装，安置 to put a piece of equipment somewhere and connect it so that it is ready to be used

es.e: They’ve installed the new computer network at last.
es.c: 他们终于安装了新电脑网络。

es.e: Security cameras have been installed in the city centre.
es.c: 在市中心已安装了一些监控摄像机。

d: v 使变淡，稀释 to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid；adj 稀释的 a dilute liquid has been made weaker by the addition of water or another liquid

es.e: diluted fruit juice
es.c: 稀释的果汁

d: n 房屋的一层 a floor or level of a building

es.e: A staircase leads to the upper storey .
es.c: 有一段楼梯通往上面一层。

d: n 可能，机会 how likely it is that something will or will not happen

es.e: (= it is likely ) that he will commit the same crime again.
es.c: 他可能还会犯同样的罪行。

es.e: (= how likely is it ) that they will mess up?
es.c: 他们失败的可能性有多大？

es.e: a new company that has beaten the odds and succeeded (= it was not likely to succeed, but it did )
es.c: 战胜逆境而取得成功的一家新公司

d: vt&vi 打旋，旋动 to move around quickly in a twisting circular movement, or to make something do this

es.e: The river had become a swirling torrent.
es.c: 河水变成了翻滚的洪流。

d: v 使放心，使消除疑虑 to make someone feel calmer and less worried or frightened about a problem or situation

es.e: Teachers reassured anxious parents.
es.c: 老师们安慰焦急的父母。

d: n 伤亡人员

es.e: We have had our first casualty. One runner has dropped out with cramp.
es.c: 我们有了第一位伤员，有一位队员因腿部痉挛退出了。

es.e: Any history of bombing must also be a history of civilian casualty, for bombing saves the lives of soldiers only at the expense of other lives.
es.c: 任何空袭的历史也必定是平民伤亡的历史，因为空袭救了士兵的性命只能以其他人的生命为代价。

es.e: The first item always on that was the overnight casualty report from Iraq and Afghanistan, and I would often come and see that had been circled by the president or that he would be reflecting on that.
es.c: 上面的第一条永远是,这一晚在伊拉克和阿富汗,士兵的伤亡报告，我来的时候会看到那条消息,被布什总统圈了出来,他看着报告会陷入沉思。

d: n 火柴；比赛；对手；婚姻;相称v相当,相配 an organized sports event between two teams or people

es.e: It’s our last match of the season.
es.c: 这是我们本赛季最后一场比赛。

es.e: They’re preparing for a big match tomorrow.
es.c: 他们在为明天的一场大赛做准备。

es.e: McClaire’s goal earned him the title of man of the match (= the person in a team who plays best ) .
es.c: 麦克莱尔的进球为他赢得了“本场最佳球员”的称号。

d: n 十年 a period of 10 years

es.e: ...the last decade of the nineteenth century.
es.c: …19世纪的最后10年。

d: v 比大，超出 to be more than a particular number or amount

es.e: Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
es.c: 工作时间每周不得超过42小时。

es.e: His performance exceeded our expectations.
es.c: 他的表现出乎我们的预料。

d: n 私人教师；[英]大学导师 someone who gives private lessons to one student or a small group, and is paid directly by them

es.e: The children were educated at home by a succession of tutors.
es.c: 这些孩子在家接受教育，连续请过几任家庭教师。

d: n 最近，接近 nearness in distance or time

es.e: Here the rich and the poor live in close proximity (= very near to each other ) .
es.c: 在这里，富人和穷人比邻而居。

d: adj 全世界的，世界主义的 a cosmopolitan place has people from many different parts of the world – use this to show approval

es.e: a vibrant, cosmopolitan city
es.c: 一个充满活力的国际性都市

es.e: a lively hotel with a cosmopolitan atmosphere
es.c: 一家有着国际化氛围的、热闹的宾馆

d: a&n 基督教的；基督教徒 a person who believes in the ideas taught by Jesus Christ

es.e: He was a devout Christian.
es.c: 他曾是一个虔诚的基督教徒。

d: n 催化剂；造成变化的人或事 a substance that makes a chemical reaction happen more quickly without being changed itself

es.e: I very much hope that this case will prove to be a catalyst for change.
es.c: 我非常希望这件事终将成为促成变化的催化剂。

d: v 运送；交付 to send something somewhere, especially in order to sell it
v 出租 to use a building, car etc under a lease；n 租约 a legal agreement which allows you to use a building, car etc for a period of time, in return for rent

es.e: I’m interested in leasing your cottage.
es.c: 我有兴趣租下你的小屋。

d: v 月亮变小，月亏；衰退 when the moon wanes, you gradually see less of it

es.e: My enthusiasm for the project was waning.
es.c: 我对这个项目的热情逐渐减退了。

d: n 配额，限额(进口及移民人数) an official limit on the number or amount of something that is allowed in a particular period

es.e: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
es.c: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

es.e: There are plans to introduce strict immigration quotas.
es.c: 有计划要推行严格的移民限额制度。

d: v 降低，使沮丧；使萧条 to make someone feel very unhappy

es.e: The thought of taking the exam again depressed him.
es.c: 想到要补考，他就心情沮丧。

es.e: It depresses me that nobody seems to care.
es.c: 似乎没有人在乎，这让我感到很沮丧。

d: v 澄清，使液体清洁 to make something clearer or easier to understand

es.e: Reporters asked him to clarify his position (= say exactly what his beliefs are ) on welfare reform.
es.c: 记者们要求他阐明他在福利改革问题上的立场。

d: adj 极度的，尽头的 very great in degree；n 极端，相反的性质 a situation, quality etc which is as great as it can possibly be – used especially when talking about two opposites

es.e: Extreme poverty still exists in many rural areas.
es.c: 许多农村地区仍处于赤贫状态。

es.e: extreme cold
es.c: 严寒

es.e: He had extreme difficulty getting hold of the ingredients.
es.c: 他费了极大的劲找配料。

d: n 雷达 a piece of equipment that uses radio waves to find the position of things and watch their movement

es.e: The coastline can now be monitored by radar.
es.c: 现在能用雷达监测海岸线了。

es.e: We could see the plane quite clearly on the radar screen.
es.c: 我们在雷达屏幕上可清晰地看到飞机。

d: v 附属；有关 If one thing pertains to another, it relates, belongs, or applies to it

es.e: ...matters pertaining to naval district defence.
es.c: …与海军区域防卫有关的问题。

d: adj 假设的；约定的；同意的 any particular time, situation, amount etc that is being used as an example

es.e: On any given day in the Houston area, half the hospital beds are empty.
es.c: 在休斯敦地区，任何一天医院的床位都有一半是空的。

es.e: The rules are to be followed in any given situation.
es.c: 这些规则在任何情况下都要遵守。

d: adj 地震的，地震强度的 relating to or caused by  earthquakes

es.e: increased seismic activity
es.c: 越来越频繁的地震活动

d: n 顶点，高峰；峰会(最高级会谈)

es.e: But are these the summit of our values, of our aspirations of society?
es.c: 但这些是我们的价值观、我们对社会的抱负的顶点吗？

d: adj 航海的，船舶的，海员的 relating to ships, boats, or sailing

es.e: nautical equipment
es.c: 航海装备

d: n 许可，特许，执照；放纵 an official document giving you permission to own or do something for a period of time

es.e: The dealers applied for an export licence.
es.c: 经销商申请了出口许可证。

es.e: He was arrested for driving without a license.
es.c: 他因无照驾驶被捕。

es.e: The Tennessee Valley Authority applied for a license to operate the facility.
es.c: 田纳西河谷管理局申请了这个场所的经营执照。

d: n 靶，标；批评对象；指标 something that you are trying to achieve, such as a total, an amount, or a time

es.e: There is no target date for completion of the new project.
es.c: 这个新的项目何时完工没有预定日期。

es.e: The government may fail to meet (= achieve ) its target of recycling 25% of domestic waste.
es.c: 政府可能达不到回收利用25%的生活垃圾的目标。

es.e: Jiang set annual growth targets of 8–9%.
es.c: 江确定了8%至9%的年增长目标。

d: adj 分析的；分解的 thinking about things in a detailed and intelligent way, so that you can examine and understand things

es.e: She’s got an analytical mind.
es.c: 她思维缜密。

d: n&v 急动，急停

es.e: Wilcox jerked his head to indicate that they should move on.
es.c: 威尔科克斯扭扭头，示意他们该走了。

d: vt&n 援救；营救 to save someone or something from a situation of danger or harm

es.e: Survivors of the crash were rescued by helicopter.
es.c: 空难的生还者被直升机救了出来。

d: n 长沙发 a comfortable piece of furniture big enough for two or three people to sit on；v 表达 to be expressed in a particular way

es.e: Tom offered to sleep on the couch.
es.c: 汤姆说他来睡沙发。

d: adj 战略的，战略方针的 done as part of a plan, especially in a military, business, or political situation

es.e: UN forces made a strategic withdrawal.
es.c: 联合国部队作了战略性撤退。

es.e: strategic planning meetings
es.c: 战略计划会议

es.e: a strategic decision to move production to Hungary
es.c: 把生产转至匈牙利的战略决定

d: n 推动，冲力，冲动 a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about whether it is a sensible thing to do

es.e: The eye converts light signals to nerve impulses.
es.c: 眼睛把光信号转变成神经冲动。

d: adj 紫外线的 ultraviolet light cannot be seen by people, but is responsible for making your skin darker when you are in the sun

es.e: Ozone in the stratosphere is important because it absorbs some of the Sun’s dangerous ultraviolet radiation.
es.c: 在平流层的臭氧是重要的，因为它吸收了一些太阳中危险的紫外线辐射。

es.e: Birds perceive the world differently tohumans, being able to see light in the ultraviolet range of the spectrum.
es.c: 鸟类感知世界的方式和人类不同，他们能够在紫外线光谱范围内看见光线。

es.e: But it also says there is no evidence to support disinfecting toothbrushes in the microwave or with ultraviolet devices on the market.
es.c: 但它也说，没有证据支持在微波炉或市面上销售的紫外线设备中对牙刷消毒。

d: adj 音调悦耳的，旋律的 something that sounds melodious sounds like music or has a pleasant tune

es.e: He spoke in a quiet melodious voice.
es.c: 他说话的声音轻柔悦耳。

d: adj 决定性的；紧要关头的 something that is crucial is extremely important, because everything else depends on it

es.e: The conservation of tropical forests is of crucial importance .
es.c: 保护热带雨林至关重要。

d: n 日用品，商品 a product that is bought and sold

es.e: agricultural commodities
es.c: 农业商品

es.e: Commodity prices fell sharply.
es.c: 商品价格急剧下跌。

d: v 想出(主意)；怀孕 to think of a new idea, plan etc and develop it in your mind

es.e: Scientists first conceived the idea of the atomic bomb in the 1930’s.
es.c: 在20世纪30年代，科学家第一次有了原子弹的设想。

d: n 垄断，专卖权 if a company or government has a monopoly of a business or political activity, it has complete control of it so that other organizations cannot compete with it

es.e: a monopoly in copper trading
es.c: 对铜交易的垄断

d: adj 怪诞的；离奇的，古怪的；超自然的 very strange and unusual, and difficult to understand or explain

es.e: A really weird thing happened last night.
es.c: 昨晚发生了一件非常奇怪的事。

es.e: He’s a weird bloke.
es.c: 他是个古怪的家伙。

es.e: They sell all sorts of weird and wonderful (= very strange ) products.
es.c: 他们出售各种稀奇古怪的产品。

d: n 典型的榜样，样本

adj 光滑的；平稳的 a smooth surface has no rough parts, lumps, or holes, especially in a way that is pleasant and attractive to touch；v 使光滑；使平稳 to make something such as cloth or hair flat by moving your hands across it

es.e: Her skin felt smooth and cool.
es.c: 她的皮肤摸上去又滑又凉。

es.e: a smooth pebble
es.c: 光滑的卵石

es.e: The stone steps had been worn smooth .
es.c: 石阶被磨得光溜溜的了。

d: adj 笨拙的；愚笨的 moving or doing things in a careless way, especially so that you drop things, knock into things etc

es.e: A clumsy waiter spilled wine all over her new skirt.
es.c: 一名笨手笨脚的服务员把葡萄酒洒得她新裙子上到处都是。

es.e: a clumsy attempt to catch the ball
es.c: 笨拙的接球动作

d: adj 手提式的，便携式的 able to be carried or moved easily

es.e: a portable radio
es.c: 便携式收音机

d: n 电压 electrical force measured in volts

es.e: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
es.c: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

d: n 麻烦事，讨厌的人 a person, thing, or situation that annoys you or causes problems

es.e: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
es.c: 他喝醉时会是一个有点令人讨厌的人。

d: v 加强; 加剧 to increase in degree or strength, or to make something do this

es.e: In Junethe civil war intensified.
es.c: 6月份内战更加激烈了。

es.e: His mother’s death intensified his loneliness.
es.c: 母亲的过世使他感到更加孤单。

d: vt&vi 再获得；挽回；挽救 to make a situation satisfactory again after there has been a serious mistake or problem

es.e: The general made one last desperate effort to retrieve the situation.
es.c: 将军为挽回局面而孤注一掷。

d: n 拳头 the hand when it is tightly closed, so that the fingers are curled in towards the  palm  . People close their hand in a fist when they are angry or are going to hit someone.

es.e: She held the money tightly in her fist.
es.c: 她把钱紧紧地攥在手中。

es.e: Malcolm clenched his fist (= held his fist very tightly closed ) angrily.
es.c: 马尔科姆愤怒地握紧拳头。

es.e: Dooley stood up and shook his fist in her face.
es.c: 杜利站起身，在她眼前挥舞着拳头。

d: v 闪烁，闪耀；闪闪发光 if a star or light twinkles, it shines in the dark with an unsteady light

es.e: stars twinkling in the sky
es.c: 天空中闪烁的星星

es.e: I saw lights twinkling in the little town below us.
es.c: 我看到我们下面的小镇灯火闪烁。

d: n 管弦乐队

es.e: He directed an orchestra.
es.c: 他指挥一个管弦乐队。

es.e: She conducted an orchestra of forty instruments.
es.c: 她在一个拥有40种乐器的管弦乐队里当指挥。

d: v 遵从，符合 to obey a law, rule etc

es.e: the pressure on schoolchildren to conform
es.c: 小学生要顺应社会的压力

d: adj 易犯错误的，错误难免的 able to make mistakes or be wrong

es.e: Humans are fallible.
es.c: 人孰无过。

es.e: These surveys are often a rather fallible guide to public opinion.
es.c: 这些调查往往会对舆论产生误导。

d: n&vt 疲劳，(金属)疲劳，杂役 very great tiredness

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["metal fatigue"]}
es.c: 金属疲劳

d: n 实践者，从事者；(医生或律师等)开业者 someone who regularly does a particular activity

es.e: one of golf’s most experienced practitioners
es.c: 最有经验的高尔夫球员之一

d: n 天主教教徒 A Catholic is a member of the Catholic Church

es.e: At least nine out of ten Mexicans are baptized Catholics.
es.c: 至少十分之九的墨西哥人是受过洗礼的天主教徒。

d: n 喜剧；一出喜剧，喜剧性事件 entertainment that is intended to make people laugh

es.e: a career in stand-up comedy
es.c: 单口喜剧表演职业

d: v 发生，发起；发明

es.e: How did the plan originate?
es.c: 这个计划最早是怎么想到的？

d: v 分配，配给 to use something for a particular purpose, give something to a particular person etc, especially after an official decision has been made

es.e: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
es.c: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

d: n 较年幼者 If you are someone's junior, you are younger than they are；adj 较年幼的，等级较低的 relating to sport for young people below a particular age

es.e: She now lives with actor Denis Lawson, 10 years her junior.
es.c: 她现在和比她小10岁的演员丹尼斯·劳森同居。

d: n 碗橱 a piece of furniture with doors, and sometimes shelves, used for storing clothes, plates, food etc

es.e: It’s in the kitchen cupboard.
es.c: 它在厨房的碗柜里。

es.e: The cupboard doors were open.
es.c: 柜门开着。

d: n 机动脚踏车 a small two-wheeled vehicle with an engine

es.e: Look at that family on a moped!
es.c: 看看脚踏车上的那一家子！

d: prep&n 加，加号 used to show that one number or amount is added to another；adj 正的 used to talk about an advantage or good feature of a thing or situation

es.e: Three plus six equals nine (3+6=9).
es.c: 3 加6等于9。

es.e: The total cost was $10,000, plus 14% interest.
es.c: 全部费用是1万美元，外加14%的利息。

d: n 乐观，乐观主义 a tendency to believe that good things will always happen

es.e: There are grounds for cautious optimism.
es.c: 有理由保持谨慎乐观。

d: v 体现；使具体化 to be a very good example of an idea or quality

es.e: She embodies everything I admire in a teacher.
es.c: 她具备了我所钦佩的教师该具备的一切素质。

d: n 楔子，楔形物 a piece of wood, metal etc that has one thick edge and one pointed edge and is used especially for keeping a door open or for splitting wood；v 挤进；把楔住 to force something firmly into a narrow space

es.e: Garnish with lemon wedges.
es.c: 用几角柠檬片作装饰。

d: n 典礼，仪式；礼节 an important social or religious event, when a traditional set of actions is performed in a formal way

es.e: a wedding ceremony
es.c: 婚礼

es.e: the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games
es.c: 奥运会开幕式

d: n 自杀 the act of killing yourself

es.e: More people commit suicide at Christmas than at any other time.
es.c: 圣诞节期间自杀的人比其他任何时候都多。

es.e: My mother attempted suicide on many occasions.
es.c: 我母亲多次试图自杀。

es.e: He apparently left a suicide note (= letter explaining his reasons for killing himself ) on his desk.
es.c: 他显然在桌上留了封绝笔信。

d: vt&vi 郑重地说；强调；发誓 to say very strongly that what you are saying is true

es.e: I never touched your purse, I swear!
es.c: 我绝对没有碰过你的钱包，我发誓！

es.e: I never touched her, I swear to God .
es.c: 我从未碰过她，我敢向上帝起誓。

es.e: I think it was about ten o’clock when we left, but I couldn’t swear to it (= I am not certain ) .
es.c: 我想我们离开时大约10点，但我不能肯定。

d: adj 相当大的；重要的 fairly large, especially large enough to have an effect or be important

es.e: Michael has already spent considerable time in Barcelona.
es.c: 迈克尔在巴塞罗那已经待了相当长的时间了。

es.e: issues of considerable importance
es.c: 相当重要的问题

es.e: The series has aroused considerable interest.
es.c: 这套系列节目引起了观众相当浓厚的兴趣。

d: adj 法庭(官)的, 审判的 " Judicial means relating to the legal system and to judgments made in a court of law

es.e: ...an independent judicial system.
es.c: …一个独立的司法体系。

es.e: ...efforts to manipulate the judicial process.
es.c: …操纵审判程序的努力。

d: n 大灾难，大祸 a terrible event in which there is a lot of destruction, suffering, or death

es.e: From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe.
es.c: 从各个方面来看，战争都会是一场灾难。

d: n 输水软管；长统袜 A hose is a pipe made of rubber or plastic, along which a liquid or gas flows, for example from one part of an engine to another；v 浇园子，用管冲洗 to wash or pour water over something or someone, using a hose

es.e: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
es.c: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管吸走。

d: "n [pl~s,-ma]最少量；最低限度" the smallest amount of something or number of things that is possible or necessary

es.e: At a minimum, we must recruit two new teachers.
es.c: 我们最起码应该招两名新教师。

d: adj 家的，家庭的，本国的 relating to or happening in one particular country and not involving any other countries；n 佣人 a servant who works in a large house

es.e: Unfortunately his domestic life wasn’t very happy.
es.c: 不幸的是，他的家庭生活并不幸福。

d: n 空额，赤字 the difference between the amount of something that you have and the higher amount that you need

es.e: the country’s widening budget deficit
es.c: 这个国家日益严重的预算赤字

es.e: the US’s foreign trade deficit
es.c: 美国的对外贸易逆差

d: v 离开，遗忘；保持一定状态；留下 to go away from a place or a person

es.e: My baby gets upset when I leave the room.
es.c: 我一离开房间宝宝就会不安。

es.e: Before leaving the train, make sure you have all your belongings with you.
es.c: 下火车前一定要带好随身物品。

es.e: Leave the motorway at Junction 7.
es.c: 请在七号交叉路口驶离高速公路。

d: n&vt 滥用；恶习；辱骂 the use of something in a way that it should not be used

es.e: A self-monitoring tax system is clearly open to abuse (=  able to be used wrongly  ) .
es.c: 自我监督的税收制度明显会被滥用。

d: n&vt 脸一部分，面貌，特征，特写，故事片 a part of something that you notice because it seems important, interesting, or typical

es.e: Air bags are a standard feature in most new cars.
es.c: 气囊是大多数新车的标准配置。

es.e: Striped tails are a common feature of many animals.
es.c: 尾巴上有条纹是许多动物的共同特征。

es.e: The hotel’s only redeeming features (= things that make it acceptable ) were that it was cheap and near the city centre.
es.c: 这家旅馆仅有的可取之处就是价格低廉并且靠近市中心。

d: n 自动扶梯 a set of moving stairs that take people to different levels in a building

es.e: Take the escalator to the third floor and it's the last office on the left.
es.c: 乘电梯到4楼，左边最后的那个办公室就是。

d: n 领土，领域，范围 an area of activity, interest, or knowledge, especially one that a particular person, organization etc deals with

es.e: Looking after the house was viewed as a woman’s domain.
es.c: 料理家务被认为是女性的份内之事。

d: v 使扩大，展开，膨胀 to become larger in size, number, or amount, or to make something become larger

es.e: Water expands as it freezes.
es.c: 水结冰时会膨胀。

es.e: Sydney’s population expanded rapidly in the 1960s.
es.c: 20世纪60年代，悉尼的人口迅速增加。

es.e: exercises that expand the chest muscles
es.c: 扩展胸肌的运动

d: adj 一致的，相同的，相应的 caused by or connected with something you have already mentioned

es.e: The war and the corresponding fall in trade have had a devastating effect on the country.
es.c: 战争以及由此所导致的贸易量下降对这个国家产生了致命的影响。

d: v 认为，视为 to think of something in a particular way or as having a particular quality

es.e: French and German were deemed essential.
es.c: 法语和德语被认为是必需的。

d: n 激情 a very strong feeling of sexual love

es.e: His eyes were burning with passion.
es.c: 他的眼中欲火燃烧。

d: n 面粉 a powder that is made by crushing wheat or other grain and is used for making bread, cakes etc

es.e: He added some flour to thicken the soup.
es.c: 他加了一些面粉使汤浓些。

es.e: Add in the lemon after mixing the flour and sugar.
es.c: 在面粉和糖混合之后倒入柠檬汁。

es.e: The villagers used to pound the grain into flour by hand.
es.c: 村民们过去常用手工把粮食捣成粉。

d: n 碰，幢;冲突 an accident in which two or more people or vehicles hit each other while moving in different directions

es.e: Two people were killed in a head-on collision (= between two vehicles that are moving directly towards each other ) on highway 218.
es.c: 218号公路上有两辆汽车迎面相撞，两人死亡。

d: v 归因于，把归于 If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing

es.e: An autopsy eventually ascribed the baby's death to sudden infant death syndrome.
es.c: 一次尸检最终把这名婴儿的死亡归因于婴儿猝死综合症。

d: v 大批出动，成群出现(鼠类及害虫) if insects, rats etc infest a place, there are a lot of them and they usually cause damage

es.e: ...pests like aphids which infest cereal crops.
es.c: …像蚜虫那样大肆侵害谷类作物的害虫。

d: v 插入，介入，干涉，(时间)介于 to become involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens

es.e: The army will have to intervene to prevent further fighting.
es.c: 军队将不得不干预以阻止进一步的战斗。

d: v 纠正；矫正 to correct something that is wrong

es.e: I did my best to rectify the situation, but the damage was already done.
es.c: 我竭尽全力去挽回局面，但损害已经造成了。

d: n 引诱，诱惑 a strong desire to have or do something even though you know you should not

es.e: Resist the temptation to buy the item until you’re certain you need it.
es.c: 要抵挡住购买的诱惑，除非你确有需要。

es.e: I finally gave in to the temptation and had a cigarette.
es.c: 我最终还是屈从诱惑，抽了一支烟。

d: vt&vi 打碎；打破；击溃 to break into pieces violently or noisily, or to make something do this by dropping, throwing, or hitting it

es.e: Vandals had smashed all the windows.
es.c: 破坏分子打碎了所有的窗子。

es.e: Firemen had to smash the lock to get in.
es.c: 消防员不得不砸锁而入。

es.e: Several cups fell to the floor and smashed to pieces .
es.c: 有几个杯子掉到地上摔得粉碎。

d: n&a 爆炸(的)，爆发性(的)

es.e: ...one-hundred-and-fifty pounds of Semtex explosive.
es.c: …150磅的塞姆汀塑料炸药。

d: v 辅导，训练 to teach a person or team the skills they need for a sport；n 长途汽车；教师；教练 someone who trains a person or team in a sport

es.e: Nigel coaches a cricket team in his spare time.
es.c: 奈杰尔业余时间担任一个板球队的教练。

d: v 导致；引起 To induce a state or condition means to cause it

es.e: Doctors said surgery could induce a heart attack.
es.c: 医生们说手术可能导致心脏病。

d: n&v 勒马的皮带；控制，约束 to control or limit something in order to prevent it from having a harmful effect

es.e: measures to curb the spread of the virus
es.c: 控制病毒扩散的措施

d: adj 数不清的，无数的

es.e: The rumours will do untold damage to his reputation.
es.c: 这些谣言会给他的名声造成无法估计的损害。

d: n 倾向，趋势，偏好 a tendency to behave in a particular way or suffer from a particular illness

es.e: There is a thin dividing line between educating the public and creating a predisposition to panic.
es.c: 教育公众和营造恐慌倾向之间只有细小的区别。

d: n 顶点；小说等的高潮 the most exciting or important part of a story or experience, which usually comes near the end；v 达到高潮 if a situation, process, or story climaxes, it reaches its most important or exciting part

es.e: The festival reaches its climax with the traditional boat-burning ceremony.
es.c: 传统的烧船仪式将节庆活动推向了高潮。

d: n 治疗，补救；纠正 a way of dealing with a problem or making a bad situation better

es.e: The problems in our schools do not have a simple remedy.
es.c: 我们学校的问题没有简单的解决办法。

d: n (pl)档案室 Archives are a collection of documents and records that contain historical information. You can also use archives to refer to the place where archives are stored.

es.e: ...the State Library's archives.
es.c: …国立图书馆的档案。

d: adj 宏伟的，壮丽的 very good or beautiful, and very impressive

es.e: a magnificent performance
es.c: 气势恢宏的演出

es.e: The twelve-mile coastline has magnificent sce-nery.
es.c: 这12英里的海岸线景色壮观。

es.e: She looked magnificent in a long red dress.
es.c: 她穿着红色长裙，看起来美极了。

d: v 辛劳工作，艰难地行动 When people toil, they work very hard doing unpleasant or tiring tasks；n 苦工，难事 hard or exhausting work

es.e: People who toiled in dim, dank factories were too exhausted to enjoy their family life.
es.c: 在阴暗潮湿的工厂里苦作的人们精疲力竭了，无法享受家庭生活。

es.e: Workers toiled long hours.
es.c: 工人们长时间辛苦工作。

d: adj 必有一死的；致命的；极大的 something very serious that may cause the end of something；n 致命性

es.e: The computer has dealt a mortal blow to traditional printing methods.
es.c: 计算机 给了传统的印刷方法一记致命的打击。

es.e: Our health service is in mortal danger.
es.c: 我们的公共医疗保健服务岌岌可危。

d: v&n 振翼，颤动，(心脏)不规则跳动 if your heart or your stomach flutters, you feel very excited or nervous

es.e: A small bird fluttered past the window.
es.c: 一只小鸟拍打着翅膀飞过窗前。

d: "a 暗的，不清楚的；费解的vt使阴暗,使难解；adj "
n&vt 存款；定金；沉淀，沉积 an amount of money that is paid into a bank account

es.e: fatty deposits on the heart
es.c: 心脏上沉积的脂肪层

d: n 高贵，尊贵，高位 the fact of being respected or deserving respect

es.e: Prisoners should be treated with regard for human dignity .
es.c: 对待囚犯应该考虑到人的尊严。

d: adj 有利的，赚钱的 a job or activity that is lucrative lets you earn a lot of money

es.e: Thousands of ex-army officers have found lucrative jobs in private security firms.
es.c: 成千上万的退役军官在私人保安公司找到了薪水丰厚的工作。

d: n&v 暗示，提示 something that you say or do to suggest something to someone, without telling them directly

es.e: There have been hints that he may take up coaching.
es.c: 他暗示过可能会出任教练。

es.e: ‘Look, I can’t tell you.’ ‘Oh, come on, give me a hint .’
es.c: “听着，我不能告诉你。”“得了，给我一点暗示吧。”

es.e: I made it clear I wasn’t interested in him, but he didn’t take the hint .
es.c: 我清楚地表明我对他不感兴趣，但他不明白我的意思。

d: n 回弹，弹性 the ability of a substance such as rubber to return to its original shape after it has been pressed or bent

es.e: And I think what we're seeing in the economy now is the inherent resilience of the American economy and the American people.
es.c: 而且我认为，我认为，在经济方面，我们现在看到的是美国经济和美国人民一直以来所固有的弹性。

d: n (事件、观念等的)系列；顺序；关联 the order that something happens or exists in, or the order it is supposed to happen or exist in

es.e: Be careful to perform the actions in the correct sequence .
es.c: 注意要按正确的顺序来完成动作。

d: n 才能；能力 a test that measures your natural skills or abilities
n 碎片，碎屑；少许，少量 a small piece of paper, cloth etc

es.e: a rug made out of old scraps of material
es.c: 用旧零碎材料拼做的一块小地毯

d: n 财产，资产 the things that a company owns, that can be sold to pay debts

es.e: the value of a company’s assets
es.c: 公司的资产价值

d: n 人群，群众 a large group of people in one place；v 拥挤，群集 if people throng a place, they go there in large numbers

es.e: She got lost in the throng.
es.c: 她在人群中迷路了。

d: n&a ，验尸，尸体解剖；事后的，死后的 A postmortem is a medical examination of a dead person's body in order to find out how they died

es.e: A postmortem was carried out to establish the cause of death.
es.c: 进行了尸检以确定死因。

d: n 时间 the thing that is measured in minutes, hours, days, years etc using clocks

es.e: Einstein changed the way we think about space and time.
es.c: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。

es.e: close relationships established over a long period of time
es.c: 长期建立起来的亲密关系

es.e: Customers have only a limited amount of time to examine the goods.
es.c: 顾客只有有限的时间可以检查商品。

d: adv 在别处，向别处 in, at, or to another place

es.e: She is becoming famous in Australia and elsewhere.
es.c: 她在澳大利亚和其他地方渐渐出名了。

es.e: Kerala has less crime and alcoholism than elsewhere in India.
es.c: 喀拉拉邦的犯罪和酗酒现象少于印度的其他地区。

d: n 戏剧的独白；滔滔不绝 a long speech by one person

es.e: Henry looked up, then continued his monologue.
es.c: 亨利抬起头，然后继续他的长篇独白。

d: n 财产；房产；性质 the thing or things that someone owns

es.e: The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests’ personal property .
es.c: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

es.e: Some of the stolen property was found in Mason’s house.
es.c: 在梅森家里找到了部分被盗财物。

d: v 转移，取代 to take the place or position of something or someone

es.e: Coal has been displaced by natural gas as a major source of energy.
es.c: 作为一种主要能源，煤的地位已为天然气所取代。

es.e: immigrants who displace US workers in the job market
es.c: 在就业市场上取代美国工人的移民

d: adj 同一的，完全相似的 exactly the same, or very similar

es.e: four identical houses
es.c: 四幢一模一样的房子

d: adj 华丽的，灿烂的；宜人的；可喜的 If you say that something is gorgeous, you mean that it gives you a lot of pleasure or is very attractive

es.e: ...gorgeous mountain scenery.
es.c: …壮观的山间景色。

es.e: It's a gorgeous day.
es.c: 今天天气真棒。

d: v 抵抗，反抗 If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it

es.e: ...armoured vehicles designed to withstand chemical attack.
es.c: …设计来抵御化学攻击的装甲车。

d: n&vt 洪水，暴雨；使泛滥 a large flood, or period when there is a lot of rain

es.e: There was a deluge of requests for interviews and statements.
es.c: 对接受访谈和发表声明的要求铺天盖地地涌来。

d: v 沉浸，沉浸于

es.e: He left school at 16 and immersed himself in the Labour Party.
es.c: 他16岁离开学校投身工党。

d: adj 辉煌的；壮丽的，光荣的 having or deserving great fame, praise, and honour

es.e: a truly glorious future
es.c: 无比美好的将来

es.e: a glorious victory
es.c: 光荣的胜利

d: n 海绵(状物)，松糕 a piece of a soft natural or artificial substance full of small holes, which can suck up liquid and is used for washing

es.e: a Victoria sponge
es.c: 维多利亚海绵蛋糕

d: n&vt 一瞥，匆匆一看 a quick look at someone or something that does not allow you to see them clearly

es.e: I glimpsed a figure at the window.
es.c: 我瞥见窗前有个身影。

d: v 请教；咨询，查阅 to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something

es.e: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
es.c: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

d: adj 单调的，枯燥的 boring and ordinary, and having no variety or interest

es.e: ...her lawyer husband, trapped in a humdrum but well-paid job.
es.c: ...她整天做着单调乏味的工作但收入颇丰的律师丈夫。

d: n 王冠，王权；顶部 the top part of a hat or someone’s head；v 为加冕；褒奖 to place a crown on the head of a new king or queen as part of an official ceremony in which they become king or queen

es.e: a hat with a high crown
es.c: 高顶帽

d: n 倾向，趋势 a general tendency in the way a situation is changing or developing

es.e: The current trend is towards more part-time employment.
es.c: 当前的趋势是雇用更多的兼职人员。

es.e: the general trend towards the centralization of political power
es.c: 政治权力集中化的普遍趋势

es.e: A disturbing trend is that victims of violence are getting younger.
es.c: 一个令人担心的趋势是，暴力行为的受害者越来越年轻。

d: vt&vi 伸长，拉长；滥用，曲解 to reach a long way for something；n 伸展 the action of stretching a part of your body out to its full length, or a particular way of doing this

es.e: The procession stretched for several miles.
es.c: 游行队伍延伸了数英里。

d: v 授以花粉 to give a flower or plant pollen so that it can produce seeds

es.e: flowers pollinated by bees
es.c: 由蜜蜂授粉的花

d: n 物品；文章；条款；[语]冠词 a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine

es.e: The paper’s leading article (=  the main article  ) described the government as weak.
es.c: 该报社论称政府软弱。

es.e: newspaper articles
es.c: 报纸上的文章

d: n 安全处所，避难所 a place where people or animals can live peacefully or go to in order to be safe

es.e: ...Lake Baringo, a freshwater haven for a mixed variety of birds.
es.c: …百瑞高湖，一个适合各种鸟类的淡水栖息地。

d: v 收养；采用 to take someone else’s child into your home and legally become its parent

es.e: Sally was adopted when she was four.
es.c: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

es.e: The couple are unable to have children of their own, but hope to adopt.
es.c: 那对夫妇自己无法生育，但希望领养孩子。

d: vt&vi 突出；伸出 to stick out from somewhere

es.e: ...a huge round mass of smooth rock protruding from the water.
es.c: …从水中突出来的一块光滑的圆形巨石。

d: n 小教堂；殡仪馆 a small church, or a room in a hospital, prison, big church etc in which Christians pray and have religious services

es.e: Bethan goes to chapel every Sunday.
es.c: 贝唐每个星期天都去教堂做礼拜。

d: n 假货，骗子 a copy of a valuable object, painting etc that is intended to deceive people；v 伪造 to make something seem real in order to deceive people

es.e: The painting was judged a fake.
es.c: 这幅画被鉴定为赝品。

es.e: Jones can spot a fake from 20 feet away.
es.c: 琼斯在20英尺开外就能认出假货。

d: adj (表面)潮湿的，湿润的 slightly wet, especially in a way that is pleasant or suitable

es.e: Make sure the soil is moist before planting the seeds.
es.c: 播种之前要确保土壤湿润。

es.e: a rich, moist chocolate cake
es.c: 香浓软润的巧克力蛋糕

es.e: warm moist air
es.c: 温暖湿润的空气

d: adj 不注意的，不顾的

es.e: The new tax laws were rammed through regardless of the opposition of the majority of the people.
es.c: 不顾大多数人民的反对，新的税法强行通过了。

d: n 板岩，石板 a dark grey rock that can easily be split into flat thin pieces

es.e: There were several slates missing from the roof.
es.c: 房顶有几块石板瓦掉了。

d: n 光辉 a soft steady light；v 发白热光；脸发红发热 if your face or body glows, it is pink or hot because you are healthy, have been doing exercise, or are feeling a strong emotion

es.e: She had a healthy glow in her cheeks.
es.c: 她脸上泛着健康的红晕。

d: n 联邦, 联盟, 同盟 " a group of organizations, clubs, or people that have joined together to form a single group

es.e: the National Federation of Women’s Institutes
es.c: 〔英国及英联邦国家〕妇女协会全国联合会

d: n&a 狡猾(的)，精巧(的) the ability to achieve what you want by deceiving people in a clever way

es.e: the tiger’s ferocity and cunning
es.c: 老虎的凶猛和狡诈

es.e: She would use low cunning (= unpleasant dishonest methods ) to win people’s sympathy.
es.c: 她会耍卑鄙的花招来博得别人的同情。

d: n 阵风，(感情的)迸发 a sudden strong movement of wind, air, rain etc

es.e: A gust of wind drove down the valley.
es.c: 一阵狂风掠过山谷。

d: n 日常工作；琐碎烦人的杂务 a small job that you have to do regularly, especially work that you do to keep a house clean

es.e: everyday chores like shopping and housework
es.c: 购物和做家务之类的日常琐事

es.e: We share the domestic chores.
es.c: 我们分担家务。

d: adj 可笑的，荒谬的 completely stupid or unreasonable

es.e: It seems an absurd idea.
es.c: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

d: v 波动，汹涌，澎湃 if a large amount of a liquid, electricity, chemical etc surges, it moves very quickly and suddenly

es.e: A wave surged up towards them.
es.c: 一个浪头向他们涌来。

es.e: Adrenalin surged through her veins.
es.c: 她血脉偾张。

d: n 幸存者，残存；幸存 the state of continuing to live or exist

es.e: The doctors gave him a one in ten chance of survival .
es.c: 医生说他有十分之一的生存希望。

es.e: A lot of small companies are having to fight for survival (= work hard in order to continue to exist ) .
es.c: 很多小公司不得不挣扎求生。

d: v 点燃，使燃烧 to start burning, or to make something start burning

es.e: The petrol tank suddenly ignited.
es.c: 油箱突然着火了。

es.e: The candle ignited the plastic.
es.c: 蜡烛烧着了塑料。

d: adj 巨大的；庞大的 extremely big

es.e: a gigantic skyscraper
es.c: 摩天大楼

d: n 景色；前景 a particular event which will probably or definitely happen in the future – used especially when you want to talk about how you feel about it

es.e: Unfortunately, there is little prospect of seeing these big questions answered.
es.c: 遗憾的是，几乎没有可能看到这些重大问题得到解答。

d: n 期；学期；条件 a fixed period of time during which someone does something or something happens

es.e: Teachers often feel overworked in term time (= during the term ) .
es.c: 教师在学期内经常觉得工作担子过重。

d: v 抑制 to not do something that you want to do

es.e: Mrs. Hardie refrained from making any comment.
es.c: 哈迪太太忍住了没做任何评论。

d: n 赤道 an imaginary line drawn around the middle of the Earth that is exactly the same distance from the North Pole and the South Pole

es.e: The United States is north of the equator.
es.c: 美国位于赤道以北。

es.e: In the hot zone near the equator the sun heats the air continually; hence the air there ascends.
es.c: 在靠近赤道的热带地区，太阳不断地加热那里的空气，于是那里的热空气就上升。

d: v&n 砰地关上；猛击 if a door, gate etc slams, or if someone slams it, it shuts with a loud noise

es.e: We heard a car door slam.
es.c: 我们听到有车门砰的一声关上了。

es.e: He slammed the door shut .
es.c: 他把门砰地关上。

d: v 提供，报答；表演，演奏；翻译 to give something to someone or do something, because it is your duty or because someone expects you to

es.e: an obligation to render assistance to those in need
es.c: 为有困难的人提供援助的义务

es.e: a bill of $3,200 for services rendered
es.c: 一张3,200美元服务费的账单

d: adj 任何的，无论什么样的
n 驾驶
n 友好；爱情 If you regard someone or something with affection, you like them and are fond of them

es.e: She thought of him with affection.
es.c: 她怀着喜爱想起了他。

d: n&v 握，抓；支持；装得下；认为；举行 to have a meeting, party, election etc in a particular place or at a particular time

es.e: This year’s conference will be held at the Hilton Hotel.
es.c: 今年的会议将在希尔顿酒店召开。

es.e: A thanksgiving ceremony was held to mark the occasion.
es.c: 举行了一个感恩仪式以庆祝这一特别的时刻。

es.e: The funeral was held on a grey day in November.
es.c: 葬礼在11月的一个阴天举行。

d: v 使安静，变平静 to make someone feel calm or as if they want to sleep；n 间歇 A lull is a period of quiet or calm in a longer period of activity or excitement

es.e: The hum of the tyres on the road lulled her to sleep.
es.c: 一路上滚滚的车轮声使她昏昏欲睡。

es.e: There was a lull in political violence after the election of the current president.
es.c: 现任总统选举结束以后，政治暴力曾暂时平息。

d: adj 无价的, 无法估价的 "

es.e: The internet is an invaluable source of information.
es.c: 因特网是十分有价值的信息来源。

d: v 剽窃，抄袭（别人学说、著作） to take words or ideas from another person’s work and use them in your work, without stating that they are not your own

es.e: He accused other scientists of plagiarizing his research.
es.c: 他指控其他科学家剽窃他的研究成果。

d: adj 酸的；尖刻的 having a sharp sour taste；n 酸 a chemical substance that has a  pH  of less than 7. Strong acids can burn holes in material or damage your skin

es.e: a juicy apple with a slightly acid flavour
es.c: 一个多汁、略带酸味的苹果

d: adj 相互的，共有的，共同的 mutual feelings such as respect, trust, or hatred are feelings that two or more people have for each other

es.e: I didn’t like Dev, and the feeling seemed to be mutual.
es.c: 我不喜欢德夫，他好像也不喜欢我。

es.e: The two men were a mutual admiration society , gushing about how much they were learning from each other.
es.c: 两个男人互相吹捧，盛赞对方让自己受益匪浅。

d: n 公开，宣传 Publicity is information or actions that are intended to attract the public's attention to someone or something

es.e: Much advance publicity was given to the talks.
es.c: 会谈之前做了大量的宣传。

es.e: ...government publicity campaigns.
es.c: …政府的宣传活动。

d: n 火炉，炉格 A grate is a framework of metal bars in a fireplace, which holds the wood or coal；v 擦碎，磨碎；擦响 to rub cheese, vegetables etc against a rough or sharp surface in order to break them into small pieces

es.e: A wood fire burned in the grate.
es.c: 柴火在炉栅里燃烧。

d: v 管理，支配；给予 to manage the work or money of a company or organization

es.e: The money will be administered by local charities.
es.c: 这笔资金将由当地慈善机构管理。

es.e: Our office administers the affairs of the Society.
es.c: 我们办公室管理协会的事务。

d: v 限制，约束 If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength

es.e: Wally gripped my arm, partly to restrain me and partly to reassure me.
es.c: 沃利抓住了我的胳膊，部分是想制止我，部分是想安慰我。

d: adj 战争的；军事的 connected with war and fighting

es.e: martial music
es.c: 军乐

d: n 面纱；掩饰物 a thin piece of material that women wear to cover their faces at formal occasions or for religious reasons

es.e: She lifted her veil with both hands.
es.c: 她用双手揭开面纱。

es.e: a bridal veil
es.c: 新娘的面纱

d: n 通货膨胀 a continuing increase in prices, or the rate at which prices increase

es.e: Inflation is now at over 16%.
es.c: 通货膨胀率现已超过16%。

d: adj 先前的 A previous event or thing is one that happened or existed before the one that you are talking about

es.e: She has a teenage daughter from a previous marriage.
es.c: 她有个出自前一次婚姻的十几岁的女儿。

d: n&v [天](日，月)蚀

es.e: an eclipse of the sun
es.c: 日食

d: adv 仅仅，几乎不 almost not or almost none at all

es.e: The city had scarcely changed in 20 years.
es.c: 这座城市20年中几乎没有什么改变。

es.e: The country had scarcely any industry.
es.c: 该国几乎没有工业。

es.e: He scarcely ever left the region.
es.c: 他几乎没有离开过这个地区。

d: n 陈词滥调 a statement that has been made many times before and is not interesting or clever – used to show disapproval

es.e: His excuse was the platitude ‘boys will be boys.’
es.c: 他还是那一套理由:“男孩总归是男孩。”

d: n 鼓励，激励，动机 something that encourages you to work harder, start a new activity etc

es.e: As an added incentive, there’s a bottle of champagne for the best team.
es.c: 给最优秀的队发一瓶香槟作为额外的鼓励。

d: n 泥泞，沼泽地

es.e: The wheels got stuck in the mire.
es.c: 轮子陷入泥潭里了。

d: v 驱逐，消除 to make something go away, especially a belief, idea, or feeling

es.e: We want to dispel the myth that you cannot eat well in Britain.
es.c: 我们要消除在英国吃不好的误解。

es.e: Light poured into the hall, dispelling the shadows.
es.c: 阳光洒进大厅，驱散了阴影。

d: adj 永久的，不朽的，不停的 continuing for ever and having no end

es.e: the Christian promise of eternal life
es.c: 基督教承诺的永生

es.e: She’s an eternal optimist (= she always expects that good things will happen ).
es.c: 她永远是个乐观主义者。

d: n 木桩；赌注；利害关系 if you have a stake in something, you will get advantages if it is successful, and you feel that you have an important connection with it

es.e: Young people don’t feel they have a stake in the country’s future.
es.c: 年轻人觉得自己与国家的未来没有关系。

d: n 一致，协调，和声 notes of music combined together in a pleasant way

es.e: the gorgeous vocal harmonies on ‘Mexicali Rose’
es.c: 《墨西哥玫瑰》的精彩和声演唱

es.e: three-part harmonies
es.c: 三部和声

d: conj =while；当 时候

es.e: As you lower your pen whilst continuing the motion, you should notice the resulting shape is more regular than it otherwise would have been.
es.c: 随着你降低你的笔，同时保持圆周运动，你应该会注意到画出的形状比起不这样做画出的形状要规范的多。

es.e: Indeed, it is important to keep fit and healthy, whilst we all aspire to improve the way we look and feel in order to make good first and lasting impressions.
es.c: 事实上，为了得到一个良好的初次印象和持续印象，在保持体形和健康的同时，我们也渴望提高自己看待和感受他人的方式。

es.e: Modules participate in a dynamic life cycle which includes the ability to add, update and remove modules at runtime, whilst preserving the state in the system.
es.c: 模块参与到动态的生命周期里，这个动态的生命周期能够在运行时添加、更新、删除模块，同时保留系统中的状态。

d: adv 照字义地，逐字地 You can use literally to emphasize an exaggeration. Some careful speakers of English think that this use is incorrect.

es.e: We've got to get the economy under control or it will literally eat us up.
es.c: 我们必须控制住经济，否则它真地就会把我们困住。

d: v 查明，探查 to find out something

es.e: A postmortem was ordered to try to ascertain the cause of death.
es.c: 下令验尸以查明死因。

d: n 麻痹，瘫痪；完全无力 the loss of the ability to move all or part of your body or feel things in it

es.e: paralysis of the lower body
es.c: 下半身瘫痪

es.e: The snake’s poison causes paralysis.
es.c: 这种蛇的毒液会引起身体麻痹。

d: adj 及时的；适时的 done or happening at exactly the right time

es.e: The fight ended only with the timely arrival of the police.
es.c: 幸亏警察及时赶到，打斗总算停止。

d: n 礼拜；崇拜

es.e: The ceremony must take place in a recognized place of worship .
es.c: 该仪式必须在获得认可的敬拜场所举行。

d: n 习语，成语 a group of words that has a special meaning that is different from the ordinary meaning of each separate word. For example, ‘under the weather’ is an idiom meaning ‘ill’.

es.e: the new musical idiom
es.c: 新的音乐风格

d: v 保护；维护 to protect something from harm or damage

es.e: technology that will safeguard the environment
es.c: 将会保护环境的技术

d: n 喇叭(声)

es.e: Life is something like a trumpet.
es.c: 生活有点像一个喇叭。

d: vt&vi (使)溢出，(使)溅出 if you spill a liquid, or if it spills, it accidentally flows over the edge of a container

es.e: Katie almost spilled her milk.
es.c: 凯蒂差点把牛奶洒出来。

d: n&v 漩涡 a circular movement of water, wind, dust etc

es.e: The racing river caused swirling eddies.
es.c: 湍急的河水形成了许多漩涡。

d: n 旁观者，观众 someone who is watching an event or game

es.e: The match attracted over 40,000 spectators.
es.c: 这场比赛吸引了四万多名观众。

d: n 系列；光谱 the set of bands of coloured light into which a beam of light separates when it is passed through a  prism

es.e: the electromagnetic spectrum
es.c: 电磁（波）谱

d: n 弹药 bullets, shells (  shell  ) etc that are fired from guns

es.e: He had only seven rounds of ammunition for the revolver.
es.c: 他只有7发左轮手枪的弹药。

d: n 吊唁，慰问；吊慰 sympathy for someone who has had something bad happen to them, especially when someone has died

es.e: a letter of condolence
es.c: 吊唁信

d: adj 土生土长的，本土的 indigenous people or things have always been in the place where they are, rather than being brought there from somewhere else

es.e: the many indigenous cultures which existed in Siberia
es.c: 存在于西伯利亚的许多当地文化

d: v 组成; 构成; 任命 if several people or things constitute something, they are the parts that form it

es.e: We must redefine what constitutes a family.
es.c: 我们必须对家庭的构成重新定义。

d: n (法律)配偶 a husband or wife

es.e: Spouses were invited to the company picnic.
es.c: 配偶受到邀请参加公司的野餐会。

d: n 高原 a large area of flat land that is higher than the land around it

es.e: A broad valley opened up leading to a high, flat plateau of cultivated land.
es.c: 一个宽阔的山谷展开，通向一片平坦的高原耕地。

d: adj 含蓄的，暗示的，无保留的 suggested or understood without being stated directly

es.e: ...an implicit warning to the Moroccans not to continue or repeat the military actions they began a week ago.
es.c: …叫摩洛哥人不要继续或重复一周前开始的军事行动的含蓄警告。

d: n 素食者 someone who does not eat meat or fish

es.e: Our youngest daughter is a vegetarian.
es.c: 我们的小女儿是个素食主义者。

es.e: dishes suitable for vegetarians
es.c: 适合素食者的菜肴

es.e: I’m thinking about becoming a vegetarian.
es.c: 我在考虑戒除荤食。

d: adj 遗传学的；发生的 relating to genes or genetics

es.e: genetic defects
es.c: 遗传性缺陷

es.e: each person’s genetic make-up
es.c: 每个人的遗传特征

es.e: genetic research
es.c: 基因研究

d: adj 合法的，合理的 fair or reasonable

es.e: That’s a perfectly legitimate question.
es.c: 那个问题完全合乎情理。

es.e: Most scientists believe it is legitimate to use animals in medical research.
es.c: 大多数科学家认为用动物作医学研究是正当的。

d: n 智慧，才智；明智的思想言论 good sense and judgment, based especially on your experience of life

es.e: a man of great wisdom
es.c: 一个有大智慧的男人

es.e: You can always expect a few words of wisdom from Dave.
es.c: 戴夫总能冒出几句至理名言。

d: v&n 反驳，反击 to reply quickly, in an angry or humorous way

es.e: ‘It’s all your fault!’ he retorted.
es.c: “那都是你的错！”他反驳道。

d: v 校准，调整 to change or move something slightly to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose

es.e: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
es.c: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

es.e: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning.
es.c: 尝尝汤的味道，然后调整佐料用量。

es.e: If your employment status changes, your tax code will be adjusted accordingly.
es.c: 如果就业状况改变，你的免税代码也会作相应调整。

d: n 汽车旅馆 a hotel for people who are travelling by car, where you can park your car outside your room

es.e: The gas station just neighbours to the motel.
es.c: 加油站就在汽车旅馆的附近。

es.e: I also have to get back to the motel. The manager took my passport last night, and now he and the passport are nowhere to be found.
es.c: 我也必须回到汽车旅馆去，因为旅馆经理昨天晚上拿走了我的护照，到现在为止他本人和我的护照都不知所踪。

d: n 趋向，趋势 if someone or something has a tendency to do or become a particular thing, they are likely to do or become it

es.e: ...the government's tendency to secrecy in recent years.
es.c: …近年来政府的保密倾向。

d: adj 月的，似月的 relating to the Moon or to travel to the Moon

es.e: studies of the lunar surface
es.c: 对月球表面的研究

es.e: a lunar eclipse
es.c: 月食

d: v 伸出，延长；给予；扩大 to continue for a particular distance or over a particular area

es.e: Management have agreed to extend the deadline.
es.c: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

d: n 记者，新闻工作者 someone who writes news reports for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio

es.e: a well-known journalist and broadcaster
es.c: 一位著名的新闻记者兼播音员

d: adj 表示歉意的 If you are apologetic, you show or say that you are sorry for causing trouble for someone, for hurting them, or for disappointing them

es.e: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate.
es.c: 医院员工都深表歉意，但那不能真正补偿。

d: n 矛盾，对立 a difference between two statements, beliefs, or ideas about something that means they cannot both be true

es.e: apparent contradictions in the defendant’s testimony
es.c: 被告证词中的明显矛盾

d: adj 谨小慎微的；过细的 If you describe someone as meticulous, you mean that they do things very carefully and with great attention to detail

es.e: He was so meticulous about everything.
es.c: 他对任何事情都很小心谨慎。

d: adv 不论用何种方法；无论如何

es.e: The scandal could damage her reputation but the press reported it anyhow.
es.c: 这宗丑闻可能损害她的名声，不过报纸还是给登了出来。

d: n 草稿；汇票；征兵 a piece of writing or a plan that is not yet in its finished form；v 起草；征兵 to write a plan, letter, report etc that will need to be changed before it is in its finished form

es.e: the rough draft of his new novel
es.c: 他的新小说的草稿

es.e: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
es.c: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

es.e: All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
es.c: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

d: n 前征，先驱 someone or something that existed before something similar that developed or came later

es.e: ...a machine which, in some respects, was the forerunner of the modern helicopter.
es.c: …一台在某些方面是现代直升飞机的前身的机器。

d: n 重复 doing or saying the same thing many times

es.e: Children used to learn by repetition.
es.c: 过去小孩子是通过背诵来学习的。

d: v 移居国外 to leave your own country in order to live in another country

es.e: He emigrated to Belgium.
es.c: 他移民去了比利时。

d: n 填料，填充物，填充剂 a mixture of bread or rice, onion etc that you put inside a chicken, pepper etc before cooking it

es.e: sage and onion stuffing
es.c: 洋苏叶和洋葱填料
