d: adj 慷慨的，过度的，大量的 large, impressive, or expensive

es.e: a royal palace on a lavish scale
es.c: 庞大的皇宫

es.e: a lavish lifestyle
es.c: 奢侈的生活方式

es.e: The food was lavish.
es.c: 食物很丰盛。

d: n 连续，系列 several events or actions of a similar type that happen one after the other

es.e: the series of events that led to the outbreak of war
es.c: 导致战争爆发的一系列事件

es.e: The police are investigating a series of attacks in the area.
es.c: 警方在调查该地区发生的一连串袭击事件。

es.e: There’s been a whole series of accidents on this road.
es.c: 这条路上发生了一连串的交通事故。

d: n 海峡；困难，窘迫 a narrow passage of water between two areas of land, usually connecting two seas

es.e: the Bering Strait
es.c: 白令海峡

d: n 讽刺，挖苦，嘲笑 a way of speaking or writing that involves saying the opposite of what you really mean in order to make an unkind joke or to show that you are annoyed

es.e: ‘Good of you to arrive on time,’ George said, with heavy sarcasm (= very clear sarcasm ) .
es.c: “你到得真准时啊。”乔治不加掩饰地挖苦道。

d: adj 敏感的；过敏的，容易生气的；仪器灵敏的 easily upset or offended by events or things that people say

es.e: a very sensitive child
es.c: 一个很敏感的小孩

d: v 依赖 If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly

es.e: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers.
es.c: 他们非常依赖专业顾问的建议。

d: n 艰巨的事业；事业心，企业 a company, organization, or business

es.e: commercial enterprises such as banks and food manufacturers
es.c: 银行和食品制造厂等商业企业

d: n 垃圾，污物 waste material, such as paper, empty containers, and food thrown away

es.e: Can you take out the garbage when you go?
es.c: 你走的时候把垃圾带出去好吗？

d: n 信件中附笔，附言 a message written at the end of a letter after you have signed your name
v 隔开；分离 to separate one group of people from others, especially because they are of a different race, sex, or religion

es.e: A large detachment of police was used to segregate the two rival camps of protesters.
es.c: 一大队分遣警察被派来隔离两群敌对的抗议者。

d: n 圆桶，汽缸 the tube within which a  piston  moves forwards and backwards in an engine

es.e: a four-cylinder engine
es.c: 四汽缸引擎

d: n 额外费用，过高的要价 money that you have to pay in addition to the basic price of something
v 跟着发生；结果是 If something ensues, it happens immediately after another event, usually as a result of it

es.e: If the Europeans did not reduce subsidies, a trade war would ensue.
es.c: 如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。

d: v 气喘，喘息；气喘吁吁地说 to breathe quickly with short noisy breaths, for example because you have been running or because it is very hot

es.e: He came in panting after running up the steps.
es.c: 他跑上台阶，气喘吁吁地走了进来。

es.e: He was panting for breath .
es.c: 他上气不接下气。

es.e: The dog lay panting on the doorstep.
es.c: 那条狗躺在门阶上喘着气。

d: adj 严厉的，严格的 serious and strict, and showing strong disapproval of someone’s behaviour

es.e: sterner penalties for drug offences
es.c: 对毒品犯罪的更为严厉的惩罚

d: adj 稳定的，不变的 continuing or developing gradually or without stopping, and not likely to change

es.e: Paul is making steady progress.
es.c: 保罗逐渐在进步。

es.e: a steady rain
es.c: 下个不停的雨

d: adj 抽象的 based on general ideas or principles rather than specific examples or real events；n (书籍、演说等的)摘要 a short written statement containing only the most important ideas in a speech, article etc

es.e: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
es.c: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

es.e: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
es.c: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

d: n 线索 an object or piece of information that helps someone solve a crime or mystery

es.e: Police have found a vital clue .
es.c: 警方发现了至关重要的线索。

es.e: Archaeological evidence will provide clues about what the building was used for.
es.c: 考古证据将为这幢建筑的用途提供线索。

es.e: a desperate search for clues
es.c: 拼命寻找线索

d: adj 彻底的；详尽的 including every possible detail

es.e: The doctor gave him a thorough check-up.
es.c: 医生给他做了一次全面的体检。

es.e: a thorough and detailed biography
es.c: 详尽的传记

es.e: The police investigation was very thorough.
es.c: 警方的调查十分彻底。

d: adj 按字母表顺序的 relating to the alphabet

es.e: The files are arranged in alphabetical order .
es.c: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。

d: n 民主，民主政体，民主社会 a system of government in which every citizen in the country can vote to elect its government officials

es.e: a return to democracy after 16 years of military rule
es.c: 16年军人统治后民主制度的恢复

d: v 液体渗出 to flow slowly through small holes or spaces

es.e: Radioactive water had seeped into underground reservoirs.
es.c: 放射性水已渗入了地下蓄水池。

d: n 差别，区分；卓著，荣誉 a clear difference or separation between two similar things

es.e: Eliot’s distinction as a poet
es.c: 艾略特作为诗人的杰出才能

d: n 指示者，指示物 something that can be regarded as a sign of something else

es.e: All the main economic indicators suggest that trade is improving.
es.c: 所有主要的经济指标都表明贸易情况正在改善。

d: v 锲而不舍 to continue trying to do something in a very determined way in spite of difficulties – use this to show approval

es.e: It can be tricky at first, but persevere.
es.c: 一开始会有些棘手，不过要坚持。

d: n 识字，读写能力 the state of being able to read and write

es.e: a new adult literacy campaign
es.c: 新一轮成人识字[扫盲]运动

d: v 断定，肯定 If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or exists

es.e: The court affirmed that the information can be made public under the Freedom of Information Act.
es.c: 法院公开肯定了此信息能依据《自由信息法案》公之于众。

es.e: ...a speech in which he affirmed a commitment to lower taxes.
es.c: …在其中他公开肯定了减税承诺的一次演讲。

d: v 谴责，斥责 to express strong disapproval of someone or something, especially in public

es.e: The group denounced the failure by the authorities to take action.
es.c: 该团体谴责当局没有采取行动。

d: n 缺点，欠缺 a fault or a lack of something that means that something or someone is not perfect；v 背叛 to leave your own country or group in order to go to or join an opposing one；n 逃跑；n 开小差

es.e: All the cars are tested for defects before they leave the factory.
es.c: 所有汽车在出厂前都经过品质检验。

es.e: a genetic defect
es.c: 遗传缺陷

d: v 编织；紧密结合 to make clothing out of wool, using two knitting needles

es.e: My grandmother taught me how to knit.
es.c: 我祖母教过我编织。

es.e: She’s knitting a sweater.
es.c: 她在织毛衣。

d: adj 令人惊奇的；创造奇迹的
v 常去；(鬼，魂)常出没于 if the soul of a dead person haunts a place, it appears there often；n 常去的地方 a place that someone likes to go to often

es.e: The pub is said to be haunted by the ghost of a former landlord.
es.c: 据说这个酒吧里经常有一位前任房主的鬼魂出没。

d: vt&vi 传教；讲道；劝诫；鼓吹 to talk about a religious subject in a public place, especially in a church during a service

es.e: He traveled the southern states, preaching the gospel .
es.c: 他游历南方各州宣讲福音。

d: n (酒店)价目表；关税税率 a tax on goods coming into a country or going out of a country

es.e: America wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.
es.c: 美国想要取消电子类产品的关税。

d: adj 主要的；最好的 most important

es.e: Smoking is the prime cause of lung disease.
es.c: 抽烟是引发肺部疾病的首要原因。

es.e: Our prime concern is providing jobs for all young school leavers.
es.c: 我们的头等大事是为所有的年轻毕业生提供工作。

es.e: He was named as the prime suspect in the murder investigation.
es.c: 在那宗谋杀案的调查中他被定为主要嫌疑人。

d: n 薄雾；朦胧 a light cloud low over the ground that makes it difficult for you to see very far

es.e: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
es.c: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。

es.e: He vanished into the mist.
es.c: 他消失在雾中。

es.e: The hills were shrouded in mist (= covered in mist, so that you could not see them ) .
es.c: 山峦笼罩在雾霭之中。

d: n 极度痛苦 very severe pain

es.e: the agony of arthritis
es.c: 关节炎的剧烈疼痛

d: n 镐；挑选；选择 if you can have your pick or take your pick of different things, you can choose which one you want；vt&vi 挑选；采 to choose a person or thing, for example because they are the best or most suitable

es.e: Have a look at the menu and take your pick .
es.c: 看看菜单再作选择吧。

es.e: He knew he could take his pick of any of the girls in the office.
es.c: 他知道自己可以挑办公室里任何一个姑娘。

es.e: Sarah could have her pick of any university in the country.
es.c: 萨拉可以选择国内任何一所大学。

d: n 比赛，联赛

es.e: She is aching to join in the tournament.
es.c: 她渴望参加比赛。

es.e: They dropped two games in a row and were eliminated from the tournament.
es.c: 他们在划船比赛中输了两场比赛，并被淘汰出局。

es.e: It's no use egging him on; he's made up his mind not to join in the tournament.
es.c: 他已拿定主意不参加比赛了，你再将他也没有用。

d: n 天才，天才人物，才华 a very high level of intelligence, mental skill, or ability, which only a few people have

es.e: The film reveals Fellini’s genius.
es.c: 这部影片展现了费里尼的天赋。

es.e: a work of pure genius
es.c: 天才之作

d: vi&n 闪烁，摇曳，闪现 to burn or shine with an unsteady light that goes on and off quickly

es.e: The overhead lights flickered momentarily.
es.c: 头顶灯闪了一会儿。

d: n 等级制度 a system of organization in which people or things are divided into levels of importance

es.e: a rigid social hierarchy
es.c: 严格的社会等级制度

es.e: She worked her way up through the corporate hierarchy to become president.
es.c: 她在公司一步一步升到了总裁的位置。

d: v 区别，识别；使显赫 to recognize and understand the difference between two or more things or people

es.e: Could he distinguish right from wrong?
es.c: 他能辨别是非吗？

d: n 房间；议院；贸易团体；弹膛 a room used for a special purpose, especially an unpleasant one

es.e: the Queen’s private chambers
es.c: 女王的寝宫

d: n 信任状，证书 a letter or other document which proves your good character or your right to have a particular position

es.e: The commissioner presented his credentials to the State Department.
es.c: 该委员向国务院递交了他的任职资格证书。

d: v 监考 to watch people who are taking an examination and make sure that they do not cheat

es.e: Different is, the exam in the life often does not have person invigilate.
es.c: 不同的是，生活中的考试常常是没有人监考的。

es.e: I need to invigilate the biology practice examination for the first class.
es.c: 我需要在第一节课监考生物模拟考试。

es.e: From technical area analysis, this invigilate is too severe, all sorts of measure that help city cannot come on stage.
es.c: 从技术面分析，这次监考太严，各种救市措施无法出台。

d: vt&vi 重新找到；复原，痊愈 to get back an ability, a sense, or control over your feelings, movements etc after a period without it

es.e: It was some hours before she recovered consciousness .
es.c: 过了几个小时她才恢复知觉。

es.e: Once she stumbled, but somehow she recovered her balance and carried on running.
es.c: 她绊了一下，但还是找回平衡，继续向前跑去。

d: n 火炮，干线 Artillery consists of large, powerful guns that are transported on wheels and used by an army

es.e: Using tanks and heavy artillery, they seized the town.
es.c: 他们使用坦克和重炮攻下了这座城市。

d: v 使空气流通；通风 to let fresh air into a room, building etc

es.e: Ventilate the room properly when stripping paint.
es.c: 在刮漆的时候要适当地使房间通风。

d: vt&n 责备，指责 criticism, blame, or disapproval

es.e: ‘You don’t need me,’ she said quietly, without reproach.
es.c: “你不需要我。”她语气平静，没有丝毫责备。

d: v 倒垃圾，倾销 to get rid of goods by selling them in a foreign country at a much lower price；n 堆垃圾的地方 a place where unwanted waste is taken and left

es.e: We dumped our bags at the nearby Grand Hotel and hurried toward the market.
es.c: 我们把包扔在附近的格兰德旅馆，急匆匆地向市场赶去。

d: n 卷，容积；音量；大量 the amount of sound produced by a television, radio etc

es.e: the volume of trade
es.c: 贸易量

d: n 结合，联盟，联合 a union of two or more political parties that allows them to form a government or fight an election together

es.e: the centre-right coalition government
es.c: 政治上中间偏右的联合政府

es.e: an emergency meeting of the three coalition parties
es.c: 三个联盟政党召开的一次紧急会议

d: n 口，孔；开始；张开；职位空缺 a hole or space in something

es.e: There are very few openings in scientific research.
es.c: 科学研究领域很少有职位空缺。

d: n 打击，巨大的成功 Hit is also a noun；v 打，打击，打倒 to touch someone or something quickly and hard with your hand, a stick etc

es.e: First a house took a direct hit and then the rocket exploded.
es.c: 首先一幢房子被直接击中，接着火箭弹爆炸了。

d: v 证实；证明 to prove the truth of something that someone has said, claimed etc

es.e: Katzen offered little evidence to substantiate his claims .
es.c: 卡曾拿不出什么证据来证明他的说法。

d: v 断言；宣称 to say that something is true or that someone has done something wrong, although it has not been proved

es.e: She alleged that there was rampant drug use among the male members of the group.
es.c: 她指称该组织中有大量的男性成员吸毒。

d: v 吩咐使用

es.e: Planning, as they employ the term, means: plans made by others will prescribe to me what I am to do and how to do it.
es.c: 按照他们使用这个词的方式，“计划”的意思是指：由他人所制定的计划将规定我应该做什么以及如何做。

d: v 消费，用尽 To expend something, especially energy, time, or money, means to use it or spend it

es.e: Children expend a lot of energy and may need more high-energy food than adults.
es.c: 孩子们耗能多，可能比成人需要更多高能量的食物。

d: adj 深思的，关心的 always thinking of the things you can do to make people happy or comfortable

es.e: Paul is very thoughtful.
es.c: 保罗非常体贴人。

d: n 家禽；家禽肉 birds such as chickens and ducks that are kept on farms in order to produce eggs and meat

es.e: ...a poultry farm.
es.c: …一个家禽饲养场。

d: v 供应伙食；提供娱乐节目

es.e: ...a full-service restaurant equipped to cater large events.
es.c: …一家承办大型活动及提供全方位服务的饭店。
